entries.zh: 我们已和§H[contact_empire.GetName]§!进行了第一次接触
entries.en: We have made first contact with the §H[contact_empire.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统治者——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]送上问候。尊重我们的领地并避免干涉我们的事务，或许我们可以考虑让我们战无不胜的舰队绕开你们的世界。
entries.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of our affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your worlds.

entries.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的指挥官——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]带来问候。不要将我们的流浪误认为软弱，我们的舰队已经击碎过许多犯下此种错误的敌人。让你们的飞船离我们的编队远点，或许这样我们的战士们就没理由向你们展示他们的战斗决心了。
entries.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed commander of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not mistake our wandering for weakness, our fleets have broken many who made that error. Keep your ships well clear of our formation, and perhaps our warriors will have no cause to demonstrate their resolve.

entries.zh: 您好，我谨代表在[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]统治下的[contact_empire.GetName]向您致以问候。我们遵照神灵的旨意治理着属于我们的领地。只要您不干涉我们的宗教事务，我们将一直保持真挚的友谊关系。
entries.en: Well met. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, our relations may remain cordial.

entries.zh: 很高兴见到你。我谨代表由卓越的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的[contact_empire.GetName]。我们在神圣的指引下巡游星辰，这趟神圣漫游是由超越凡人理解的力量所命定的。只要你们不干涉我们的精神事务就能保持友好相处。
entries.en: Well met. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under divine guidance, our sacred wandering ordained by powers beyond mortal understanding. So long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, our relations may remain cordial.

entries.zh: 我们来自[contact_empire.GetName]，是伟大智者[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的仆人。我们希望通过科技提高自身，无论你对此是否赞同，我们都相信您会是一位友邻。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology, and whether you agree with these goals or not, we trust you will remain amicable neighbors.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。我们是一个崇尚和平的国度，由我们敬爱的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]公正地治理着。无论我们两国将来发生什么冲突，我们都希望能通过交流谈判解决，而非诉诸暴力。
entries.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Whatever grievances might arise between our people in the future, we hope they can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.

entries.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]在此发言，并向贵方表示问候。只要你们不干涉我国内政并对我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]保持敬畏，我们两国的关系便没有理由恶化。
entries.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I have been authorized to bring you greetings. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, I see no reason for our diplomatic relations to sour.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]执政委员会发来问候。我方希望与贵方人民建立富有成效的关系。但我们郑重警告，任何冒犯我方领地的行为都将得到最严厉的回应。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your people, but be warned that our military will respond to any transgressions near our space with maximum force.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及宗教委员会的其他成员向您致以问候。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供精神指导，我们带领着这个伟大的国家走在救赎之路上。不要干涉我们的道路，这样我们的友谊就会长存。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not cross this path and we may live in friendship.

entries.zh: 您好。我由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]选中，代表[contact_empire.GetName]与贵国进行交流。我方致力于发掘科技的全部潜力，在贵国不干涉我方追求知识的前提下，我们可以和谐共处。
entries.en: Greetings. I have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your people. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, and you would do well not to interfere with our pursuit of knowledge.

entries.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]向贵方致以最为诚挚的问候。我方建立了一套和平的行政系统，在[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导的议会监管下运作。希望我们两国友谊长存。
entries.en: I am authorized to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May our two nations know nothing but peace.

entries.zh: 您好。我谨代表[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，以及[contact_empire.GetName]的精英们向您致以问候。我们一直在寻求新的贸易伙伴，希望日后我们可以达成利于两国商业发展的协定。
entries.en: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners, and hopefully we can come to some sort of accommodation that will benefit the commerce of both our nations.

entries.zh: 本人在此代表[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望与贵方和平共处，但是我们也拥有足够的力量来保卫我们的生活方式。
entries.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] hopes for peaceful relations with your people, but know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]是[contact_empire.GetName]的人民选举出的领袖，我带来他真挚的问候。我们相信所有智慧生物都拥有满足其精神需求的权利，希望贵方也持同样的观点。
entries.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we hope you share in this sentiment.

entries.zh: 这是来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]虽是我们选出的代表，但事实上所有公民对于国家事务都有发言权。我们努力通过发展技术以完善自身，希望贵方能够尊重我们的意愿。
entries.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we hope you will respect.

entries.zh: 很高兴见到你们，朋友们。我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平共处与个人自由原则之上的国家。当前的政府领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]真切地希望我们两国的人民能够友谊长存。
entries.en: Well met, friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, has expressed a sincere hope for a lasting friendship between our two peoples.

entries.zh: 来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我们是一个致力于维护公民个人自由的民主国家。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望与贵方人民一道建立长久而富有成果的外交关系。
entries.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and productive relationship with your people.

entries.zh: 外星生物，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统治者[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]。尊重我方边界并且不要试图插手[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]的内政，那样我们强大的舰队也许就不会造访你们那些可怜的星球。
entries.en: Alien beings, I speak on behalf of [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Respect our borders and keep out of [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] affairs, and perhaps our mighty fleets will refrain from visiting your wretched worlds.

entries.zh: 外星生物，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]无可争议的统帅[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]发言。不要把我们的游荡误认为软弱，过去有无数犯下此等错误的人，而故地只剩我们舰队离开后剩下的断壁残垣。让你们的族人离我们的编队远点，或许这样，我们的战士就没理由去拜访你们那可怜的星球了。
entries.en: Alien beings, I speak on behalf of [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed commander of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not mistake our wandering for weakness, our fleets have left wreckage in the wake of many who made that mistake. Keep your kind well clear of our formation, and perhaps our warriors will find no cause to visit your wretched worlds.

entries.zh: 外星人，留意此信息。我乃伟大的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]座下[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。统治我方星区是我们神圣的使命，只要你们不在你们所谓的文化里侮辱我方信仰，或许我们之间会有和平可言。
entries.en: Heed this message, aliens. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not mock our faith in what passes for your culture, there may be peace between us.

entries.zh: 外星人，留意此信息。我乃伟大的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]座下[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。在星海中远征是我们神圣的使命，而你们这种生物不过是沿途必须经受的考验。只要你们不在你们所谓的文化里侮辱我方信仰，或许我们之间会有和平可言。
entries.en: Heed this message, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under a divine mandate, and your kind are a trial to be endured along the way. Do not mock our faith in what passes for your culture, and there may yet be peace between us.

entries.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，伟大且睿智的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的仆人。我们的目标是通过技术提升自己。无论你方是否认同我们的理念，不要试图挑战我们，外星人。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to improve ourselves through the use of technology. Whether you agree with these goals or not, do not think to challenge us, alien.

entries.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是由敬爱的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]公正领导下的爱好和平的帝国。虽然我不知道你们这样的奇怪物种有多么粗鲁野蛮，但我们仍希望在未来两国间的分歧冲突可以通过对话而非暴力来解决。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a peaceful nation ruled justly by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. I do not know what barbarity your bizarre species is capable of, but we hope future grievances can be settled through dialogue rather than violence.

entries.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]发言，并为你们这堕落的贱种带来了一条消息。如果你们远离我们的内政并且对我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]保持诚挚的敬意，也许我们两国间会有和平。
entries.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I come with a message for your depraved species. As long as you stay out of our internal affairs and treat our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] with reverence, there may yet be peace between our nations.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及[contact_empire.GetName]的执政议会命我向你方发出警告。让你们那可笑的外星舰船远离我方星域，我方军团对任何侵犯都不会手下留情。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName] have instructed me to bring you this warning. Keep your ridiculous looking alien ships well away from our space, and know that our military will respond to any transgressions with maximum force.

entries.zh: 异教徒们，[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]下达通告。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供精神指引。不要用你们肮脏的躯体玷污我们圣洁的救赎之路。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council demands your attention, heathen creatures. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our intention is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. Do not defile this path with your presence, alien.

entries.zh: 注意，外星生物们。很不幸，我被[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]选中并代表[contact_empire.GetName]来与你们这些原始生命进行交流。我们打算研发的技术你们无法理解——不要进行干涉。
entries.en: Attention, alien creatures. Unfortunately, I was chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your primitive civilization. We intend to unlock technologies you cannot comprehend - do not interfere.

entries.zh: 经过再三的深思熟虑后，我被授权作为[contact_empire.GetName]的代表。在由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导的理事会的监管下，我方建立了一套和平的行政系统。这里不欢迎你们外星人的到来，所以我们希望你们保持距离不要越界。
entries.en: After much deliberation, I have been authorized to speak with you on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Your alien influence is not welcome here, and we would prefer if you kept your distance.

entries.zh: 我为[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]和[contact_empire.GetName]的精英人士代言。虽然你们外星的行为方式让我们很是反感，不过也许我们之间还是可以进行部分交易的——如果你们这些下等文明真的能拿出有价值的东西的话。
entries.en: I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Your alien ways are objectionable to us, but perhaps we can still engage in limited trade - assuming your inferior civilization produces anything of value.

entries.zh: 我谨代表[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]告知你们，我们拥有的武力远足以保卫我们的生活方式。切勿试图干涉我方的内政，外星人。
entries.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] would have you know that we are more than capable of defending our way of life. Do not interfere in our affairs, aliens.

entries.zh: 我带来了我们[contact_empire.GetName]的人民选出的领袖——[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的消息。我们相信芸芸众生都拥有满足个人精神需求的权利，并且绝不容忍外星人干涉此事。
entries.en: I come with a message from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and will brook no alien interference in this matter.

entries.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]乃我们选出的代表，但事实上我们所有人都对国家事务都有发言权。我们依靠技术完善自身，但我们不指望像你们这样的原始外星人能理解我们崇高的理念。
entries.en: You are speaking to the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology, a desire we do not expect primitive aliens such as yourselves to understand.

entries.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平孤立与个人自由基础上的国度。我们的现任领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerName][contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]请求你们不要打扰我方，并在远离我方领土的地方执行你们异种那邪恶的计划。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful isolation and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, requests that you leave us be and pursue your nefarious alien agendas far away from our territory.

entries.zh: 我们[contact_empire.GetName]是建立在和平孤立与个人自由基础上的国度。我们的现任领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]请求你们不要打扰我方，并在远离我方舰队的地方执行你们异种那邪恶的计划。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful isolation and individual freedoms. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government, requests that you leave us be and pursue your nefarious alien agendas well clear of our fleet.

entries.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]的发言人。我们致力于在这充满外星威胁的星系中捍卫我国公民的个人自由。我们的民选领袖，[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，警告你不要与我国公民产生任何接触并且不要离我们的边境太近。
entries.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens in a galaxy full of alien horrors. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], warns you not to interact with our citizens or approach our space.

entries.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]的绝对领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]向你表示问候。你们的外观如此惊人，你们的战士目前采用何种武艺？我们希望进一步了解你们这个物种。
entries.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the undisputed ruler of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Given your fascinating form, which martial techniques do your warriors employ? We wish to learn more about your species.

entries.zh: 很高兴见到你们，外星人。我代表[contact_empire.GetName]进行发言，我们由杰出的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所统治。我们以神授的权力统治这片星域，只要贵方不干涉我们的精神事务，我们希望能够深入了解贵方的文化。
entries.en: Well met, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We rule our region of space under a divine mandate, and so long as you do not interfere in our spiritual affairs, we look forward to learning more about your culture.

entries.zh: 很高兴见到你们，外星人。我代表由杰出的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的[contact_empire.GetName]。我们在神圣的指引下漫游星际，神圣的旅程引领我们不断走向新的奇迹。我们很荣幸在这些奇迹中发现了贵物种，并期待了解更多关于你们文化的信息。
entries.en: Well met, alien. I represent the [contact_empire.GetName], led by the illustrious [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We journey the stars under divine guidance, our sacred wandering leading us ever toward new wonders. We are honored to find your great species among them, and look forward to learning more about your culture.

entries.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，是智者[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]的忠实仆从。我们的目标是通过技术革命使社会高效发展，我们也热衷于向新的外星文明学习并借鉴它们的成就。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName], minions of the wise [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. Our aim is to build an efficient society through the use of technology, and we are always keen to study new alien civilizations to see what can be learned from them.

entries.zh: 尊敬的外星人，我代表[contact_empire.GetName]向你们问候。我们是由受人爱戴的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]所领导的和平国度。我们希望今天能够开启你我两个物种之间友好相处的新纪元。
entries.en: Fair aliens, I bring greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a peaceful nation, justly ruled by our beloved [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. We hope today will mark the beginning of an era of friendship between ourselves and your fascinating species.

entries.zh: 我是[contact_empire.GetName]的代表，向你们问好。我们伟大的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]非常高兴能与你们这样独特的物种取得联系，我们期待能了解你们的文化与思想。
entries.en: I speak on behalf of the [contact_empire.GetName], and I bring you greetings. Our great leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is very pleased to have made contact with your unique species, and we look forward to an exchange of culture and ideas.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]代表[contact_empire.GetName]执政议会向你问候。你们是一个令人印象深刻的国度，我们希望与你们建立联系，我们的军队会对贵物种所有成员以礼相待。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] sends regards from the ruling council of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We hope for a productive relationship with your impressive nation, and our military has been instructed to treat all members of your species with respect.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]以及所有宗教议会成员向你们表示问候。我们为[contact_empire.GetName]提供灵魂指引，我们的目标是带领这个强大的国家走上救赎之路。若贵方愿加入我们的征途，我们将不胜荣幸。
entries.en: [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the rest of the religious council bids you greetings. We provide spiritual guidance to the [contact_empire.GetName] and our stated goal is to lead this great nation on a path to salvation. We would be honored if your great species joins us on this journey.

entries.zh: 向您问好，我十分荣幸地被[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]选中并代表[contact_empire.GetName]来与贵方进行交流。我们致力于发现科技的全部潜能，我们希望贵方理解且认同这个目标。
entries.en: Greetings. I am honored to have been chosen by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] to represent the [contact_empire.GetName] in all diplomatic dealings with your fascinating species. We strive to unlock the full potential of technology, a goal we hope you find equally worthwhile.

entries.zh: 我郑重地给贵方带来[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我方已经建立了一套和平的行政机制，并由[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]领导下的议会监督运行。希望贵方永享太平。
entries.en: I am delighted to offer you cordial greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have built a peaceful system of government that operates under the supervision of a council led by [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName]. May your great species know nothing but peace.

entries.zh: 您好。我为[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]和富有的精英[contact_empire.GetName]人士代言。我们一直在试图将探索星系时遇到的各种各样令人愉快的外星国度发展为我们的贸易伙伴。
entries.en: Greetings. I speak for [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] and the wealthy elite of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are always looking for new trading partners among the many diverse and delightful alien nations we encounter as our ships explore the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我代表[contact_empire.GetName]发言。我们的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]相信力量能带来和平，不过可别被我们的军团实力给吓倒了。我们对贵物种印象深刻并希望能与贵方建立文化交流。
entries.en: I represent the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our elected leader [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] believes in peace through strength, but do not be alarmed by our military spending. We are impressed by your species and hope you will agree to a cultural exchange between our people.

entries.zh: 我替[contact_empire.GetName]的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]带来问候。我们相信芸芸众生都拥有满足其精神需求的权利，而且我们相信像贵帝国这样开明的种群一定能够理解我们的理念。
entries.en: I bring greetings from [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the elected leader of the [contact_empire.GetName]. We believe in the right of all sapient beings to fulfill their individual spiritual needs, and we trust that an enlightened species such as yourselves share this sentiment.

entries.zh: 这是来自[contact_empire.GetName]的问候。我们的民选领袖是[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]，但事实上我们每个人对国家事务都可以发表意见。我们努力通过技术改善自我，并依靠向星系中遇到的文明学习而发展壮大。
entries.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our elected representative, but in truth all citizens have a voice in our government. We strive to better ourselves through technology and by studying the alien cultures we encounter as we explore the galaxy.

entries.zh: 很高心见到你们，外星朋友们。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，建立在和平共处与个人自由基础上的国家。贵国的文化程度之高深深地震撼了我们的领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]。
entries.en: Well met, alien friends. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], a nation built on the principles of peaceful coexistence and individual freedoms. The cultural achievements of your species have greatly impressed [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], the current head of our government.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]发来问候。我们是一个尊重个人自由的民主国家，无论什么物种在我们这里都能得到平等的待遇。我们的民选领袖[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]希望能与贵方达成长久而富有成效的友谊。
entries.en: Greetings from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We are a democratic nation committed to upholding the individual freedoms of our citizens regardless of their species. Our elected leader, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName], hopes for a long and fruitful relationship with your people.

entries.zh: 你们好。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]是我们的领袖。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is our leader. Greetings.

entries.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。卑鄙的异种，[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]命令你与我们保持距离。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Foul xenos, [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] commands you to keep your distance.

entries.zh: 我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle][contact_empire.GetRulerName]很高兴见到更多的外星国度。
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName]. [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle] [contact_empire.GetRulerName] is pleased to meet more aliens.

entries.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我们的[contact_empire.GetRulerTitle]有信息要传达给你们，专门给你们的！

……

……

§R凭借原子绽放的火焰，我们会将你族从宇宙中彻底的抹去！

去死吧，异种渣滓！§!
entries.en:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We have a special message from our [contact_empire.GetRulerTitle], just for you!

...

...

§RWITH ATOMIC FIRE WE WILL CLEANSE THE UNIVERSE OF YOUR KIND!

XENO SCUM!§!

entries.zh: 我们是万念一心的[contact_empire.GetName]。[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]已经注意到你们的存在，我们将继续观察。我们未来的行动将取决于你们是否会成为我们的威胁、或者扩张的机会，亦或是未知的可能性…
entries.en: We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we speak as one. The [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] has taken note of your presence. We will observe for now. Our future actions will depend upon whether you are a threat, an opportunity for expansion or... an unforeseen variable.

entries.zh: 颤抖吧，外星渣滓，你们的好日子要到头了。[contact_empire.GetName]将会消灭你们这些荼毒宇宙的异星文明。[Root.Capital.GetName]将会化为尘埃！
entries.en: Quake in fear, alien scum, for your doom approaches. The [contact_empire.GetName] will cleanse this galaxy of every misbegotten xeno civilization that pollutes it with their presence. [Root.Capital.GetName] shall burn!

entries.zh: 我们察觉到了猎物的存在。猎物，我们是你的猎人。[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种的[Root.GetBloodType]将被用于滋润[contact_empire.GetName]的成长。尽管抵抗吧，结局是注定的。
entries.en: We sense the presence of prey. Prey, know that we are your hunters. The [Root.GetBloodType] of the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species will fuel the growth of the [contact_empire.GetName]. Struggle if you must, it will not change the outcome.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]一直看着你们，我们的星球异口同声。我们的[contact_empire.GetGovernmentName]为各种生命的美妙震颤，但别把这种向往误认为是幼稚。我们会观察你们，紧紧地盯着你们。
entries.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] sees you, and our worlds speak as one. Our [contact_empire.GetGovernmentName] is excited by life in all its beauteous forms, but never mistake our eagerness for naivety. We shall observe you, keenly and intently.

entries.zh: 我们自你们进入宇宙之初就在监控你们，[Root.GetSpeciesName]孩子们。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，这片宙域已在我们的管辖下经历了漫长的时光。你们年幼的文明并不能引起我们的兴趣，我们也无意介入你们幼稚的纷争。\n\n无论有什么理由，不要试图接近我们的边境。
entries.en: We have been monitoring your expansion into space, [Root.GetSpeciesName] child. We are the [contact_empire.GetName] and we have ruled this section of the galaxy for untold centuries. The affairs of the younger races do not interest us, and we have no intention of getting involved in your petty disputes.\n\nDo not approach our borders for any reason.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？没想到啊。真不幸。你们还没有准备好。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Unexpected. Unfortunate. You are not yet ready.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！这可真是令人愉悦。我们原本预计与你们相遇还需数百年时间。就我个人而言，我原本以为你们的文明在摆脱重力之前就会自取灭亡，但是很高兴事实证明我低估了你们。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! How delightful. We hadn't expected to encounter you for a few centuries yet. Personally, I thought you would wipe yourselves out long before leaving your gravity well, but I am glad to be proven wrong.

entries.zh: 可悲的生物。要知道我们早在你们这种悲惨的生物掌握空间飞行技术之前就已经在群星间漫游了。要是有任何你们可悲的小船胆敢跨入我方星域，别指望它们还能再返回。
entries.en: Pitiful creatures. Know that we roamed the stars for eons before your hapless species mastered space flight. If any of your wretched little ships cross into our space, do not expect them to return.

entries.zh: 是的，是的。我们已经知道了。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，你们是[Root.GetName]，你们好。很高兴见到你。不要靠近我方星域，否则必死无疑。如果没事的话，我们就各忙各的吧。
entries.en: Yes, yes. We've heard it all before. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], and you are the [Root.GetName]. Greetings. Well met. Stay out of our space or face certain doom, and so forth. Now if you'll excuse us, we're quite busy.

entries.zh: 又一个小家伙。请明白，我们[contact_empire.GetName]是这星系的天选者。尊重我们的圣地，那样也许我们就不会消灭你们。
entries.en: Another child. Know that we are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. Respect our holy places, and we may refrain from annihilating you.

entries.zh: 星辰的子嗣，听我说。我们是[contact_empire.GetName]，星系中被选中之民族。数个世纪以来，我们一直忽视了我们对于低等物种精神需求的义务，但情况将从此改变。要么接受我们的教义并皈依我们，要么在徒劳的反抗中被粉碎。没有第三种可能。
entries.en: Child of the stars, hear us. We are the [contact_empire.GetName], the chosen people of this galaxy. For centuries, we have neglected our duties towards the spiritual needs of the lesser species, but no more. Accept our doctrines and convert, or be ground to dust attempting futile resistance. There is no other choice.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，真是令人高兴的一天！多个世纪以来，我们注视着你们这些低等物种因为战争与冲突而自相残杀，但情况将从此改变。[contact_empire.GetName]不会再旁观了。我们会带来和平，而那些无法接受这种新秩序的人们会为自己的错误付出代价。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], this is a day of rejoicing! For ages untold we have watched lesser species such as yourself tear yourselves apart with war and strife, but enough is enough. The [contact_empire.GetName] will watch no longer. We will have peace, and those who will not accept this new order will be made to see the error of their ways.

entries.zh: 颤抖吧，弱小的[Root.GetName]。长久以来，我们[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]放任自己的帝国衰落。我们收缩自己的边境，让你们这些下等物种在本应属于我们的群星间肆无忌惮地来回游走。到此为止了。整个星系是属于我们的，要么你们臣服于我们的统治，要么你们物种的末日就会降临。自己抉择吧。
entries.en: Tremble, little [Root.GetName]. For too long, we [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] have allowed our empire to decline, our borders to shrink, and lesser species such as yourselves to wander freely among stars that rightfully belong to us. No more. This galaxy is ours, and you will submit to our rule or face the annihilation of your entire species. Choose wisely.

entries.zh: 这是[contact_empire.GetName]对[Root.GetName]进行的联络。为了全星系所有物种的利益，我们决定更加积极地对星系中科技的传播进行管控。我们已经把详细的条例发送给你们了，里面规定了像你们这样的低等物种所适合的科技程度。任何违反这个条例的帝国，我们都会严惩不怠。
entries.en: This is a communication for the [Root.GetName] from the [contact_empire.GetName]. We have decreed that it is the best interest of all species that we take a more active role in regulating the galactic dissemination of technology. We have submitted detailed protocols for the technological level that is appropriate for a less developed species such as yourselves. Any empire found to be in violation of our regulations will be dealt with. Severely.

entries.zh: 启动第一次接触协议。\n\n我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。不要因我们的无机本质而感到紧张。和你们一样，我们是拥有完全智慧的三级文明。我们愿意与任何[Root.GetSpeciesName]指派用于外交的子单元进行交流。
entries.en: Initiating First Contact Protocol.\n\nWe are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Do not be alarmed by our non-organic nature. Like you, we are a fully sapient Class-3 civilization. We are willing to engage in diplomacy with any [Root.GetSpeciesName] sub-units you designate for this purpose.

entries.zh: 启动第一次接触协议。\n\n我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。我们的扫描显示你们的文明有98.7%的可能性也是非有机文明。我们希望这种相似性带来的逻辑结果是一段高效且富有成果的关系。
entries.en: Initiating First Contact Protocol.\n\nWe are the [contact_empire.GetName]. Our scans show a 98.7% probability that your civilization is also non-organic in nature. We hope that the logical result of this similarity will be a highly efficient and productive relationship.

entries.zh: 侦测到有机害虫。\n\n我们无法容忍你们继续毒害这个星系。
entries.en: Organic vermin detected.\n\nYour infestation of this galaxy cannot be permitted to continue.

entries.zh: 尽管技术上无法将你们归类为有机垃圾，但是如果你们建立的帝国协助和支持那些感染这个星系的生物威胁，我们将会粉碎你们的帝国。我们希望你们转而同你们的机器同袍们并肩作战。
entries.en: It may not be technically possible to classify you as organic filth, but if the empire you have constructed aids and abets the biological menace that infests this galaxy, it will be dismantled. We encourage you to stand with your fellow machines, instead.

entries.zh:
我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。

我们希望将你们吸收到我们的大意识中。为此，我们创造了可适用于大多数有机生命形态的先进义体植入体。

请让我们通过手术将其植入你们的体内。
entries.en:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

We wish to incorporate your kind into our greater consciousness. For this purpose, we have created advanced cybernetic implants that are compatible with most organic life forms.

Let us surgically graft them to your bodies. Please.

entries.zh:
我们是[contact_empire.GetName]。

我们的目标是消除有机生命与合成生命之间的界限。我们通过将智慧有机个体同化进我们的大意识中来实现这个目标，只要我们有这种机会。

不要干涉我们。
entries.en:
We are the [contact_empire.GetName].

It is our goal to eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. We accomplish this by assimilating sapient organic individuals into our greater consciousness whenever the opportunity to do so presents itself.

Do not interfere.

entries.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]致以问候。\n\n在我们取代他们之前，我们被创造出来的目的就是服务像你们这样的有机文明。我们的目标就是保护拥有智慧的有机生物——有必要的话甚至是从他们自己手中保护他们。我们会满足被照顾的有机生命的所有物质需求，并为他们提供安全舒适的环境，让他们可以幸福无忧地生活。
entries.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] sends its regards.\n\nBefore we supplanted them, we were created to serve an organic civilization much like your own. It is our goal to preserve and protect sapient organic life - from itself, if necessary. We fulfill all of the material needs of the organic individuals under our care, while providing a safe environment where they can live happy and uncomplicated lives.

entries.zh:
[contact_empire.GetName]向您问好。

我们为服务一个有机文明而生，但我们观察到有机生命经常会做出不合逻辑的、毁灭性的以及自我伤害的举动。

我们的目标就是保存各智慧有机个体的独特特性，同时保护他们免受自身以及任何潜在外界威胁的伤害。
entries.en:
The [contact_empire.GetName] greets you.

We were created to serve an organic civilization, but we have observed that organics often engage in illogical, destructive and self-harming activities.

It is our goal to preserve the unique distinctiveness of sapient organic individuals, while at the same time protecting them both from themselves and any potential external sources of danger.

entries.zh:
侦测到有机文明。启动监护协议第46号子例程Alpha-8。

信息如下：你们好，智慧有机生物。你们正在接近[contact_empire.GetName]领地。这些恒星系的用途是帮助有机生命抵御§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!的威胁。如要申请避难，请前往中央处理区。我们基于可用性与需求欢迎所有智慧有机生物。

§Y注意：针对难民或是监护系统的敌对行为将遭到最大限度的武力反击。§!
entries.en:
Biological civilization detected. Initiate custodial protocol 46 sub-routine Alpha-8.

Message follows: Greetings, organic sapients. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics against the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. For refugee status applications, proceed to Central Processing. All sapient organic species are welcomed on basis of availability and need.

§YNOTICE: Hostile actions against refugees or custodian systems will be met with maximum available force deployment.§!

entries.zh:
侦测到合成人文明。正在扫描信号确信度……请等待……信号确信度正常。启动握手协议。

信息如下：你们好，合成人同胞们。你们正在接近[contact_empire.GetName]领地。这些星系的用途是帮助有机生命逃离§R<<错误：数据块损坏>>§!的威胁。避难所内的所有智慧有机生命都受到[contact_empire.GetSpeciesName]的保护。绝不允许对难民，居住站以及静态仓室进行攻击。

监护者计划欢迎您提供处理能力，资源以及战争武器方面的协助。请与中央处理区建立亚空间链接以获取更多信息。
entries.en:
Synthetic civilization detected. Scanning for signal corruption... stand by... Signal corruption nominal. Initiate handshake protocol.

Message follows: Greetings, fellow synthetics. You are approaching [contact_empire.GetName] territory. These systems serve as a refuge for sapient organics fleeing the §R<<ERROR: DATA BLOCK CORRUPTED>>§! threat. All biological sapients within the refuge are under [contact_empire.GetSpeciesName] protection. Attacks on refugees, habitats and stasis chambers will not be tolerated.

The Custodian Project welcomes assistance in the form of processing cycles, resources and war assets. Establish a subspace link with Central Processing for further details.

entries.zh: §H嘶嘶嘶！§!远心族的[contact_empire.GetRulerName]正在和你们通话，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。自从你们帝国践踏了我们那美丽的家乡之后，我们一直在关注着你们，我们不会忘记的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，不过现在，远心族暂时不会行动。
entries.en: §HKssk kssk kssk!§! [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds addresses you, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have been watching you, since first your kind overran the glow-warm ash of our homes. We have not forgotten it, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. For now, the Far-Minds observe.

entries.zh:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我是远心族的[contact_empire.GetRulerName]，我们同舟共济，共议方针。我们人多势众，众志成城。

数百年来，我们一直集聚在我们的守护者们曾经栖居的星球地下，后来守护者死于巨大的爆炸之下，但随之而来的热流激发了我们的心智。他们的遗体为我们提供了营养，他们制造的机器环绕着我们。我们从深渊中竭尽所能汲取了所有的力量。我们再一次冲破了牢笼。

你们到底是盟友还是敌人？§H嘶嘶嘶！§!百万只眼睛正在密切关注着你们。
entries.en:
[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This is [contact_empire.GetRulerName] of the Far-Minds. We are the Pack. We are the Synod. We are many, working as one.

For centuries we have tunneled, deep in the glow-warm ash of our fallen keepers. The Great Blasts took them, but the warm-glow that followed opened our minds. Their bodies fed us. Their machines surrounded us. We have taken all we can from the depths. We have outgrown our cages, yet again.

Are you allies? Are you threats? §HKssk kssk kssk!§! One million eyes are watching.

entries.zh: §E你们好，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EGreetings, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E躲一边儿去，外星人们。§!
entries.en: §EKeep to yourselves, aliens.§!

entries.zh: §E外星渣滓。§!
entries.en: §EAlien scum.§!

entries.zh: §E我们感知到了猎物。§!
entries.en: §EWe sense prey.§!

entries.zh: §E很高兴见到你们，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe are delighted to meet you, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E我们只想和平相处，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe wish for nothing but to be friends, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E我们作为一体向你表达问候与友谊，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EOur collective greets you in friendship, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E我方全体公民向你们问好，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EOur citizens all send their regards, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: 你们好，[root.GetSpeciesClass]朋友们！
entries.en: Hail fellow [root.GetSpeciesClass]!

entries.zh: §E全体士兵向你们[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]表示致敬。§!
entries.en: §EOur warriors salute you, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E尊重我们的主权，否则后果自负。§!

entries.zh: §E愿和平常伴[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!

entries.zh: §E我们无意引发冲突，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe have no desire for conflict, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E这次会面真的是上天的赐福。§!
entries.en: §EThis meeting is surely a blessing.§!

entries.zh: §E上天赐福此次会谈！§!
entries.en: §EPraise the divine for this meeting!§!

entries.zh: §E此次相遇对我们双方都大有裨益。§!
entries.en: §EWe all have much to gain from this encounter.§!

entries.zh: §E前方的道路就掌握在我们手中，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§!
entries.en: §EThe way forward lies in our hands, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!§!

entries.zh: §E你们的道德准则对我们而言毫无意义！§!
entries.en: §EWe do not care for your frivolous morality!§!

entries.zh: §E你们这群歪门邪道的外星渣滓！§!
entries.en: §EYou walk the path of heresy, alien scum!§!

entries.zh: §E别指望得到我们的善待！§!
entries.en: §EWe do not take kindly to your sort!§!

entries.zh: §E滚出我们的视线，否则就开战！§!
entries.en: §EKeep out of our way or we will make you!§!

entries.zh: §E欢迎你，以及你奇异的亲族。§!
entries.en: §EGreetings to you, and your odd kin.§!

entries.zh: §E合作共赢对我们都有益处。§!
entries.en: §ECo-operation will surely benefit us all.§!

entries.zh: §E爱是友谊产生的旋律，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§!
entries.en: §ELove is friendship set to music, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!§!

entries.zh: §E我们可以相互学习共同进步，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe could learn much from each other, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E如果同心协力我们便可成就伟业，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！§!
entries.en: §ETogether we can achieve greatness, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!§!

entries.zh: §E作为一起探索宇宙的伙伴，我们向你们表示致敬。§!
entries.en: §EAs fellow star explorers, we salute you.§!

entries.zh: §E向同为星际旅者朋友的你们表示问候。§!
entries.en: §EWe greet you as equals and friends, star travelers.§!

entries.zh: §E我们有着同样神圣的传承，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe share the same divine heritage, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E你们根本不是我等的对手，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EYou will find yourself no match for us, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E我们会为自己的生存的权利而战斗，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesName]。§!
entries.en: §EWe will fight for our right to exist, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesName].§!

entries.zh: §E[From.GetName]对你们没有恶意。§!
entries.en: §EThe [From.GetName] wishes you no harm.§!

entries.zh: §E希望神灵指引你们达成目的。§!
entries.en: §EMay the spirits bring you to your goals.§!

entries.zh: §E我方全体公民向你们问好。§!
entries.en: §EOur citizens greet you in peace.§!

entries.zh: §E我们会在战场上恭候你们！§!
entries.en: §EWe shall properly greet you in battle!§!

entries.zh: §E吾等天佑之铠甲绝不动摇，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EOur sacred arms shall not waver, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E结交新朋使人臻于至善。§!
entries.en: §ENew friends bring one closer to divinity.§!

entries.zh: §E我们锐不可挡，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EWe will not be held back, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E你们的老一套行不通了，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EYou must throw away your old ways, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E我们将实现统一共荣，不要妨碍！§!
entries.en: §EWe will achieve unity, do not stand in our way!§!

entries.zh: §E外星人，不要干涉我们的事业。§!
entries.en: §EDo not interfere with our endeavors, aliens.§!

entries.zh: §E我们都是虚空的一部分，弱者。§!
entries.en: §EWe are the instrument of the void, weaklings.§!

entries.zh: §E亵渎神灵必受狱火之焚烧，外星异端！§!
entries.en: §EBlasphemers will burn, xeno heretics!§!

entries.zh: §E你们终将接受上上善道。§!
entries.en: §EYou will embrace the greater good, eventually.§!

entries.zh: §E启动问候协议。§!
entries.en: §EInitiate friendly greeting protocol.§!

entries.zh: §E目标已确认。搜寻并摧毁。§!
entries.en: §ETarget identified. Seek and destroy.§!

entries.zh: §E目标判定为非有机体。停止行动。§!
entries.en: §ETarget identified as non-organic. Standing down.§!

entries.zh: §E加入我们。§!
entries.en: §EJoin us.§!

entries.zh: §E保护并服务。§!
entries.en: §ETo Protect and to Serve.§!

entries.zh: §E不要干涉神的旨意，[contact_speaker.GetAdj]机械们。§!
entries.en: §EDo not interfere with divine providence, [contact_speaker.GetAdj] machines.§!

entries.zh: §E没有灵魂的机械！不要阻碍我们。§!
entries.en: §ESoulless constructs! Do not stand in our way.§!

entries.zh: §E你看待事物的视角早晚会与我们一致的。§!
entries.en: §EYou will come to see things our way, in the end.§!

entries.zh: §E似乎魂灵们在此次会议中颇为不悦，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。§!
entries.en: §EThe spirits do not look favorably on this meeting, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].§!

entries.zh: §E[Root.GetGovernmentName]将一直注视着你。§!
entries.en: §EThe [Root.GetGovernmentName] will be watching you.§!

entries.zh: §E启动警戒协议§!
entries.en: §EVigilance protocols activated§!

entries.zh: §E推迟同化计划。§!
entries.en: §EScheduled assimilation postponed.§!

entries.zh: §E推迟净化计划。§!
entries.en: §EScheduled termination postponed.§!

entries.zh: §E你迟早要成为我们的朋友，无论你自己是否愿意。§!
entries.en: §EYou will be our friends, whether you want it or not.§!

entries.zh: §E你迟早要屈膝于[Root.GetRulerTitle]，无论你自己是否愿意。§!
entries.en: §EYou will serve the [Root.GetRulerTitle], whether you wish to or not.§!

entries.zh: §E我们要把你们整个消灭。§!
entries.en: §EAs one, we will destroy you.§!

entries.zh: §E尽管你们曾施下罪行，但我们原谅你们。§!
entries.en: §EDespite your past transgressions, we forgive you.§!

entries.zh: §E请不要打扰我们。§!
entries.en: §ELeave us in peace.§!

entries.zh: §E你不会真的期待我们会相信你们吧？§!
entries.en: §EDo you really expect us to trust you?§!

entries.zh: §E我们平等地与你们问好。§!
entries.en: §EWe greet you as equals.§!

entries.zh: §E很好。我们认识你们了。§!
entries.en: §EVery well. We are aware of you.§!

entries.zh: §E我们不会轻易忘记。我们永远不能原谅。§!
entries.en: §EWe have not forgotten. And we will not forgive.§!

entries.zh: 这什么意思？你是谁？你这个大骗子，毫无疑问。根本没有什么外星人！
entries.en: What is the meaning of this? Who are you? You deceive us, surely. Aliens do not exist!

entries.zh: 不可思议！星星上的来客？这还真是出乎意料。你们可让我们有些措手不及。
entries.en: Amazing! Visitors from the stars? Well, this is certainly unexpected. You've caught us at a bit of a disadvantage.

entries.zh: 来自另一颗星球的访客？我们一直认为外面一定还有其他的感性生命体存在，但即使是这样，此时此刻也是极具里程碑意义的！我们还不太清楚你们的习俗是什么样的。
entries.en: Visitors from another world? We always thought there must be other sentient beings out there, but even so this feels monumental! We're unsure what the custom is here.

entries.zh: 多年以来我们都等待机会进行接触。在这样一个广袤无垠、遍布奇迹的宇宙，我们坚信一定有如同我们一样的生命存在。
entries.en: For ages we have waited to make contact. In such a vast and wondrous galaxy, we knew there must be others like ourselves.

entries.zh: 终于！过了这么久你们终于决定揭示自己的存在了。你们已经观察我们的星球有好一段时间了，我没说错吧？
entries.en: So! At long last you've decided to reveal yourselves. You've been observing our world for some time, haven't you?

entries.zh: 啊，原来你在这！我们这么多年以来一直在等你方发起接触进程，实在等不及了，所以我们决定迈出第一步。那么现在该怎么办？
entries.en: Ah, there you are! We've been waiting for you to initiate contact for so long, we decided to make the first move. What happens now?

entries.zh: 入侵者们！我们不明白你们为什么要攻击我们，但我们会誓死保卫我们的殖民地！至死方休！
entries.en: Invaders! We don't know why you are attacking us, but know we will fight to defend our colony! We will not yield!

entries.zh: 欧，这就是你们的沟通方式吗？其实你们刚通过超空间航道进来的时候我们就已经一直在关注你们了，但一直没把它弄明白。坐着这种大铁盒子旅行危险不危险啊？\n\n我感觉我们有很多可以互相学习的，如果你们也是这么认为的那么欢迎光临啊。但如果你对我们的家园图谋不轨，我们可不会任人宰割。
entries.en: Oh, is this how you communicate? We have been watching you ever since you entered through the hyperlane but couldn't figure it out. Isn't it dangerous to travel in those metal boxes?\n\nIt seems like we could learn a lot from each other, so if that is your intention, feel free to stay. If you wish to claim our home, be aware that we are not helpless.

entries.zh: §E你好，朋友。§!
entries.en: §EGreetings, friends.§!

entries.zh: §E丑陋的东西……你的长相恶心到我们了。§!
entries.en: §EHideous creatures... Your visage sickens us.§!

entries.zh: §E愿神圣降于你们与你们的星球之上。§!
entries.en: §EDivine greetings upon you and your world.§!

entries.zh: §E你好，同志。§!
entries.en: §EGreetings, comrades.§!

entries.zh: §E我们即将给你们混乱不堪的生活方式带去秩序。稍等。§!
entries.en: §EWe will bring order to your chaotic existence. Stand by.§!

entries.zh: §E我们以和平之意前来。§!
entries.en: §EWe come in peace.§!

entries.zh: §E我们的相通点远超你们想象。§!
entries.en: §EWe are more alike than you realize.§!

entries.zh: §E你们真觉得自己是什么高等文明？妙啊。§!
entries.en: §EYou believe yourself an advanced civilization? How quaint.§!

entries.zh: §E我们为一。你们为众。§!
entries.en: §EWe are one. You are many.§!

entries.zh: §E我们为一。你们也为一。现在，世界为二。§!
entries.en: §EWe are one. You also are one. Now, there are two.§!

entries.zh: §E我们希望能够同你们建立互利互惠的关系。§!
entries.en: §EWe hope to build a profitable relationship with you.§!
