entries.en: Border Violation

entries.zh: 冒犯边境
entries.en: Border Violation

entries.zh: §Y[From.From.GetName]§!出现在我方的§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!恒星系内部是明显的攻击行为。若不立刻撤退我们就将兵戎相见。
entries.en: The presence of the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system constitutes a clear breach of our borders. We will be forced to consider this an act of war unless you withdraw immediately.

entries.zh: 我们侦测到§Y[From.From.GetName]§!进入了我方的§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!恒星系，直接冒犯了我方的领地。这是入侵的开端？还是贵国会立即撤离？
entries.en: We have detected the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system, in direct violation of our territory. Is this the prelude to an invasion, or will you withdraw from our space?

entries.zh: 朋友，你们的星图似乎已经过时了。我们侦测到§Y[From.From.GetName]§!在我方的§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!恒星系内。虽然我方不讨厌他们的存在，不过我们还是必须要求你们从我方领土上撤退。
entries.en: Your star charts appear to be out of date, friends. We have detected the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! traveling inside our borders in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. As much as we enjoy their company, we must ask you to withdraw your ships from our territory.

entries.zh: 我方传感器侦测到§Y[From.From.GetName]§!进入了§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!恒星系。他们是否需要援助？如果不是，请立即离开我方领域。
entries.en: Our sensors have picked up the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! inside the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. Do they require assistance in some way? If not, then we must ask you to evacuate them from our space.

entries.zh: 你方弱小的军团已突破了我方边界[From.GetName]。就在目前，§Y[From.From.GetName]§!也在我方§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系内窥视着我们的动向。你们真以为我们会无视这一重大违反星际协定的行为么？
entries.en: Your cowardly forces have breached the frontiers of the [From.GetName]. Even now, the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! is spying on us in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system which by right belongs to us. Did you think we wouldn't notice this flagrant violation of interstellar law?

entries.zh: 你方军队蓄意闯入我方控制§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。我方完全有权对你方宣战，不过为了维护星系的和平，我方决定给予你方最后一次机会：立刻将§Y[From.From.GetName]§!撤出我方领地。
entries.en: Your forces have deliberately violated our borders in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. By all rights we should already be at war, but in the interest of fostering galactic peace, our government has decided to give you one last chance to withdraw the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! from our space.

entries.zh: 侦测到§Y[From.From.GetName]§!出现在§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。正如贵方所知道的那样，该星球在我方领域之内，所以我们郑重地要你们将该毁灭性设备从我方领域内移除。
entries.en: We have detected the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. As you know, this star lies within our borders, and so we must respectfully ask that you remove your implements of destruction from our space.

entries.zh: 朋友，贵方的§Y[From.From.GetName]§!已进入我方§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。也许，是导航出错了？请告知他们的航向错误，以保证其安全返航。
entries.en: Friends, I fear the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! has ventured into our space in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. A navigation error, perhaps? Please inform them of their mistake so they can return home safely.

entries.zh: 我方侦测器侦测到§Y[From.From.GetName]§!出现在§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。我们不希望看到你们肮脏的飞船出现在我方领域。我方要求你们立即撤离！
entries.en: Our sensors have picked up the §Y[From.From.GetName]§! in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. We do not want your vile warships loitering within our space. Our government demands their immediate removal!

entries.zh: 立即将你们原始的飞船驶离§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系，否则我们就将其击沉。这是第一次也是最后一次警告。
entries.en: Remove your primitive ships from the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system, or you will not see them again. We will not ask a second time.

entries.zh: 你们的飞船，请立即驶离§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!。
entries.en: Your ships. Remove them from §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们要求你们立即将你们的小船驶离§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。当然，这是为了你们飞船的自身安全着想。
entries.en: We must ask you to remove your little ships from the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system. For their own safety, of course.

entries.zh: 马上带着你们那可怜的小破船离开§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系。
entries.en: You will remove your pathetic starships from the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system at once.

entries.zh: 你们驶进§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系的飞船对我方宙域产生了影响。请立即离开。
entries.en: Your ships in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! system are interfering with our plans for this region of the galaxy. Remove them at once!

entries.zh: 这是我方的领地。弥漫在§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!周围的臭气必须马上驱散。
entries.en: It is in our space. The smell is overpowering in §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!. It must withdraw.

entries.zh: 很好。不要再次逾矩。
entries.en: Good. Do not repeat this violation.

entries.zh: 请立即离开我们的星系。
entries.en: Then please depart from our system at once.

entries.zh: 感谢能恰当地解决此事。
entries.en: Thank you for promptly resolving this matter.

entries.zh: 就让我们都忘了这次不愉快吧。
entries.en: Then let us forget this incident ever happened.

entries.zh: 对啦，快滚回[Root.Capital.GetName]去！
entries.en: Yes, run back to [Root.Capital.GetName]!

entries.zh: 走就对了，不过可不要以为我们会忘记你们这次无理。
entries.en: Good. Do not think we will forget this transgression, however.

entries.zh: 非常好，我就知道我们能达成协议。
entries.en: Excellent. I knew we could reach an accord.

entries.zh: 好极啦，祝他们一帆风顺。
entries.en: Excellent. Then I bid them a safe journey!

entries.zh: 好哇，看来你们也不是完全没救。
entries.en: Good. Perhaps there is hope for you yet.

entries.zh: 你很乖，孩子。
entries.en: You do well to obey, child.

entries.zh: 好。
entries.en: Good.

entries.zh: 令人叹服！
entries.en: Splendid!

entries.zh: 通讯终止。
entries.en: End transmission.

entries.zh: 那这事就这么算了。
entries.en: The matter has been settled then.

entries.zh: 它遵从了，很好。
entries.en: It complies. Good.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesName]将誓死保卫自己的国土直至最后一人！
entries.en: We will defend our space to the last [From.GetSpeciesName]!

entries.zh: 好像我们怕了似的。你们会为这个决定后悔的。
entries.en: It is as we feared then. You will come to regret this decision.

entries.zh: 还把你们当作是朋友……
entries.en: And to think we considered you our friends...

entries.zh: 做出这等不忠的行径……！我……你……简直不知道说什么好！
entries.en: Of all the betrayals...! I... you... words fail me...

entries.zh: 你们这些可怜的蠢货。历史将会记住这一天，因为从今天正是[Root.GetName]灭亡的开端。
entries.en: You poor fools. History will remember this day as the beginning of the end for the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们对你们[Root.GetSpeciesName]已经算是仁至义尽。现在我们就将你们从星系中抹除。
entries.en: No one can claim that we failed to show patience with your misbegotten kind, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Now we shall cleanse you from the stars!

entries.zh: 哎哟。
entries.en: Oh dear.

entries.zh: 什么？一定是有什么误会……是翻译机出了故障？这……这真是，朋友，根据这边显示器上的显示……贵国向我国宣战了！
entries.en: What? There must be some mistake... is the translator software working correctly?  You... you won't believe this, friends, but according to my screen you just declared war!

entries.zh: 唉……你们为什么就这么喜欢诉诸武力？
entries.en: Sigh... why must you be so quick to resort to violence?

entries.zh: 很遗憾你们在宇宙中所书写的历史已经走到了尽头。
entries.en: A pity that your time amongst the stars will be so brief.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 如今的宇宙居民真是太暴躁了！真是令人陶醉。等你们被平定下来以后我们要好好研究研究。
entries.en: The current generation of interstellar nations have proven remarkably aggressive! How fascinating. We must investigate this further after you have been pacified.

entries.zh: 又多了一个要消除的讨厌存在。
entries.en: Another nuisance to be eradicated.

entries.zh: 又一个必须克服的障碍！
entries.en: Yet another obstacle to overcome!

entries.zh: 试炼！这是给我们的试炼！最终，漫长的等待终于结束了。
entries.en: A test! It is here to test us! At last, the wait is over.

entries.zh: 我们这就撤兵。
entries.en: We will withdraw immediately.

entries.zh: 我们的军团还就不走了。（宣战）
entries.en: Our forces are there to stay. (DECLARE WAR)

entries.zh: 遭遇[primitive_civ.GetName]
entries.en: [primitive_civ.GetName] Encountered

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。探测器显示，该新石器时代文明已经掌握了火的使用并发展出了基本的口语，但我们还未发现任何金属冶炼和书面交流的迹象。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小村庄里，但还是出现了少数几个大城市。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, several large city-states have formed.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们已经进入了相当于铁器时代的阶段，并分化成了无数的零碎的王国和帝国。他们的物种遍布整个[primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]的地表。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into numerous petty kingdoms and empires. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们目前可视为处于中世纪晚期时代，不仅充分掌握了冶金学，还建立了一个封建社会。印刷机的出现加速了知识的传播。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and a feudal society. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们刚刚脱离中世纪时期，进入了一个相当于文艺复兴的时期。科学知识传播的非常迅速，他们各个稀碎的小王国里，军队都配备其了简陋的火药射击武器。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They currently seem to be experiencing the equivalent of a Renaissance, having recently left the Medieval Age behind them. Scientific knowledge is spreading rapidly and the armies of their petty kingdoms are equipped with crude gunpowder-based projectile weapons.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们进入了早期蒸汽时代，有证据表明他们已经开始使用以蒸汽机为动力的交通工具和工厂。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have entered the early Steam Age, and there is clear evidence that they are beginning to make use of both vehicles and early factories powered by steam engines.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了前太空时代外星文明。他们进入了早期工业时代，电力和内燃机正在逐渐被推广使用。我们应该在上空建立一个§Y观测站§!，以便进一步研究他们。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a pre-space civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are in an early Industrial Age, with electricity and internal combustion engines gradually coming into widespread use.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了前太空时代外星文明。他们处于人口十分集中的机器时代，从轨道上可见的大气污染和光污染也证明了这一点。他们已经掌握了飞行技术，工厂也可以大批量生产商品。我们应该在上空建立一个§Y观测站§!，以便进一步研究他们。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Atmospheric contaminants and light pollution visible from orbit are consistent with a densely populated Machine Age society. They appear to have mastered air travel, and factories are mass-producing goods in their cities.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了前太空时代外星文明。有证据表明他们已经可以驾驭原子能，而且多个帝国可能已经拥有核武。突发性自我毁灭事件发生的概率非常之高。我们应该在上空建立一个§Y观测站§!，以便进一步研究他们。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many divided nation states. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!星系里的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上发现了外星文明。他们似乎处于太空时代的早期，因为许多原始的卫星正在围绕着这颗行星。行星上的诸多势力正在逐步形成一个全球化帝国。他们踏出星球并加入星系共同体只是时间早晚问题。\n\n我们应该在上空建立一个§Y观测站§!，以便进一步研究他们。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of an alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their nation states are on the path towards joining together in a global government, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。探测器显示，处于新石器时代的他们已经可以熟练地用火，并在各蜂巢之间发展出了一套口语系统用以互相交流，但至今未发现任何冶金和书面交流的迹象。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language to communicate between hives, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们似乎处于青铜器时代晚期，已经掌握了基础的金属加工技术。尽管他们大部分人生活在小聚落里，但少数几个大型蜂巢集体业已形成。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the later stages of a Bronze Age, having mastered early metalworking. Although most of their population is rural, multiple larger hive collectives have formed.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们已经发展到了相当于铁器时代的水平，分裂成了许多小型蜂巢及一些大型簇集。该物种已经遍布几乎整个[primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]的表面。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They have advanced into the equivalent of an Iron Age and are divided into many minor hives as well as a few larger clusters. Their species has spread across almost the entire surface of the [primitive_civ.Capital.GetPlanetMoon].\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔[GetPreFTLLower]前文明的存在。他们目前处于相当于中世纪晚期时代，不仅充分掌握了冶金学，还建立了大型的蜂巢社群。印刷术正在各蜂巢思维间加速知识传播、增进相互理解。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They are presently in what could be considered a Late Medieval Age, with a firm grasp of metallurgy and larger hive communities. The printing press is accelerating the spread of knowledge and understanding between the minds.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔前太空文明的存在。证据表明他们已经驯服了原子能，可能已经有众多的分支蜂巢殖民地拥有核武器。突发性自我毁灭事件发生的概率非常之高。\n\n我们应该在其星球上空建立一座§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt pre-space alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. There is evidence that they have harnessed the power of the atom, and nuclear weapons may be prolific among their many splintered hive colonies. The possibility of a sudden self-inflicted extinction event is high.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§!恒星系的§Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§!上探测到一个外星格式塔文明的存在。他们似乎处于太空时代的早期，因为目前有许多原始的卫星围绕这颗行星运动。当地的蜂巢思维正在逐步形成一个统一的意识。他们踏出星球并加入星海共同体只是时间早晚问题。\n\n我们应该在其上空建立一个§Y观测站§!，以便进一步观察研究。
entries.en: We have detected the presence of a gestalt alien civilization on §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetName]§! in the §Y[primitive_civ.Capital.GetStarName]§! system. They appear to be in the Early Space Age, as evidenced by the many primitive satellites orbiting their homeworld. Their local hiveminds are in the process of amalgamating into a unified consciousness, and it is likely only a matter of time before they venture beyond their world and join the galactic community.\n\nWe should consider building an §YObservation Post§! above their world to study them more closely.

entries.zh: 遭遇掠夺者
entries.en: Pirates Encountered

entries.zh: 在[From.From.From.GetName]的遭遇
entries.en: Encounter in [From.From.From.GetName]

entries.zh: 在[From.From.From.GetName]星系遭遇未知来源的飞船！这些奇怪的船被标记为§Y[From.GetName]§!，其余信息正待进一步调查。应做好应对，防止对方有敌意。
entries.en: We have encountered ships of an unknown origin in the [From.From.From.GetName] system! These strange vessels have been flagged as §Y[From.GetName]§! until we can learn more about them.\n\nWe should take precautions in the event that they are hostile.

entries.zh: 真是有趣。
entries.en: Interesting.

entries.zh: 通讯已建立
entries.en: Communications Established

entries.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与§Y[From.From.GetName]§!建立了联络。现在可以开启交流频道，所有的敌对行为都被终止了。
entries.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the §Y[From.From.GetName]§!. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities have been terminated.

entries.zh: 在成功的翻译了他们的语言之后，我们与§Y[From.From.GetName]§!建立了联络。开启交流频道之后，我们§Y发现§!他们是被我们遗弃的难民。所有的敌对行为都暂时被终止了。
entries.en: After successfully translating their language, we have established communications with the §Y[From.From.GetName]§!. As we open diplomatic channels we §Yrecognize§! them as the refugees we once abandoned. All hostilities have been terminated for now.

entries.zh: 棒极了。
entries.en: Excellent.

entries.zh: 通讯已建立
entries.en: Communications Established

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自§Y[From.GetName]§!的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。双方之间的外交频道已经打开，一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
entries.en: We are receiving a transmission from the §Y[From.GetName]§!! They appear to have successfully translated our language. Diplomatic channels are now open and all hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自§Y[From.GetName]§!的通讯！他们似乎已经成功翻译了我们的语言。随着他们开放了交流频道，我们可以将他们§Y认定§!为曾被我们抛弃的难民。双方的一切敌对行为已经暂时停止。
entries.en: We are receiving a transmission from the §H[From.GetName]§!! They appear to have successfully translated our language. As they open channels, we can §Yrecognize§! them as the refugees we once abandoned. Hostilities between us have ceased for the moment.

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自§Y[From.GetName]§!的通讯！他们似乎拥有一套我们无法理解的高级内部通讯系统，在我们星系中休眠的同时成功翻译了我们的语言。
entries.en: We are receiving a transmission from the §Y[From.GetName]§!! They appear to have an advanced system of internal communication that we could not discern, and have translated our language while lying dormant in our system.

entries.zh: 真是有趣。
entries.en: Interesting.

entries.zh: 怎么又是它们……
entries.en: Not them again...

entries.zh: 征服[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]文明
entries.en: Subjugating [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]

entries.zh: 我方军团已成功进入§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!并完成对原始文明的压制。当地居民已放弃一切抵抗，我们已将其文明收入我们帝国管制之下。考虑到其落后的科技水平，要将其转变为[Root.GetAdj]可用的生产力还需要一些时间。
entries.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the primitive forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. The locals have given up all attempts at fighting back and we have now subsumed their civilization into our Empire although, backwards as they are, it may take some time for the natives to become fully productive members of [Root.GetAdj] society.

entries.zh: 我们的秩序维持者们成功地镇压了§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族。当[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]意识到我们只想为它们服务时，它们无奈停止了其古怪的抵抗。目前它们正在被送往特别设计的居住站，我们将确保它们丰衣足食。不幸的是，它们发育不全的头脑可能需要花一点时间，才能适应摆脱自我决定之苦的生活。
entries.en: Our peacekeeping enforcers have successfully pacified the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. The [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were coerced into ceasing their quaint attempts at resistance when they realized we only desire to serve them. They are currently being transported into specially designed habitats, where we will ensure they want for nothing. Unfortunately, it may take some time before their underdeveloped minds acclimatize to being freed from the burden of self-determination.

entries.zh: §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的原始有机体已被我们的登陆军团制服。尽管其低下的战斗力是不发达社会的表现，我们的生物分析机器人仍然认为其神经系统能力仍具有潜力。它们将被同化。
entries.en: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subjugated by our landing forces. Though their feeble combat capabilities are indicators of an undeveloped society, our bio-analyst bots have concluded that their neural capacities show promise. They will be assimilated.

entries.zh: 我们的猎杀者单元毫不费力便撕碎了§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的有机土著建立起来的那点可怜的防线。任何幸存的样本都将被进行了系统性灭除，以确保它们不会进化出对星系造成有机污染的物种。
entries.en: Our Hunter-Killer units have effortlessly trampled the pitiful defenses mounted by the primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. Any remaining specimens are being systematically annihilated, so that they will never evolve to threaten the galaxy with their organic agenda.

entries.zh: §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何残余的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]都将根据所制定的有机种族管理协议进行根除。
entries.en: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any remaining [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] will be removed in accordance with established bio-species management protocols.

entries.zh: §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的原始有机体在对我们的登陆行动进行了一番非常无效的抵抗后被征服了。任何幸存的样本都将被并入[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]能源网。
entries.en: The primitive organics on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§! have been subdued after mounting a grossly insufficient attempt at resisting our landing incursion. Any surviving specimens will be amalgamated into the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] energy grid.

entries.zh: 原始的[conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]那种支离破碎的思想无法在§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!抗衡我们团结一致的陆军，整个地表都已完全占领。剩下的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]对我们毫无用处，会根据[GetGestaltEntityName]的意志从这颗星球上抹除。
entries.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!, and the surface has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] are of no use to us, and will be expunged from the planet, as the [GetGestaltEntityName] wills.

entries.zh: [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural]原始而一盘散沙的思维在§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!敌不过我们团结的登陆军团，行星表面已经被我们控制。剩余的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]种族将被用作家畜供养我们的[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]。
entries.en: The fragmented minds of the primitive [conquered_primitive_species.GetNamePlural] were no match for our unified landing forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!, and the planet has now been secured. The remaining [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] will be used as livestock to feed our [Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们的军团成功地入侵并战胜了§Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!上的[GetPreFTLLower]部队。当地种族明智地决定臣服于我们，而我们则开始按政策对其进行净化，以为[Root.GetAdj]的产业腾出地块。
entries.en: Our armies have successfully invaded and subdued the [GetPreFTLLower] forces on §Y[conquered_primitive_world.GetName]§!. The locals have wisely elected to succumb to our rule, and we have now begun to purge them from the planet as per policy, in order to prime the terrain for [Root.GetAdj] industry.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国壮大了。
entries.en: Our Empire grows.

entries.zh: 异星人不是我们的对手！
entries.en: The xenos are no match for us!

entries.zh: 在他们看来，我们的武器一定就像是魔法……
entries.en: To them our weapons must appear like magic...

entries.zh: 我们神圣的政体闪耀出真理。
entries.en: Our divine right shines true.

entries.zh: 他们在我们的统治下能更好地进化。
entries.en: Their evolution will benefit from our control.

entries.zh: 它们将成为美妙的活体陈设！
entries.en: They shall make lovely bio-trophies!

entries.zh: 开始身份升华。
entries.en: Commence identity sublimation.

entries.zh: 开始武器测试……
entries.en: Commencing weapons testing...

entries.zh: 收到。
entries.en: Received.

entries.zh: 将§Y星际文化冲击§!的修正添加到§H[From.From.From.GetName]§!上，在未来几年之内巨幅减少该星球的产出并降低其稳定度。
entries.en: §YStellar Culture Shock§! modifier added to §H[From.From.From.GetName]§!, drastically reducing output and reducing stability for several years to come.

entries.zh: 在§Y[From.From.From.GetName]§!星系遭遇了外星飞船！在我们调查清楚之前，这些奇怪的飞行物被标为§Y[From.GetName]§!。有必要谨慎应对……
entries.en: We have encountered some form of alien vessels in the §Y[From.From.From.GetName]§! System! These strange objects have been flagged as §Y[From.GetName]§! until we can learn more about them.\n\nWe should proceed with caution...

entries.zh: 在§Y[From.GetName]§!星系遭遇了外星飞船！在我们调查清楚之前，这些奇怪的飞行物被标为§Y[target_enclave.GetName]§!。\n\n有必要谨慎应对……
entries.en: We have encountered some form of alien vessels in the §Y[From.GetName]§! System! These strange objects have been flagged as §Y[target_enclave.GetName]§! until we can learn more about them.\n\nWe should proceed with caution...

entries.zh: 法令生效
entries.en: The Law Comes into Effect

entries.zh: 人工智能，不论何种型号设计，在[Root.GetName]境内都是不合法的。有关部门已经将任何违反该法令的机器人单位进行了拆解。相关的机器人组装工厂也被重新整改为只能生产无思考回路的机器人。
entries.en: Artificial intelligence, in any shape or form, has been declared illegal throughout the [Root.GetName], and the authorities have started dismantling all robotic units that are in violation of this law.\n\nThe Robotic Assembly Plants responsible for producing these units are also being re-tooled to manufacture simpler, non-thinking robots.

entries.zh: 好，必须尽快处理掉这些令人憎恶的东西。
entries.en: Good. We must rid ourselves of these abominations.

entries.zh: 所有的智能人和合成人必须被清除。\n\n智能人和合成人组装工厂转变为机器人组装工厂。
entries.en: All Droid and Synthetic Pops are being purged.\nSynthetic and Droid Assembly Plants are converted to Robotics Assembly Plants

entries.zh: [LastKilledCountryName]的末日
entries.en: End of the [LastKilledCountryName]

entries.zh: 被称为§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!的帝国在敌人的进攻之下已经灭亡。这会怎样影响星系的政治环境还有待观察。
entries.en: The star nation formerly known as the §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has been destroyed by its enemies. How this will affect the political climate of the galaxy remains to be seen.

entries.zh: $action.62.name$
entries.en: $action.62.name$

entries.zh: 远古的先驱帝国§H[LastKilledCountryName]§!终于败在了敌人手中。这个曾经伟大的帝国之陨落将产生什么样的后果仍然不得而知。
entries.en: The ancient precursor state of §H[LastKilledCountryName]§! has met its final demise at the hands of its enemies. What the fall of this once great empire will mean for galactic politics remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 合成领袖已损坏
entries.en: Synth Leader Out of Commission

entries.zh: [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName]的船员报告称科学专员[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，导致[malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer]彻底无法行动。
entries.en: The crew of the [malfunctioning_leader_fleet.GetName] reports that Science Officer [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction, rendering [malfunctioning_leader.GetHimHer] permanently inoperable.

entries.zh: $action.71.name$
entries.en: $action.71.name$

entries.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
entries.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

entries.zh: $action.71.name$
entries.en: $action.71.name$

entries.zh: $action.71.name$
entries.en: $action.71.name$

entries.zh: 科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]在长期暴露在高度辐射性的地质样本下后发生了致命故障，因其内部辐射计数器损坏而未能察觉。
entries.en: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.

entries.zh: $action.71.name$
entries.en: $action.71.name$

entries.zh: 指挥官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]因制造缺陷而发生了致命故障。
entries.en: Commander [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a terminal malfunction due to a manufacturing error.

entries.zh: $action.71.name$
entries.en: $action.71.name$

entries.zh: 总督[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障——彻底失灵——原因是在例行维护中安装了损坏的固件。
entries.en: Governor [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction - "bricking" - following the unfortunate installation of corrupt firmware during routine maintenance.

entries.zh: 战胜§H[From.GetName]§!
entries.en: Victory against the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我方战胜§H[From.GetName]§!
entries.en: We have won the war against the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
entries.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.

entries.zh: 真是最好的结果。
entries.en: The best possible outcome.

entries.zh: 败给§H[From.GetName]§!
entries.en: Defeated by the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我们败给了§H[From.GetName]§!
entries.en: We have lost the war against the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 战争结束了。我方大获全胜！
entries.en: This war is over. We are victorious.

entries.zh: 真是最糟糕的结果。
entries.en: The worst possible outcome.

entries.zh: 谢谢您？
entries.en: Thank you?

entries.zh: 与§H[From.GetName]§!通过维持现状结束战争
entries.en: Status Quo Peace with the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我们与§H[From.GetName]§!签署了无条件和平协议！
entries.en: We have signed a white peace in the war against the §H[From.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 战争结束了。没有胜败。
entries.en: This war is over. There can be no victor this time.

entries.zh: 就暂且接受现状。
entries.en: We will accept this for now.

entries.zh: 不管公正与否，你方的确击败了我们。拿走你们的战利品吧，我们必定会卷土重来！
entries.en: Whether by honorable or dishonorable means, you have defeated us in combat. Claim your spoils and rue the day of our return.

entries.zh: 我们似乎低估了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的实力。不过放心，以后不会了。
entries.en: We appear to have underestimated your net value, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Rest assured, it will not happen again.

entries.zh: 你们长久的威胁使得我们被迫让步。希望我们今后不会再卷入这类纷争。
entries.en: Your constant terror has forced us to concede. May our enterprises never be plagued by a conflict like this again.

entries.zh: 我们认输，但别想太多，这只不过是[This.GetName]暂时性的挫折。
entries.en: We admit defeat, but do not think this is anything more than a temporary setback for the [This.GetName].

entries.zh: 为了避免无辜的牺牲，我们被迫结束这起冲突。但若再次进犯，我们将集结全星海的力量与你对抗。
entries.en: We have been forced to end this conflict to spare innocent lives, but continue on this path and we will unite the galaxy against you.

entries.zh: 我们被迫投降，但别以为我们会忘记你们是如何残忍杀害[This.GetSpeciesAdj]生命的！我们早就知道你们是这种人。
entries.en: We are forced to surrender, but don't think we will forget how callously you took [This.GetSpeciesAdj] lives! This is exactly what we expected from your kind.

entries.zh: [This.GetName]达成了一致，我们必须让步。你为限制我们成长的努力暂时而言是成功的。
entries.en: The [This.GetName] is unanimous. We must concede. Your effort to limit our growth has proven successful for the time being.

entries.zh: 我们别无选择，只能遵守你的命令。你为什么要这样对待我们？我们只想与你们共享此星系。
entries.en: We have no choice but to give into your demands. Why do you do this to us? We only want to share this galaxy with you.

entries.zh: 你们的胜利只是对我们信念的又一次考验。最终，心诚者将笑到最后。
entries.en: Your victory is only yet another test of our faith. In the end, the true believers will prevail.

entries.zh: 无论你们如何索取，我们都将成千上万倍地讨回来。等你们被烧成灰烬时，任何取得的胜利都将毫无意义。
entries.en: Whatever you claim, we will reclaim thousandfold. Your victory will mean nothing when you have been reduced to ash.

entries.zh: 我们的军团即将撤退，同时停止针对[Root.GetName]的行动。
entries.en: We are withdrawing our troops and ceasing military operations targeting the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们觉得[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]瘦弱，这一结论显然下早了。我们愿为自己的行为付出代价并接受你们的要求。
entries.en: Our assumptions about [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] weakness may have been hasty. As a token of our new experience, we accept your demands.

entries.zh: 我们已经受够了这场战争。拿走你想要的东西离开吧。
entries.en: We have had enough of this war. Take what you will and be on your way.

entries.zh: 你们已经展示了你们的强大，但不要错误地将其等同于智力上的胜利。
entries.en: You may have shown your military power superior, but don't mistake this for an intellectual victory.

entries.zh: 你们已经聆听了宇宙渴望和平的呐喊。为了结束无意义的冲突，我们马上退兵。
entries.en: We have heard the pain of the cosmos crying out against this conflict. To stop the senseless dissonance, we surrender immediately.

entries.zh: 为了全体[This.GetName]的利益，我们必须低头。希望你们可以对我们宽宏大量，假如胜利者是我们，你们也会希望我们这样做的。
entries.en: For the good of all of [This.GetName], we must yield. Show the same magnanimous mercy you'd expect from us.

entries.zh: 我们必须让步，但请记住我们的警告。如果你们执意沿着这条道路走下去，天知道未来迎接你们的将是什么。
entries.en: We must back down, but heed our warning. You cannot fathom what the future has in store for you if you continue down this path.

entries.zh: 你竟敢对拉你出苦海的圣手反咬一口？现在你们拒绝了我们的智慧，总有一天你们的后代会谴责这一愚蠢举动。
entries.en: You bite the hand that reaches out to save you from destruction. One day, your descendants will decry that you rejected our wisdom.

entries.zh: 年轻气盛的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]！你们怎敢宣称战胜了我们？
entries.en: Precocious [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]-[Root.GetSpeciesSpawnNamePlural]! How dare you claim victory over us?

entries.zh: 眼下我们决定退一步进行观望。尽量不要对未来的工作带来太大的破坏。
entries.en: The time has come for us to take a step back and watch. Try not to cause too much destruction in your future endeavors.

entries.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
entries.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

entries.zh: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$
entries.en: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$

entries.zh: 金属。
entries.en: Metal.

entries.zh: 不。这一切都不该是这样的。这种混乱。我们到底怎么了？
entries.en: No. No this is not how this is supposed to go. The confusion. What is wrong with us?

entries.zh: 啊……一个值得较量的对手……
entries.en: Finally. A worthy opponent...

entries.zh: 乖乖呆在我们的[From.GetHandName]中，你们本可以成就更多。如果你们能明白就好了，我们想要的只是完善这个星系。
entries.en: Under our [From.GetHandName] you could have been so much more. If only you would see, all we want is to perfect the galaxy.

entries.zh: 不！不，你们不能夺走我们的食物。工蜂们会饿死的！把它还给我们……
entries.en: No! No you can't take our food. The drones will starve! Give it back...

entries.zh: 我们按照[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的传统光明正大地战胜了你们。制定条约是我们的特权与职责。
entries.en: We have defeated you in noble combat as per the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] traditions. We have the privilege and obligation to dictate the terms.

entries.zh: 你们讨价还价的本领很厉害，但最终还是我们技高一筹。不要低估资金雄厚的军团在市场中的价值。
entries.en: You drove a hard bargain, but we outbid you in the end. Don't underestimate the strength of a well-funded army in an unregulated market.

entries.zh: 我们终于可以将这次冲突抛到脑后了。希望这让你们明白了战争的代价。
entries.en: Finally, we can put this conflict behind us. We hope this has taught you the cost of war.

entries.zh: 最终，脆弱的[Root.GetName]被迫就范。这只是我们争夺星系主导地位的又一块垫脚石。
entries.en: At last the frail [Root.GetName] has been brought to heel. Just another stepping stone on our road to galactic supremacy.

entries.zh: 我们双方都为这场战争付出了高昂的代价，但希望你们明白不要再招惹[This.GetName]或其盟友了。
entries.en: We have both paid a high price for this war, but hopefully you will have learned not to threaten the [This.GetName] or its allies.

entries.zh: 我们已经除掉了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的威胁！我们的边境重归安宁，[This.GetSpeciesAdj]的未来又一次得以保障。
entries.en: We have driven out the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] menace! Our borders and the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] future are once again secure.

entries.zh: 从你们的角度来说，这场战争完全是徒劳的。任凭谁都无法抵御[This.GetName]的扩张。
entries.en: This war was always a futile effort on your behalf. None can stand against the expansion of the [This.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们提出的要求已经很仁慈了，你们不应该对[This.GetSpeciesAdj]怀恨在心。
entries.en: We have been lenient in our demands only so that you may not carry resentment against the [This.GetSpeciesAdj] people in your hearts.

entries.zh: 异教徒，跪下！你们发动了预言中的战争，并为你们的愚蠢付出了代价。
entries.en: Kneel, heathen! You have done battle with the heralds of divine providence and paid the price for your foolishness.

entries.zh: 不要以为这样就结束了。只要星系中还存在着[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，就不可能有真正的和平。
entries.en: Do not think this is the end. As long as there are [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] in the galaxy, there can be no true peace.

entries.zh: 为了解放[Root.GetAdj]的人民，我们采取了必要的措施。不要再妨碍我们正义的事业了。
entries.en: We have taken the necessary steps to bring freedom to the [Root.GetAdj] people. Don't stand in the way of our noble cause again.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]，你应该清楚自己的位置。你们注定要服侍我们，而不是与我们作对。
entries.en: You should have known your place, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]. Your people were meant to serve us, not to fight us.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]，现在你后悔妨碍[This.GetName]了吗？我们对挑战我们的统治的敌人绝不手软。
entries.en: Do you regret interfering with the [This.GetName] now, [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]? We are not lenient with those who upset our rule.

entries.zh: 今天，理智战胜了愚昧。继续在黑暗中跌跌撞撞吧，你们还将被开化的民族击败更多次。
entries.en: Today, reason triumphs over ignorance. Continue to stumble around in the dark, and you will suffer more defeats against enlightened people.

entries.zh: 通过这场胜利，我们成功了守护和平与和谐。我们不指望你能理解。
entries.en: Through this victory, we have sought to restore balance and harmony. We wouldn't expect you to understand.

entries.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民欢庆今天的胜利。我们和平的社会绝不会再次受到[Root.GetName]阴谋诡计的威胁。
entries.en: The [This.GetAdj] people rejoice on this day of victory. Never again shall our peaceful society be threatened by the malicious plans of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 今天，[Root.GetAdj]不敬者受到了正义的制裁。我们神圣的任务得以履行。
entries.en: Justice has been delivered upon the [Root.GetAdj] desecrators on this day. Our hallowed duties have been fulfilled.

entries.zh: 心存侥幸吧。败在我们手里总好过在死亡的路上一去不复返。
entries.en: Consider yourselves fortunate. Defeat at our hands is vastly preferable to continuing down the path to destruction.

entries.zh: 正如你们早就明白飞船不要离闪耀的恒星太近，现在你们明白了不要惹[This.GetName]。
entries.en: Just as you learned not to fly your ships too close to a brightly burning star, you have now learned not to disturb the [This.GetName].

entries.zh: 虽然挑选与消灭部分人口花费了一些精力，不过[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人口暂时不会在对星系的生态系统产生不良影响了。
entries.en: It took some prudent culling, but the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] population should not threaten the galactic ecosystem for a while now.

entries.zh: 惩罚进程完成。自卫协议终止。处罚协议启动。
entries.en: Punishment process complete. Self-defense protocols ended. Punitive protocols initiated.

entries.zh: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$
entries.en: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$

entries.zh: 摧毁。
entries.en: Demolish.

entries.zh: 我们只需派出一个就足以击败你们零散的抵抗。别再试探我们了。
entries.en: It would only have taken one of us to defeat your splintered resistance. Do not test us again.

entries.zh: 够了，你们还未领悟战争的真谛。拿着这些资源，下次再好好打一场。
entries.en: That is enough, you have yet to learn the true meaning of War. Take these resources and put up a better fight next time.

entries.zh: 听好了，晚辈。我们回来可不是为了容忍这种愚蠢行为。
entries.en: Now listen to your elders. We did not return to suffer this foolishness.

entries.zh: 给工蜂更多资源。给星球更多资源。更多。更多。更多。更——
entries.en: More material for the drones. More material for the worlds. More. More. More. Mo-

entries.zh: 没有明确获胜方的战争是可耻的悲剧，但有时确实无法避免。我们改日战场上再见吧。
entries.en: A war without a clear winner is a tragic and shameful sight, but sometimes unavoidable. Let us fight again another day.

entries.zh: 我们同意以当前边界为标准终止这次冲突。
entries.en: We will agree to end this conflict as the borders currently stand.

entries.zh: 帝国恢复正常，和平的历史继续进展，这对我们各自都有好处。
entries.en: A return to the normal state of things and resumption of peacetime activities would be best for all parties.

entries.zh: 鉴于目前的情况，我们应该立刻结束这次冲突。与其深陷这次冲突的泥潭不能自拔，[This.GetName]倒不如找些有意义的事来做。
entries.en: The circumstances dictate that we put an end to this war. The [This.GetName] has better things to do than pursue this conflict indefinitely.

entries.zh: 我们希望，停止敌对可以使[Root.GetName]和[This.GetName]开启全新的外交对话。
entries.en: We hope ceasing hostilities will open up for new diplomatic dialogue between the [Root.GetName] and the [This.GetName].

entries.zh: 尽管我们不愿意看到你们逃脱了惩罚，但我们同样也希望你们这些卑鄙的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]至少明白不要干涉我们的事务。
entries.en: As much as we hate to see you escape unpunished, we hope you miserable [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] have at least learned to stay out of our business.

entries.zh: [This.GetName]需要时间恢复。我们同意在此结束战争。
entries.en: The [This.GetName] needs time to recuperate. We have agreed to end our conflict here.

entries.zh: 由于双方都无心进一步索取，我们希望创伤的治愈过程能够缩短。请不要因既成事实而对[This.GetSpeciesName]心存憎恨。
entries.en: With no further demands on either side, we hope that the healing process can be shortened. Do not resent the [This.GetSpeciesName] for what has been done.

entries.zh: 虽然我们没有贯彻正义，但我们只能终止战争。不过，神之惩罚终将降临到你们头上。
entries.en: We are forced to put an end to this without delivering proper justice, but you cannot escape the divine punishment that will befall you.

entries.zh: 这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。
entries.en: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 停战约定应该是[Root.GetAdj]打破枷锁、争取交流对话的第一步。
entries.en: Negotiating a truce can be seen as the first step towards a diplomatic conversation about the liberties of the [Root.GetAdj] people.

entries.zh: 懒惰的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，就算拿来当苦力也没什么用。看来议和是最好的选项了。
entries.en: Lazy [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wouldn't be any good to us even as slaves. Peace might be the best option after all.

entries.zh: 乏味的战争，乏味的结局。我们还是各自去拥抱生命中更加美好的东西吧。
entries.en: A thoroughly dull ending to a thoroughly dull war. Let us return to the better things in life.

entries.zh: 考虑到目前状况，双方都不再进一步退让，就此结束冲突是最为合理的行为了。
entries.en: Ending the war now with no further concessions on either side is the most rational course of action, judging by its current state.

entries.zh: 如果双方再互相攻击，就会造成无法调节的失衡。若签订和平条约，则可保持精神上的长久均衡。
entries.en: If you would try to further take from us, or we from you, an imbalance would be created that cannot be corrected. A peace deal ensures continued spiritual equilibrium.

entries.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民同意结束这场战争，立即生效。
entries.en: The [This.GetAdj] people has agreed to bring an end to this war, effective immediately.

entries.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。
entries.en: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.

entries.zh: 我们不会再继续向你要求什么了，但我们恳求你，请考虑一下我们的智慧，再想想如果忽略了我们的智慧会有何等的后果。
entries.en: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.

entries.zh: 你们活该被碾碎，但这并不值得我们浪费宝贵的时间。看来议和是无法避免的了。
entries.en: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.

entries.zh: 我们已深陷战争泥潭。就让我们当做什么都没发生过吧，同样也希望这样的事情以后也永远不会发生。
entries.en: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.

entries.zh: 惩罚进程中断。自卫协议终止。
entries.en: Punishment process interrupted. Self-defense protocols ended.

entries.zh: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$
entries.en: $01_BERSERK_MACHINE_EMPIRE_ERROR$

entries.zh: 不真实。
entries.en: Untrue.

entries.zh: 是的。我们要回归常态。变化……变化并非好事。我们可不想打破平衡
entries.en: Yes. We shall return to the normal. Change... Change is not good. We wouldn't want to disturb the Balance.

entries.zh: 令人印象深刻。若是在我们的时代，你们一定会有出色的表现。也许你们能守住沙拉什，而不像其他人那样失败。我们改日再战！
entries.en: Impressive. You would have done well back in our time. Perhaps you could have defended Shallash where others failed. We must do this again sometime!

entries.zh: 我们没有时间可以和你们过家家，星系需要我们的引导。不要再来碍我们的事了。
entries.en: We have no more time to waste on you, the galaxy calls for our guidance. Don't get in our way again.

entries.zh: 没时间再跟你们浪费了，星系需要我们的指引。别再挡我们的道。
entries.en: Yes, we have fed enough here. There are more well stocked larders out in the galaxy. We won't - can't starve.

entries.zh: 重整队伍
entries.en: Regroup

entries.zh: 当你把舰队派往敌方新的领土内时，§Y[From.GetName]§!战争就发生了。
entries.en: The §Y[From.GetName]§! began while you had fleets inside your new enemies' borders.

entries.zh: [From.GetNumPlayerFleetsGoneMIA]舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。
entries.en: [From.GetNumPlayerFleetsGoneMIA] fleets have gone §RMissing In Action§! so that they can regroup inside friendly territory.

entries.zh: 一支舰队在任务中失踪，他们会在友军领地内重新集合。
entries.en: A fleet has gone Missing In Action so that it can regroup inside friendly territory.

entries.zh: [From.GetNumPlayerWormholeStationsDestroyed]虫洞站已被摧毁。
entries.en: [From.GetNumPlayerWormholeStationsDestroyed] Wormhole stations have been destroyed.

entries.zh: 一个虫洞站已被摧毁。
entries.en: A Wormhole station has been destroyed.

entries.zh: 坠毁的飞船
entries.en: Crashed Ship

entries.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
entries.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

entries.zh: 未知起源
entries.en: Unknown Origin

entries.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
entries.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

entries.zh: 覆盖着残骸
entries.en: Covered in Debris

entries.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
entries.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

entries.zh: 能量辐射
entries.en: Energy Emissions

entries.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
entries.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

entries.zh: 对接舱
entries.en: Docking Hatch

entries.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
entries.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

entries.zh: 小行星碰撞
entries.en: Asteroid Collision

entries.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
entries.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

entries.zh: 废弃空间站
entries.en: Abandoned Station

entries.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
entries.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

entries.zh: 生命迹象
entries.en: Life Signs

entries.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
entries.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

entries.zh: 大气层中的物体
entries.en: Atmospheric Object

entries.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
entries.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

entries.zh: 潜力巨大的卫星
entries.en: Promising Moon

entries.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
entries.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

entries.zh: 生命迹象
entries.en: Life Signs

entries.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部检测到了生命迹象。这是否表明是有生物圈存在？
entries.en: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?

entries.zh: 大气风暴
entries.en: Atmospheric Storms

entries.zh: 可以看到这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中发生了大风暴。进行深入研究可能十分有价值。
entries.en: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.

entries.zh: 飞行器结构
entries.en: Aerostat Structures

entries.zh: 某种未知结构正漂浮在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中。似乎是用到了空气静力学的原理来维持漂浮。
entries.en: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.

entries.zh: 货舱
entries.en: Cargo Pod

entries.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
entries.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

entries.zh: 太空碎片
entries.en: Space Debris

entries.zh: 这颗气态巨行星周围存在大量碎片。大部分来自各种规格的失事星舰。
entries.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

entries.zh: 巨大撞击
entries.en: Massive Impact

entries.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
entries.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

entries.zh: 异常能源示数
entries.en: Unusual Energy Readings

entries.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
entries.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

entries.zh: 微弱的信号
entries.en: Weak Signal

entries.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
entries.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

entries.zh: 轨道小行星
entries.en: Asteroid in Orbit

entries.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
entries.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

entries.zh: 太阳帆
entries.en: Solar Sailer

entries.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
entries.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

entries.zh: 生命迹象
entries.en: Life Signs

entries.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
entries.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

entries.zh: 生命迹象
entries.en: Life Signs

entries.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
entries.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

entries.zh: 生命迹象
entries.en: Life Signs

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
entries.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

entries.zh: 空间站
entries.en: Space Station

entries.zh: 在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时，附近一艘小型空间站使用轨道推进器企图躲开我们的科研船，但未能得逞。他们为什么要躲呢？
entries.en: As this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] was surveyed, a small nearby space station used its orbital thrusters in a vain attempt to hide from our Science Ship. What are they hiding?

entries.zh: 战争迹象
entries.en: Signs of Battle

entries.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上存在着大量的飞船残骸。这有可能是某次大型舰队行动遗留下来的。
entries.en: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.

entries.zh: 远古船坞
entries.en: Ancient Shipyard

entries.zh: 此世界的上方静静地飘着一座远古轨道船坞。它在战争中严重受损，多个部位缺失。
entries.en: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.

entries.zh: 前人殖民的迹象
entries.en: Signs of Former Habitation

entries.zh: 这个寸草不生的世界似乎曾居住着的前太空时代文明。其城市的废墟还在该行星表面随处可见。
entries.en: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.

entries.zh: 地表文字
entries.en: Surface Writing

entries.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
entries.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

entries.zh: 地表信标
entries.en: Surface Beacon

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
entries.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

entries.zh: 成因奇怪的山脉
entries.en: Strange Mountain Formation

entries.zh: 我们在努力测绘这个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，结果在南半球发现了一条奇怪的山脉。它看上去不像是通过自然过程形成的。
entries.en: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.

entries.zh: 未知物体
entries.en: Unidentified Object

entries.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上一个小的矩形物体就像镜面一样反射各种探测射线。我们的探测器无法探测出其组成成分。
entries.en: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.

entries.zh: 气态巨行星信号
entries.en: Gas Giant Signal

entries.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
entries.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

entries.zh: 气态巨行星飞船
entries.en: Gas Giant Ship

entries.zh: 传感器显示，我们在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气内短暂探测到了一艘中型飞船。
entries.en: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.

entries.zh: 终结轨道
entries.en: Terminal Orbit

entries.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
entries.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

entries.zh: 先驱者的活动迹象
entries.en: Signs of Precursor Activity

entries.zh: 这颗小行星上有着古代先驱者文明活动的迹象。
entries.en: There are signs of activity by an ancient precursor civilization on this asteroid.

entries.en: Vultaumar Prime

entries.zh: 远古时期沃陶姆的母星。昔日辉煌尚可见一斑。
entries.en: The ancient homeworld of the Vultaum homeworld. It has seen better days.

entries.zh: 大尤特安星
entries.en: Yuhtaan Majoris

entries.zh: 此世界曾经是古代尤特族的首都，曾经生生不息的繁华世界如今已经变成阴森恐怖的不毛之地。
entries.en: This world, which served as the capital of the ancient Yuht Empire, once supported life. No longer.

entries.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽
entries.en: Fen Habbanis

entries.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽III，或古时候居民简称的“芬-哈本尼斯”，曾经是第一联盟的首都。
entries.en: Fen Habbanis III, or simply "Fen Habbanis" as it was known to its ancient inhabitants, was the capital of the First League.

entries.zh: 伊拉西亚
entries.en: Irassia

entries.zh: 无论这个世界的生物圈里面生活着什么，现在一切都已经逝去了。
entries.en: Whatever biosphere this world may have once supported is long gone.

entries.zh: 赛博勒克斯-环形世界
entries.en: Cybrex Ring World

entries.zh: 一个被完全摧毁的环形世界——赛博勒克斯文明的最后一站。
entries.en: A thoroughly savaged ring world - the last retreat of the Cybrex civilization.

entries.zh: 粪化石小行星
entries.en: Coprolite Asteroid

entries.zh: 虽然这个真相让人有些难以接受，但所有的证据都表明[From.GetName]这颗小行星是一颗粪化石小行星——也就是某种巨大生命体的粪便化石形成的行星。其存在时间大概已经有十亿年了，因此化石的原成分也逐渐积淀成了矿藏。我们的科学家十分困惑究竟是什么样的生物才能留下这样的庞然大物。
entries.en: Although it is difficult to accept, all indications point towards asteroid [From.GetName] being a coprolite - a piece of fossilized feces from some kind of massive life form. It appears to be almost a billion years old, and much of the fossil's original organic composition has been replaced by mineral deposits. Our scientists are baffled as to what kind of creature could have produced something like this.

entries.zh: 海盗宝藏
entries.en: Pirate Treasure

entries.zh: 大约在一千年前，有一群外星海盗断断续续地将这颗小行星当做基地。我们进入该基地后，找到了当时被遗弃宝箱。其中主要是各种偷来的珠宝和文物，其中一些看起来还相当有价值。
entries.en: This asteroid appears to have been used intermittently as a base by a band of alien pirates roughly one thousand years ago. By entering the base, we managed to recover their abandoned treasure hoard. It consisted largely of stolen trinkets and artifacts, but some of it still appears to be of value.

entries.zh: 这些不义之财应该为我们所用。
entries.en: These ill-gotten gains shall serve us well.

entries.zh: 小行星动物群
entries.en: Asteroid Fauna

entries.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]时，[Root.GetName]的船员惊讶地发现小行星内部竟然出现了生命的迹象。某种穴居虫类无机体生命居住在被暗道遍布的岩石之中。这种独特的生命体似乎已经适应了太空的严寒。
entries.en: Amazingly, while conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] picked up several life signs coming from within the asteroid. There appears to be a colony of large burrowing worm-like lithovores within the rock, which has been riddled with tunnels. These unique life forms have somehow adapted to a life in the coldness of space.

entries.zh: 应该好好研究一下这些生物。
entries.en: These creatures should be studied.

entries.zh: 它们和我们一样！
entries.en: They are like us!

entries.zh: 小行星化石
entries.en: Asteroid Fossils

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]没有大气圈的地表之上，我们发现了几种似乎是水生生物的化石。有证据表明，这一圈环绕的小行星带是一颗破碎的行星形成的，因此化石的发现也证实了这一理论。从这些化石不难发现，这颗行星上曾有生命存在，而且也有水的存在。
entries.en: Fossils from what appears to be several species of aquatic animals have been found on the barren and airless surface of [From.GetName]. There are indications that the surrounding asteroid belt was created from the remains of a shattered planet, and these findings seem to confirm that theory. Judging by the fossils, the planet supported life and was at least partially covered by water.

entries.zh: 真遗憾他们没能继续进化下去。
entries.en: Unfortunate that they couldn't evolve further.

entries.zh: 废弃船厂
entries.en: Derelict Shipyard

entries.zh: [From.GetName]小行星内部的大部分都被挖空，用于建造疑似是船坞的工程，然而该工程早已被遗弃，数个世纪以来，一直暴露在宇宙的真空之中。就算里面曾有一些有价值的东西遗留，也早已被之前的探索者掠夺一空。船坞的设计非常独特，有很多值得借鉴学习之处。
entries.en: A large portion of asteroid [From.GetName] has been hollowed out to allow for the construction of some kind of shipyard. It has been abandoned and exposed to the vacuum of space for centuries - if anything useful remained, it has already been looted by previous explorers. The design of the shipyard itself is unique, however, and much could potentially be learned by its study.

entries.zh: 我们应该研究一下它的设计。
entries.en: We should study its construction.

entries.zh: 垃圾场
entries.en: Junkyard

entries.zh: 在遥远的过去，这颗小行星显然被某些人在某段时间当成了垃圾场。各种各样的报废器械和金属废料都被小行星的低重力捕获，被缓缓地拉到一大堆残骸碎石之中，现在这些残骸碎石已经覆盖了小行星的表面。在这里我们没有发现什么有价值的东西，但许多金属可以用开采站回收。
entries.en: This asteroid was evidently used as a junkyard by someone at some point in the distant past. All manner of discarded machinery and metallic refuse has been deposited inside the asteroid's weak gravity well, being slowly pulled into the jumble of debris that now covers the surface. There is nothing of particular value to be found here, but a lot of the metal could be salvaged by a mining station.

entries.zh: 回收一切可以回收的东西。
entries.en: We should recycle what we can.

entries.zh: 坠毁的侦查器
entries.en: Crashed Scout Craft

entries.zh: 一千年前，某物种的一艘小型侦察机坠毁在这颗小行星的地表，并形成了一个浅峡谷。飞行器中没有明显的驾驶舱，因此集合体获知，它有可能是远程操控的，也有可能是通过某种原始的人工智能操控。虽然它已损坏严重，无法完整复原，但舰船上至少还没有被洗劫一空。
entries.en: A small scout craft of some kind plowed into the surface of this asteroid millennia ago, creating a shallow canyon. There is no visible cockpit on the ship, leading us to believe it was either piloted by remote or through some kind of primitive artificial intelligence. Although it is too damaged to be salvaged, the ship hasn't been picked clean by looters yet.

entries.zh: 我们要研究一下它的设计。
entries.en: We will study its design.

entries.zh: 自动采矿基地
entries.en: Automated Mining Base

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面有小型武器留下的灼烧痕迹，而且该设施似乎陷入了死循环。我们已经重编译了基地系统，现在我们已完全控制该设施。
entries.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There is scorching on the hull indicative of light weapons damage, and the facility appeared to be stuck in some kind of feedback loop. We have managed to reprogram the base systems and the facility is now fully under our control.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面存在大块缺失，这些呈现锯齿状的大洞表明该船曾遭受重型武器的攻击，现已无法修复。但仍有宝贵的材料可以回收。
entries.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There are large chunks of the hull missing, the jagged holes indicative of heavy weapons damage. The station is beyond repair, but salvaging it will provide us with valuable materials.

entries.zh: 武器标靶
entries.en: Weapons Target Range

entries.zh: 小行星[From.GetName]被炸弹轰炸得坑坑洼洼，在大约两千年前，这里似乎曾被某群人当做靶场。残余能源示数表明，那伙人测试的武器也是千奇百怪，其中包括亚空间炸弹和某种奇点生成器。我们的科学家很想研究一下残余的能源回波。
entries.en: Asteroid [From.GetName] is pockmarked with craters from weapon blasts, and appears to have been used as a target range by someone roughly two millennia ago. Residual energy readings suggest they tested increasingly exotic weaponry, including subspace bombs and some kind of singularity generator. Our scientists would be interested in studying the unusual energy echoes that remain.

entries.zh: 小行星碰撞
entries.en: Asteroid Collision

entries.zh: 通过近距离查看，我们发现了一颗几乎全部由贵金属组成的小行星最近与[From.GetName]发生撞击。该致密的金属球体被埋藏在了小行星的地表下，应该具备开采条件。
entries.en: Upon closer examination, we have discovered that a smaller asteroid consisting almost entirely of precious metals recently collided with [From.GetName]. This small but dense cache of metals was hidden just beneath the asteroid's surface, but now that it has been discovered it should be accessible to mining.

entries.zh: 真是走运！
entries.en: A lucky find!

entries.zh: 外来辐射
entries.en: Exotic Radiation

entries.zh: 这颗独特的小行星是在太阳系外的来客。之前，它似乎在穿越星际空间时遭受到了某种外星辐射的洗礼，随后进入了[From.GetStarName]星系。这种辐射的来源目前已不得而知，但通过研究小行星的能源辐射，[Root.GetName]得到了许多物理数据。
entries.en: This particular asteroid is an extrasolar capture, and appears to have been washed by some kind of exotic radiation as it plummeted through interstellar space before finally settling in the [From.GetStarName] system. The original source of this radiation remains unknown, but the [Root.GetName] has been able to pick up a wealth of physics data by studying the asteroid's energy emissions.

entries.zh: 坠毁的矿石货船
entries.en: Crashed Ore Freighter

entries.zh: 在识别到一座[From.GetName]的重力井中的异常现象后，[Root.GetName]发现一艘古代超级矿物货船的残骸被埋葬在小行星的地表之下。该船坠毁时处于满载状态，因此这个小行星的矿藏含量也有所改变。
entries.en: After identifying an anomaly in the gravity well of [From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] has discovered the shattered wreckage of an ancient ore superfreighter buried deep within the asteroid's crust. It must have carried a full load when it crashed, and the asteroid's mineral wealth has been revised accordingly.

entries.zh: 大气层生态系统
entries.en: Atmospheric Ecosystem

entries.zh: 我们在气态巨行星[From.GetName]的上层大气中发现了一个生机勃勃的生态系统。巨大的漂浮生物已经进化出密度轻于空气的身体，可以随风而动，并从气态巨行星频繁的雷暴中摄取能源。这些生物也养活了浮游生物以及猎食浮游生物的小型动物，这些小型动物也互相为食。
entries.en: We have discovered a thriving ecosystem in the upper atmosphere of the gas giant [From.GetName]. Massive floating creatures, having evolved bodies filled with lighter than air gases, follow the wind currents and feed off the energy released by the gas giant's frequent lightning storms. These beings in turn support colonies of smaller animals that prey on atmospheric plankton and each other.

entries.zh: 废弃货舱
entries.en: Abandoned Cargo Pod

entries.zh: 一艘货舱早已被遗弃在[From.GetName]的大气层上部。不知为何，这个货舱没有被其他的太空远行者发现。其轨道正在逐渐降低，预计将在几年后在气态巨行星的大气中消磨殆尽。当[Root.GetName]的船员们打开货舱后，他们发现了一大堆贵金属制作的外星珠宝。
entries.en: A discarded cargo pod was left by someone in the upper atmosphere of [From.GetName] long ago. It has somehow escaped the notice of other spacefarers, and its decaying orbit means it would have been lost in the gas giant's crushing atmosphere within another few years. When the crew of the [Root.GetName] unsealed the pod, they found a stash of alien jewelry made out of precious metals.

entries.zh: 把它们熔了。
entries.en: Melt them down.

entries.zh: 全部卖掉。
entries.en: Sell them.

entries.zh: 研究一下它们的设计。
entries.en: Study their construction.

entries.zh: 留着吧。
entries.en: Let's keep them.

entries.zh: 社会实验
entries.en: Social Experiment

entries.zh: [From.GetName]大气上方发现了一个小型航空殖民地。该殖民地似乎是自给自足的，船上仍存在数个不同种群的残骸。根据目前掌握的情况推断，该殖民群落是多个世纪以前进行的一项社会实验，最终却以自相残杀收场。我们已经下载了殖民地有限的数据库中的全部数据。
entries.en: A small aerostat colony was found floating just above the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have been self-sufficient, and remains from several different species were found on board.\n\nAs best as we can tell, the colony was some kind of social experiment conducted centuries ago that ultimately ended with the colonists massacring each other. We have downloaded all of the data found in the colony's limited databanks.

entries.zh: 回收这些生物质。
entries.en: Recover the biomass.

entries.zh: 浮空殖民地
entries.en: Aerostat Colonies

entries.zh: 我们在这颗气态巨行星的近地轨道发现了一个至少可以追溯到三千年前的废弃航空殖民地。该殖民地最初的任务似乎是开采气体，但之后就被遗弃了，随后被各种不同的种群和海盗团伙占据。该殖民地里价值连城的物品早已被搜刮一空，不过单论它历经劫难仍然保持悬空漂浮这一点，就值得我们进行工程学方面的研究。
entries.en: A ruined network of aerostat colonies dating back at least three millennia can be found in low orbit of this gas giant. Their original function appears to have been gas mining, but they have since been abandoned and reoccupied by many different races and pirate groups.\n\nThe colonies have been thoroughly stripped of anything even remotely valuable, but the mere fact that they are still aloft after all this time makes them an interesting subject of engineering research.

entries.zh: 残骸场
entries.en: Debris Field

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的强重力井将大量的太空垃圾吸了进来，在气态巨行星一边形成了一圈致密的金属层。这些东西的大部分应该是数千年前星系里发生的太空战役遗留下的残骸。现在有技术价值的残骸和文物已被拾荒者搜刮走了，但可以利用开采站来回收金属。
entries.en: The strong gravity well of [From.GetName] has pulled in a massive amount of space debris which has formed a dense layer around parts of the gas giant. Most of it appears to be wreckage from a series of space battles fought in the system several millennia ago.\n\nScavengers have already scoured the debris of valuable technologies and artifacts, but a mining station should be able to recycle the metal.

entries.zh: 坠毁的巡洋舰
entries.en: Crushed Cruiser

entries.zh: [From.GetName]大气深处的近地轨道上，能够探测到一艘巡洋舰的残骸。它似乎是远航来到了这颗气态巨行星的大气中，也许是为了躲避追逐者，最后却被大气压摧毁。此船位置过深，难以打捞。但通过对飞船结构的扫描，我们得到了一些值得关注的工程数据。
entries.en: The shattered remnants of a cruiser-sized starship can be detected in a decaying orbit deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to have ventured far into the gas giant's atmosphere, perhaps in a desperate attempt to escape a pursuer, only to be crushed by the atmospheric pressure.\n\nThe vessel is too deep to be salvaged, but a structural scan of the wreckage has provided us with some interesting engineering data.

entries.zh: 了不起的飞船。
entries.en: A remarkable vessel.

entries.zh: 究极风暴
entries.en: Extreme Storms

entries.zh: [From.GetName]的大气中频繁发生规模巨大的极端风暴。一些周期较长的风暴在轨道上即可见，当中的风速最高可超过700米/秒。造成风暴的原因目前还不清楚，我们在气象模型中没有发现能够解释这一现象的线索。建议进一步研究该异常现象。
entries.en: [From.GetName] frequently experiences massive and extremely violent storm systems in its atmosphere. Several dozen persistent storms are visible from orbit, with winds often reaching speeds in excess of 700 m/s. The cause of these storms is not immediately apparent, as we have found nothing in the planet's climate model that would explain them. Studying this anomaly further is recommended.

entries.zh: 能源特征
entries.en: Energy Signature

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的大气层深处识别到了奇怪的能源特征。该能源似乎是从某建筑发出的，也许是轨道站的残骸。但超高的大气压使我们无法接近。不过，对这一独特特征的扫描让我们得到了大量的宝贵数据。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has picked up a strange energy signature coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.GetName]. It appears to originate from a structure of some kind, possibly the remains of an orbital station, but the atmospheric pressure makes it impossible to approach. Nevertheless, scans of the unique signature have yielded a large amount of valuable physics data.

entries.zh: 珍宝卫星
entries.en: Precious Moon

entries.zh: 在对[From.GetName]气态巨行星的众多自然卫星进行更为详尽的勘测后，我们发现了初步勘测时忽略的带有一座贵金属矿藏的卫星。虽然该卫星体型微小，但其环绕母星运转的轨道稳定，而且这颗小卫星的地质构造本身也很稳定。
entries.en: A more detailed scan of one of the many natural satellites orbiting the gas giant [From.GetName] has revealed a deposit of precious metals and minerals that was overlooked in the initial survey. Although the moon is very small, it has a stable orbit around its primary and appears tectonically stable.

entries.zh: 了不起的发现。
entries.en: An excellent find.

entries.zh: 小行星碰撞
entries.en: Asteroid Collision

entries.zh: 在已经流逝的数千年的某个时间，发生了一次严重的撞击事件，一颗矿物丰富的小行星与[From.GetName]相撞。现在，[From.GetPlanetMoon]的撞击坑周围仍能找到丰富的矿物储藏。
entries.en: A large mineral-rich asteroid collided with [From.GetName] at some point during the previous thousand years in what must have been a major impact event. An abundance of minerals can now be found on the [From.GetPlanetMoon] in the vicinity of the impact crater.

entries.zh: 一次意外的事件。
entries.en: A fortuitous event.

entries.zh: 超光速碰撞
entries.en: FTL Impact

entries.zh: [From.GetName]上的某个撞击坑似乎是一艘星际飞船撞击留下的。根据坑的大小判断，我们怀疑是一万年前一艘超光速引擎全速开启的飞船由于某些未知原因撞上了[From.GetPlanetMoon]。[Root.GetName]已经在超光速撞击地点附近接收到了残余亚空间回波，但由于飞船已经在撞击中解体，因此我们的猜测无法得到证实。
entries.en: A massive crater on [From.GetName] appears to be the result of a collision with a starship. From the size of the crater, we suspect that a ship exiting a hyperlane at maximum velocity rammed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] for reasons unknown roughly 10,000 years ago.\n\nThe [Root.GetName] has picked up residual subspace echoes near the crash site reminiscent of a collapsed hyperparticulate field, but as the ship itself disintegrated on impact the theory cannot be verified.

entries.zh: 微型奇点
entries.en: Microsingularity

entries.zh: 一个微奇点最近与[From.GetName]相交，径直穿过核心到达了另一边的[From.GetPlanetMoon]。这次遭遇似乎并没有造成永久性的损害，但稍微改变了行星核心的能源输出，这一点与我们目前的科学模型相违背。需要进行更深入的研究。
entries.en: A microsingularity recently intersected [From.GetName], passing straight through the core and emerging on the other side of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]. The encounter does not seem to have caused any permanent damage, but it has altered the energy output of the planetary core slightly in a way that defies our current scientific models. Further study may be warranted.

entries.zh: 磁力反转
entries.en: Magnetic Reversal

entries.zh: [From.GetName]在被[Root.GetName]观测时自身的磁场出现了完全的反转。这个罕见的现象也因此改变了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的磁极位置。幸亏这些都被我们的传感器记录了下来，给科学家们提供了宝贵的数据。
entries.en: The magnetic field of [From.GetName] experienced a complete reversal while it was being observed by the [Root.GetName]. This rare event has interchanged the positions of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic poles. Fortunately, it was all recorded by the sensors of our ship, providing our scientists with a lot of valuable data.

entries.zh: 木乃伊化的驾驶员
entries.en: Mummified Pilot

entries.zh: 在[From.GetName]的高空轨道发现了属于未知哺乳类生物的保存完整的木乃伊。身穿整套航空服，甚至还戴着头盔，或许他是史前大战中的一位战斗机驾驶员，在弹射出来之后被人遗忘抛弃在此。对尸体的研究获得了一些有趣的数据。
entries.en: The mummified remains of a single individual belonging to a previously unknown mammalian species have been found drifting in high orbit over [From.GetName]. The being is dressed in what appears to be a flight suit complete with a helmet, and may be a fighter pilot that ejected in some ancient battle only to be forgotten and left behind. Our study of the corpse has provided some interesting data.

entries.zh: 悲惨的命运。
entries.en: A tragic fate.

entries.zh: 他们的血液将流淌在其他血管中。
entries.en: Their blood shall flow in other veins.

entries.zh: 古老救生舱
entries.en: Ancient Life Pod

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!的近地轨道发现了一个被遗弃的救生舱！它的表面被烧焦了，推测可能是由于所属飞船爆炸而造成的，初步扫描显示它至少有5000岁了。[Root.GetName]的成员设法打开了救生舱，里面是一个穿着华丽制服的蜥蜴人的残骸。它的手中抓着一张另外一个蜥蜴人的照片-它的伴侣或者崇敬的领袖。
entries.en: An abandoned life pod was detected in close orbit of §Y[From.GetName]§!. It is covered in scorch marks, presumably from when the pod's mothership exploded, and preliminary scans suggest it was built more than 5,000 years ago.\n\nThe crew of the [Root.GetName] managed to open the pod, revealing the withered remains of a reptilian alien clad in a resplendent uniform. Clutched in one of its claws was a small picture of another individual from the same race - possibly a mate or revered leader.

entries.zh: 无论是君王还是奴隶，口感都差不多。
entries.en: Monarch or slave matters little to taste.

entries.zh: 外星手迹
entries.en: Alien Writing

entries.zh: 某人在大约五千年前用轨道上的采矿激光在[From.GetName]的表面雕刻了一篇巨大的文章，占据了[From.GetPlanetMoon]的大部分上半球地区，似乎讲述了一位外星佣兵的悲惨一生。
entries.en: Someone used a mining laser from orbit approximately five thousand years ago to carve a large body of writing into the surface of [From.GetName]. The massive script covers a large portion of the [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s upper hemisphere, and appears to be a short story chronicling the difficult life of an alien mercenary.

entries.zh: 太阳帆
entries.en: Solar Sailer

entries.zh: 我们在§Y[From.GetName]§!的轨道附近发现了一艘被遗弃的太阳帆飞船。这艘亚光速飞船的主人来自未知文明，并且似乎有数千年的历史了。其中一面帆有一个大裂口，似乎是被物体穿过留下的——很可能是一颗流星——这或许是飞船失去飞行能力的原因。虽然这艘飞船的科技已经很大程度上落伍了，但一些工学设计还是非常有趣的。
entries.en: We have discovered an abandoned solar sail ship in orbit around §Y[From.GetName]§!. The sublight vessel was built by an unknown culture, and appears to be several thousand years old. One of the massive sails has a large tear where some kind of object passed through - most likely a meteoroid - which appears to have disabled the vessel. Although the technology of the ship is severely outdated, it does possess some interesting engineering design choices.

entries.zh: 有趣但原始的设计。
entries.en: An interesting albeit primitive design.

entries.zh: 擦肩而过
entries.en: Glancing Hit

entries.zh: 在接近§Y[From.GetName]§!时，几枚质量加速炮弹从§Y[Root.GetName]§!的船侧飞驰而过。这些投射物已经有数十亿年的历史了，从轨迹判断，它们似乎是从邻近星系发射的，在偏离原定目标继续默默的飞行了许久-直到今天你看到它们。尽管历史悠久，但我们回收的这些炮弹的设计还是非常尖端的。
entries.en: While approaching §Y[From.GetName]§!, the §Y[Root.GetName]§! suddenly received a glancing hit by several passing mass driver rounds. The projectiles were billions of years old, and based on their trajectory they appear to be stray rounds fired from a neighboring galaxy. After missing their intended target, they continued on their journey for untold millennia - until today. The rounds we have recovered are of an advanced design despite their incredible age.

entries.zh: 被牵引的小行星
entries.en: Towed Asteroid

entries.zh: 出于某些原因，曾经有人将一个小行星拖拽到了§Y[From.GetName]§!的轨道上。在小行星表面，还能找到当年使用过的巨大的引擎和制动推进器，虽然它们已经很长时间不能工作了。不管是谁搬运小行星，此人也采掘了小行星的矿物，但是这些设施看上去似乎刚刚启用就被废弃了。
entries.en: For some reason, someone has towed an asteroid into a stable orbit around §Y[From.GetName]§!. The massive engine sections and braking thrusters can still be found on the surface, although they have long since been rendered inoperable. Whoever did this also mined the asteroid for minerals, but these operations were seemingly abandoned shortly after they begun.

entries.zh: 这外星人真有想法！
entries.en: Aliens with some sense!

entries.zh: 核毁灭
entries.en: Nuclear Devastation

entries.zh: 对§Y[From.GetName]§!的调查显示它在一千年前是一个气候温和的大陆[From.GetPlanetMoon]。而恰恰相反的是，如今这里的大气中充满着毒气，地表高度辐射，已经不再适宜居住了。我们检测到[From.GetPlanetMoon]之所以变成如此景象，是因为前太空时代的两个文明之间发生的热核大战产生的毁灭性后果。
entries.en: Our survey of §Y[From.GetName]§! has revealed that it used to be a pristine continental [From.GetPlanetMoon] with a mild climate as little as a thousand years ago. In stark contrast, the atmosphere today is extremely toxic, the surface highly irradiated and the world has long since lost the ability to support life.\n\nWe have detected signs that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] was the scene of an incredibly destructive thermonuclear war waged between factions of a relatively advanced indigenous pre-space civilization.

entries.zh: 真是浪费。
entries.en: What a waste.

entries.zh: 核废墟
entries.en: Nuclear Wasteland

entries.zh: 对§Y[From.GetName]§!的调查显示，由于数个世纪之前的全球热使用核武的战争，[From.GetPlanetMoon]目前正在经历冰河世纪。随之而来的核冬天使大多数高级生命形态消灭，这其中也包括发动战争的文明种群，而他们已经进入了后原子时代。
entries.en: The survey of §Y[From.GetName]§! has revealed that the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is currently experiencing an ice age that seems to have been triggered by a global thermonuclear war many centuries ago. Most higher life forms have been killed off by the subsequent nuclear winter, including the post-atomic civilization that initiated the apocalyptic exchange.

entries.zh: 对§Y[From.GetName]§!的调查证实[From.GetPlanetMoon]在数个世纪之前的全球热使用核武的战争之前是一个生机勃勃的热带天堂。大多数高级生命形态都被和辐射消灭，这其中也包括发动战争的文明种群，而他们已经进入了后原子时代。
entries.en: The survey of §Y[From.GetName]§! has confirmed that this [From.GetPlanetMoon] was once a thriving tropical paradise before it was laid waste by a global thermonuclear war many centuries ago. Most higher life forms, including the post-atomic civilization that initiated the apocalyptic exchange, were killed off in the irradiated wasteland that remained after the dust settled.

entries.zh: 伽马线爆
entries.en: Gamma-Ray Burst

entries.zh: 24000年之前，星系之中的一颗坍缩恒星发出的伽玛射线暴直接照射到了§Y[From.GetName]§!星球表面。[From.GetPlanetMoon]被致命辐射覆盖，不仅面向射线的[From.GetName]大多数生命形态都被辐射感染，同时大部分的臭氧层也被破坏。这次大灭绝使星球大概86%的生物消失，包括早期青铜时代的文明，他们的遗迹至今仍然存在于北半球的一些地区。目前当地的生物圈有了一些恢复的迹象。
entries.en: 24,000 years ago §Y[From.GetName]§! had the misfortune of being directly in the path of a long gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star within our galaxy. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was washed with lethal radiation, which not only produced acute radiation poisoning in most life forms on the side of [From.GetName] that happened to be facing the burst, but also depleted much of the ozone layer.\n\nThis extinction event killed off an estimated 86% of all biota, including an early Bronze Age civilization whose ruins can still be found in some parts of the northern hemisphere. The biosphere is only now showing signs of recovery.
