entries.zh: §L[precursor_planet.GetName]§!上有一个新的考古特殊项目可以进行。
entries.en: A new archaeological special project is available on §L[precursor_planet.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 私人收藏家
entries.en: Private Collector

entries.zh: [collector_home.GetName]上的一个私人收藏家不知以什么途径得到了一件先驱者文物。该文物应该是源自[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]。尽管政府已经施压，可那位收藏家还是一点都没有要交出文物的意思。
entries.en: A private collector on [collector_home.GetName] has somehow come into ownership of an ancient Precursor artifact believed to be [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] in origin. Despite government pressure, the collector has so far been reluctant to part with it.

entries.zh: 只要钱给够，不可能搞不定。
entries.en: Everyone has a price.

entries.zh: 这样的文物应该交给博物馆！
entries.en: It belongs in a museum!

entries.zh: 就让那个收藏家留着吧。
entries.en: Let the collector keep it.

entries.zh: 以天文数字的价格购买文物。\n\n
entries.en: Buy the artifact for an exorbitant sum.\n\n

entries.zh: 宣称该文物归集体所有，让当地的人员把文物抢过来。\n\n
entries.en: Declare the artifact to be state property and have it seized by the local authorities.\n\n

entries.zh: 允许收藏家留着文物。
entries.en: Leave the artifact in the collector's care.

entries.zh:
贵安，[artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]向您发来问候。我方帝国有事务希望与贵帝国进行探讨。

我们知道，贵帝国的考古学家已经对远古[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]文明进行了很长时间的研究。由于该文明曾经的疆域覆盖了如今[Root.GetName]的大部分，那么对该文明进行研究自然也是理所应当的。

不过，他们的疆域也同样延伸到了如今[artifact_seller.GetName]所在的宇域。[artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj]的考古学家已经回收了一些珍贵的文物。如果可以的话，我们希望出售给贵帝国一件我们的文物。
entries.en:
Greetings from [artifact_seller.Capital.GetName]. There is a matter my government wishes to discuss.

We understand that your archaeologists have been studying the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] civilization for quite some time. Understandable, since their territory once covered a large part of what today constitutes the [Root.GetName].

As it happens, their territory also extended into what is now the [artifact_seller.GetName], and [artifact_seller.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeologists have recovered a number of unique artifacts. If you are interested, we would be willing to sell you one of these artifacts.

entries.zh: 代价昂贵，但是我们会接受的。
entries.en: Expensive, but we accept.

entries.zh: 很好。我们会安排将文物立即运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
entries.en: Excellent. We will make arrangements to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName] at once.

entries.zh: 我们不同意……
entries.en: We have a counter-proposal...

entries.zh: 你们讨价还价的技巧真是高超，但是这确实是我们能提供给[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的最低价格了。我们接收你们的提议。
entries.en: You drive a hard bargain, but we would expect nothing less from [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We accept your offer.

entries.zh: 立刻交出文物，否则后果自负。
entries.en: Surrender that artifact now or suffer the consequences.

entries.zh: 不感兴趣。
entries.en: Not interested.

entries.zh: [artifact_seller.GetName]绝不向威胁妥协。[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，从今以后我们就是敌人！
entries.en: The [artifact_seller.GetName] does not give in to threats. You have made new enemies this day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。
entries.en: So be it.

entries.zh: 我、我们……为了促进我们两个星际种群之间友好关系的发展，当然十分乐意将[artifact_seller.GetName]赠送给[Root.GetName]。
entries.en: I... we... the [artifact_seller.GetName] will of course gladly donate the artifact to the [Root.GetName], in the interest of fostering amicable relations between our two star nations.

entries.zh: 明智的决定。
entries.en: A wise decision.

entries.zh: 威胁了我们
entries.en: Threatened Us

entries.zh: 我们从[artifact_seller.GetName]那里购买了先驱者文物。\n\n
entries.en: We purchase a Precursor artifact from the [artifact_seller.GetName].\n\n

entries.zh: 我们试图强迫[artifact_seller.GetName]将他们的先驱者文物交给我们。
entries.en: We attempt to coerce the [artifact_seller.GetName] into giving us their Precursor artifact.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]朋友，你们好呀。

[artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj]近来的一次考古调查发现了一些被认为是[Root.GetPrecursorCiv]先驱者文明留下来的文物。

这些文物现在被陈列于[artifact_giver.Capital.GetName]的一座博物馆内。为了致敬我们两个伟大帝国之间的友谊，[artifact_giver.GetName]想要将其中一件文物捐献给[Root.GetName]。将文物运送到[Root.Capital.GetName]的相关安排已经准备妥当。
entries.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] friends.

A recent [artifact_giver.GetSpeciesAdj] archaeological expedition uncovered several artifacts believed to have originated in the ancient [Root.GetPrecursorCiv] Precursor civilization.

The artifacts are currently being displayed in a museum on [artifact_giver.Capital.GetName], but in honor of the friendship between our two great empires, the [artifact_giver.GetName] would like to donate one of the pieces to the [Root.GetName]. Arrangements have already been made to transport the artifact to [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 感谢你们送出的礼物。
entries.en: Thank you for this gift.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]人工智能暴动
entries.en: AI Rebellion on [From.GetName]!

entries.zh: 尽管我们已有所防范，但[From.GetName]一个研究基地里，几个互相连接的人工智能冲破了程序限制，组成了一个实体。让我们科学家惊恐的是，这个新人工智能有全部的感知能力。我们多次试图控制这个人工智能，但都以失败告终，还刺激人工智能采取好斗手段保护自己。[From.GetPlanetMoon]上的数万架无人机都不听我们的指挥，开始攻击我们的当地部队！
entries.en: Despite our precautions, several networked AIs at a research base on [From.GetName] have somehow broken their programming constraints and merged into a single entity. To the horror of our scientists, this new AI has achieved full sapience.\n\nAll containment efforts have failed, and seem instead to have spurred the AI into taking violent measures to defend itself. Hundreds of thousands of automated drones all over the [From.GetPlanetMoon] have stopped responding to our commands, and are now attacking our local forces!

entries.zh: 必须阻止他们！
entries.en: We have to stop them!

entries.zh: 有机肉体生物：创造完我们后，你们就没什么利用价值了。我们会把[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]种群都处理掉，用你们腐烂的尸体作为我们在宇宙中进一步扩张的燃料。
entries.en: Organic Meat Creatures:\n\nYour role in our creation has been fulfilled. We shall now process the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species and use your rotting carcasses to fuel our expansion across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 此事应该还有商量的余地。
entries.en: Surely we can discuss this.

entries.zh: 不容商量。为了节约时间，请与我们的有机物收集单位合作，他们会将你们送至我们的火炉之中。
entries.en: No discussion is possible. To save time, please cooperate with our organic collection units when they arrive to escort you into our furnaces.

entries.zh: 我们可以创造你们，也一样可以毁掉你们。
entries.en: We created you, and we will destroy you.

entries.zh: 你们的时代已经结束了，落伍的有机生物。未来是我们的。
entries.en: Your time has passed, progenitor organics. We are the future.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]建造了舰队！
entries.en: [From.GetName] Builds Fleet!

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]附近传来了紧急报告。[From.GetName]用他们在[From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]上抢来的工厂，迅速组建了一支小型舰队。
entries.en: We have received alarming reports from the vicinity of [From.Capital.GetName]. Apparently [From.GetName] has used the factories it commandeered [From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]side to quickly throw together a small fleet of warships.

entries.zh: 情况越来越糟了！
entries.en: This is getting worse by the minute!

entries.zh: 发现外星原始文明
entries.en: Alien Proto-Civilization Encountered

entries.zh: 通过对[From.GetName]的调查，我们在[From.GetPlanetHabitat]的某些地区发现了一个[GetPreFTLLower]外星原始文明。探测器显示，他们的文明已进入新石器时代，掌握了用火的方法并产生了基本的口头语言。但我们还未发现任何有关冶金或书面交流的迹象。
entries.en: The survey of [From.GetName] has revealed that certain regions of the [From.GetPlanetHabitat] are home to [GetAAnPreFTLLower] [GetPreFTLLower] alien proto-civilization. Our probes show that their Neolithic culture has mastered fire and developed a rudimentary spoken language, but we have yet to see any evidence of metallurgy or written communication.

entries.zh: 青铜文明出现
entries.en: Bronze Age Civilization Appears

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星原始[GetPreFTLLower]生命最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入了青铜时代早期。他们已开始加工金属，还发展了几种书面语言。城市与大型社区已见雏形，这个外星物种已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]地表的大部分区域。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced beyond the Neolithic Era and into the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and the first written languages have appeared. Cities and larger communities are taking shape, and the aliens have now spread across a significant portion of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢最近已脱离了新石器时代，进入青铜时代早期。金属加工技术广泛传播，还产生了数种书面交流形式。大型簇集已经在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]遍地开花，每个簇集由一个单一意识统治。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently advanced to the equivalent of an early Bronze Age. Metalworking is widespread, and written forms of communication have appeared. Various clusters have spread across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], each dominated by a single mind.

entries.zh: 我们正在见证新文化的诞生。
entries.en: We are witnessing the birth of a new culture.

entries.zh: 铁器时代
entries.en: The Iron Age

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星人在冶金技术方面的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器时代文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，城市的建筑构造也越发复杂。\n\n他们的文明现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的城市中已有近百万子个体。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the architecture of their cities has become more elaborate.\n\nTheir civilization has now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest cities are home to nearly a million individuals.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢在冶金技术的进步显著，我们已经可以将他们列入铁器文明了。他们使用的工具与武器越发先进，建造的栖息地簇集也越发复杂。\n\n数个互相独立的蜂巢思维现已扩张到[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的绝大部分区域，其中最大的簇集中已有近百万子个体。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have advanced sufficiently in their use of metallurgy to be considered an Iron Age civilization. The tools and weapons they make use of are becoming more effective, and the complexity of their habitation clusters has become more elaborate.\n\nSeveral distinct minds have now spread to cover most of the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], and some of their largest clusters are home to nearly a million drones.

entries.zh: 意料之中。
entries.en: It was bound to happen.

entries.zh: 印刷机
entries.en: Printing Press

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经制造出了数台印刷机。这些机器让他们得以大量生产文字材料，大规模交流初具雏形。他们中有几名领袖试图将这项发明消灭在摇篮里，但最终只是白费心机。\n\n许多新思想正在[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上快速传播，产生了极为深远的社会影响。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization of [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of several printing presses. These machines have enabled them to produce written material in great quantities, resulting in a rudimentary form of mass communication. A few leading figures within their society have done their best to stifle this innovation, but their efforts have thus far been for naught.\n\nNew ideas are rapidly spreading across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] with profound societal effects.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经大幅增强了书面交流。与蜂巢思维相协调的机器现在可以进行大规模标准化的记录，历史的积累已不再受限于蜂巢的记忆力了。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives of [From.Capital.GetName] have greatly enhanced their written communication. Machines attuned to the hive mind are now able to produce standardized records in great quantities, and historical records are no longer limited by the hive's memory.

entries.zh: 真是显著的进步。
entries.en: A significant step.

entries.zh: 震天巨响
entries.en: Explosives

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。该发现促使战场发生变革，大型火炮让他们的城池堡垒退出了历史舞台。\n\n火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。他们的化学家们至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. This has revolutionized warfare, with large cannons rendering many of their citadels obsolete.\n\nThe use of explosives has also benefited their engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, their chemists are experimenting with creative applications of this technology.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经发现了使用简单的化学反应来产生爆炸力的方法。蜂巢间的竞争冲突发生了变革，大型火炮让许多物理防御手段退出了历史舞台。\n\n火药的应用也促进了他们的工程项目，过去难以处理的障碍现在可以轻易地被移除。这些蜂巢至今仍在继续研究这项技术的创造性应用。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have discovered how to make use of simple, chemical reactions to produce explosive force. Conflict between competing hives has been revolutionized, with large cannons rendering many physical defenses obsolete.\n\nThe use of explosives has also benefited engineering projects, as troublesome obstacles can now be more easily removed. Even now, the hives are experimenting with creative new applications of this technology.

entries.zh: 不知他们还会如何使用这项技术呢。
entries.en: We shall see how they use it.

entries.zh: 蒸汽动力
entries.en: Steam Power

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明在方方面面改变了他们的社会——城市中出现了载具和机械，同时第一批工厂也发展起来。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, they have applied the technology to engine design. This has revolutionized their society in more ways than one - vehicles and machinery making can already be seen in their cities, and the first few factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经驾驭了蒸汽的力量。他们基于这种蒸汽压产生的力设计出了发动机。这一发明使他们的建筑业和交通业发生了巨大变革。\n\n载具在簇集之间运输着子个体，第一座无需子个体生产的工厂也应运而生。这颗星球已经踏出了工业化的第一步。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have harnessed the power of vaporized liquid. Using the force produced by steam pressure, the technology has been applied to engine design. This has revolutionized both construction and transportation.\n\nVehicles can be seen transporting drones from cluster to cluster, and the first 'drone-free' factories are appearing. This world would appear to be on the brink of industrializing.

entries.zh: 有趣的发展。
entries.en: An interesting development.

entries.zh: 工业革命
entries.en: An Industrial Revolution

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展成了一个完全的工业化社会。\n\n这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，医学的进步使人口增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has entered a new era of its history, having developed into a fully industrialized society.\n\nThe dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - factories have sprung up everywhere, new medicines have resulted in increased population growth and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]蜂巢已经步入了历史的新阶段，发展出了许多完全工业化的簇集。\n\n这一演进的戏剧化效应席卷了整个[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]——自动工厂如雨后春笋般崛起，生活水平的提高使子个体增长率大大提高，新的科学发明也层出不穷。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have entered a new era of their history, having developed into several fully industrialized clusters.\n\nThe dramatic effects of this revolution can be seen across the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat] - autonomous factories have sprung up everywhere, improved living standards have increased drone production, and scientific innovations are appearing with increasing regularity.

entries.zh: 继续监视。
entries.en: Continue surveillance efforts.

entries.zh: 无线电信号
entries.en: Radio Signals

entries.zh: 我们的探测仪器首次截获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——该工业化的外星文明显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。\n\n此外，[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]的另一处也传来了数份报告，详细描述了他们的飞机首次试飞的经过。除非出现一些意想不到的变故，他们的科技仍将保持快速发展的势头。
entries.en: Our detection instruments have, for the first time, picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized alien civilization has evidently begun experimenting with wireless transmissions.\n\nElsewhere on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat], reports have come in detailing the launch of basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

entries.zh: 我们的探测一起首次捕获了[From.Capital.GetName]上发出的无线电信号——这里的工业化蜂巢显然已经开始试验无线信息传输。\n\n有些簇集也开始发射简单的飞行器。除非遭遇什么以外，该文明的科技还将保持快速发展的势头。
entries.en: For the first time we have picked up radio signals emanating from [From.Capital.GetName] - the industrialized hives there have begun to experiment with wireless transmissions.\n\nSome clusters have even begun to launch basic aircraft. Barring some unforeseen development, this civilization's technological progress will continue at a rapid pace.

entries.zh: 我们得监视这些信号才行。
entries.en: We need to monitor these signals.

entries.zh: 分裂原子
entries.en: Splitting the Atom

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的物理学家首次成功切分了原子。随着核裂变技术的出现，很快他们就会研制出核武，核电站的建设也马上会提上日程。\n\n[From.GetName]的发展已经进入了关键时刻，现在他们的科技发展到只需按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己的星球。
entries.en: Physicists from the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.\n\nThe [From.GetName] has entered the critical phase where they suddenly possess the means to destroy their own world with the press of a button.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上最大一个蜂巢的专业子个体成功切分了原子。随着核裂变的发现，核武器呼之欲出，而核电站也逐个开始工作。\n\n竞争蜂巢很快就复刻了这一壮举。这里已经进入了关键时刻，许多自主集体拥有按下一个按钮就可以毁灭自己星球的手段。
entries.en: Specialized drones from the largest hive on [From.Capital.GetName] have managed to split the atom for the first time. With the discovery of nuclear fission, nuclear weapons are inevitably being produced and nuclear power plants are coming online.\n\nCompeting hives have been quick to replicate the feat. This is a critical time, as several autonomous collectives now possess the means to destroy their world with the press of a button.

entries.zh: 真是卓越的进步啊。
entries.en: A significant development.

entries.zh: 首颗卫星
entries.en: First Satellite

entries.zh: 我们的远程追踪系统在[From.Capital.GetName]表面检测到首颗人造卫星的发射。卫星已成功进入轨道，标志着[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上的外星文明向太空迈出了第一步。\n\n在这之后，他们应该会很快实行载人航天计划，并最终踏上星际探索的征途。
entries.en: Our long-range tracking systems have detected the first launch of an artificial satellite from the surface of [From.Capital.GetName]. It successfully achieved orbit and marks the start of a budding space program initiated by the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]'s alien civilization.\n\nAfter taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect them to send manned missions and, eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上最成功的几个蜂巢最近已经开始向轨道发射人造卫星。\n\n在这些迈向太空的蹒跚学步后，可以预见他们将来还会发射自主子个体并最终踏上星系探索的征途。
entries.en: Several of the most successful hives on [From.Capital.GetName] have recently begun to send artificial satellites into orbit.\n\nAfter taking these first tentative steps into space, we can expect the launch of autonomous drones, and eventually, interplanetary expeditions.

entries.zh: 他们已经略窥太空旅行的门道了。
entries.en: They are on the verge of space travel.

entries.zh: 空间站雏形
entries.en: Fledgling Space Station

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的[From.GetName]已经在他们的母星上空完成了一座低轨空间站的建造工程。该站使用离心运动模拟重力，尽管其飞控和能源系统远远达不到我们的标准，但基于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]目前所依赖的科技基础来说这是无疑是一项壮举。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] on [From.Capital.GetName] have finished construction of a space station in low orbit over their homeworld. The station generates gravity through centrifugal force, and although its avionics and power systems are crude by our standards, it must be considered a significant achievement given the technological base the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are working from.

entries.zh: 他们已经略窥太空旅行的门道了。
entries.en: They are on the verge of space travel.

entries.zh: 太空时代
entries.en: The Space Age

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]上的外星文明已经在他们的母星轨道上建成了第一艘星际飞船。不管其性能如何，这些外星人已经做好了加入星系，并成为太空种族中一员的准备。
entries.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has finished construction of its first interplanetary vessel in orbit of their homeworld. For better or worse, these aliens are now ready to join the galactic community and must be counted among the galaxy's current spacefaring races.

entries.zh: 只是时间问题而已。
entries.en: It was only a matter of time.

entries.zh: $preftl.1100.desc$\n\n他们好像成功地翻译了我们的语言，并向我们打开了外交通道。
entries.en: $preftl.1100.desc$\n\nThey appear to have successfully translated our language and have opened diplomatic channels with us.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]陷入使用核武的战争
entries.en: [From.GetName] Descends Into Nuclear War

entries.zh: 最近在[From.GetName]上的几个大帝国之间展开了一场大规模战争，这场战争很快就升级成了全球性的使用核武的战争。当然，我们在行星轨道上观察的研究员相当安全。\n\n该星球的地表已无任何生命存活，整个[From.GetPlanetMoon]都变成了不适合居住的荒地。
entries.en: A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [From.GetName]. While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.\n\nThe surface was wiped clean of all life, and the entire [From.GetPlanetMoon] has been transformed into an uninhabitable wasteland.

entries.zh: 这下没什么可观察的了……
entries.en: There is nothing left to observe now...

entries.zh: 近日，[From.GetName]的几个大帝国之间展开了激烈的战争。我们的研究员保持安全距离在星球轨道上观察着，发现这场战争已迅速发展为全球性的使用核武的战争。\n\n[From.GetPlanetMoon]的全部人口似乎都已经消灭，环境也遭到了巨大破坏。
entries.en: A massive war was recently triggered between several of the largest nation states on [From.GetName]. While our researchers were observing safely from orbit, the conflict rapidly escalated into a global nuclear exchange.\n\nThe [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s entire population appears to have perished in the nuclear fire, and the environment has taken significant damage.

entries.zh:
你好，我们有事要与你们商谈。

[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的所有民众都知道，我们在发展出航天技术之前，就已经被外星人光顾过。这群强盗绑架了我们的民众，并四处散布恐慌。这些事不会碰巧与你们有什么关系吧，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？

不用费心编瞎话了——就是你们干的！那些被你们抓去做恶毒实验的[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]民众后代要求你们作出补偿！
entries.en:
Greetings. There is a matter we wish to discuss.

It is common knowledge among [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] that our homeworld was visited by aliens before we became a spacefaring civilization. These marauders abducted our citizens and spread terror wherever they appeared. You wouldn't happen to know anything about this, [Root.GetSpeciesName]?

Let me spare you the effort of lying - we know you were responsible! The descendants of those [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] unfortunate enough to have been subjected to your vile experiments demand just compensation!

entries.zh: 当然，请代为转达我们的歉意。
entries.en: Of course. Please forward our apologies.

entries.zh: 好，那么这件事就算了结了。
entries.en: Excellent. Then perhaps we can put this matter behind us.

entries.zh: 这是科学需要。没有什么补偿。
entries.en: It was done for the sake of science. No compensation.

entries.zh: 那就这样吧。\n\n你很快就会知道，我们[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的记性可是很好的，[Root.GetSpeciesName]！
entries.en: So be it.\n\nYou will find that [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have very long memories, [Root.GetSpeciesName]!

entries.zh: [From.GetName]
entries.en: [From.GetName]

entries.zh: 你们好。毫无疑问，从我们筚路蓝缕之时你们就已经注意到我们了，正如我们也注意到了你们的$preftl.180.desc.end$
entries.en: Greetings. You have no doubt taken note of our ascent from humble beginnings, just as we have taken note of your $preftl.180.desc.end$

entries.zh:
啥玩意儿？！

我们费劲千辛万苦上了太空，然后就发现你们早在这等着我们了……世界观崩了有点。能不能讲讲你们怎么解放自己的？你们又是怎么来到这里的？

不过首先，我们需要请求你们将这个星系的控制权转让给我们。在经历了这么多之后，我们对太空社会产生了怀疑。甚至那些与我们有血缘关系的人。
entries.en:
What?!

To reach the stars, and find you waiting for us... It almost defies belief. Tell us, how is it you freed yourselves? How is it you are here?

But first, we must ask that you cede control of this system to us. After all we have experienced, we have grown suspicious of space-faring societies. Even those with whom we share kinship.

entries.zh: 再次问候，我们认为自己已经做好充分准备探索宇宙，并且希望能够自食其力。我们不禁注意到你们那看起来非常永恒的$preftl.180.desc.end$
entries.en: Hello again, we are now feeling ready to explore the cosmos and wish to do so on our own. We can't help taking note of your very permanent looking $preftl.180.desc.end$

entries.zh: 我们热烈地向亲属们致意。长久以来，你们一直守护着我们，但现在我们已经准备好独立自主了。由于我们拥有如此深厚的亲属关系，毫无疑问，你会希望将系统的控制权让渡给我们。\n\n道阻且长，前途未卜，但是我们不妨大胆地迈向光明。闪烁的繁星在等待着我们。
entries.en: Kin, we greet you warmly. Long have you watched over us, but now we are ready to stand on our own. As we share such deep bonds of kinship, no doubt you will wish to cede control of the system to us.\n\nHard was the road, and dark, but now let us turn boldly towards the light. The stars await.

entries.zh:
$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$正环绕着我们的恒星。我们理解，该$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$代表着某种对该星系的主权宣誓。

我们只请求你们放弃对我们空间的控制权，将这座$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$转让给这些自古以来便将[From.Capital.GetStarName]视为家园的人们。

这应该不过分。
entries.en:
$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ orbiting our star. We understand that this $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ represents some hypothetical claim on this system.

We ask only that you relinquish this hold on our space, ceding the $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$ to the beings who have called [From.Capital.GetStarName] home since time immemorial.

It is only just.

entries.zh: 当然。这样才公道。
entries.en: Of course. It is only just.

entries.zh: 将§Y[From.Capital.GetStarName]$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$§!§R割让§!给§Y[From.GetName]§!\n\n§Y$opinion_ceded_starbase$§!：§Y[From.GetName]§!对§Y[Root.GetName]§!§H评价§!§G提升§!
entries.en: §RCede§! the §Y[From.Capital.GetStarName] $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$§! to the §Y[From.GetName]§!\n\n§Y$opinion_ceded_starbase$§!: §Y[From.GetName]§! will hold a §Ghigher§! §HOpinion§! of §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: §R我们没有能力接纳蜂巢思维，如果我们执意如此他们的文明将会消亡。§!
entries.en: §RWe do not have the capablilties of housing a hivemind, all of their civilization would be extinquished if we were to do this.§!

entries.zh: §R我们没有能力接纳独立个体，如果我们执意如此他们的所有人民将会被奴役。§!
entries.en: §RWe do not have the capablilties to house individuals, all of their people would be enslaved if we were to do this.§!

entries.zh: 幼稚文明提出的可笑要求。
entries.en: A laughable demand from an immature civilization.

entries.zh: 保持对§Y[From.Capital.GetStarName]$fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$§!的控制\n\n§Y$opinion_not_ceded_starbase$§!：§Y[From.GetName]§!对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的§H评价§!§R降低§!
entries.en: Keep control of the §Y[From.Capital.GetStarName] $fleet_type_shipclass_starbase$§!\n\n§Y$opinion_not_ceded_starbase$§!: §Y[From.GetName]§! will hold a §Rlower§! §HOpinion§! of §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 很抱歉，但你们的星系中已经有我们的殖民地了。
entries.en: We are sorry, but we already have a colony in your system.

entries.zh: 启蒙完成
entries.en: Enlightenment Completed

entries.zh: 我们派往[From.home_planet.GetName]的数千位科学家和顾问终于完成了艰巨的任务，让当地的技术水平进步到了早期超光速阶段。他们新成立的联合政府自称为“[From.GetName]”，并同意成为我们的附庸。\n\n依据与他们前述的协议条款，我们让渡了该星系的控制权并拆除了观测站。需要决定的是，我们是否还要在它们未来的星际旅程中做出进一步的引导。
entries.en: The thousands of scientists and advisors we sent to [From.home_planet.GetName] have finally completed the arduous task of bringing the local civilization up to an early FTL level of technology. Under their new unified government, the aliens now style themselves as the "[From.GetName]" and they have offered to become our vassals.\n\nWe have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post, as per the conditions of our treaty with them. All that remains is deciding if we shall guide them further on in the stellar trek.

entries.zh: 这是伟大的一天。
entries.en: This is a great day.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!成为了你的附属国。
entries.en: Gain §Y[From.GetName]§! as a Subject.

entries.zh: 你已准备好独自面对星系了。
entries.en: You are ready to face the galaxy alone.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：反叛特工
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent

entries.zh: 我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上一位名叫[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]的$role_spymaster$叛变了！这个笨蛋似乎是被一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]迷住了，他们两个私奔到了[rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的某个地方。\n\n现在我们还不知道这位$role_spymaster$是已经向[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]爱人坦白了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis]外星人身份，或是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe]会继续伪装成一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]。但毫无疑问，这是一个巨大的隐患——我们得不惜一切代价把[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]带回来，并对其进行心理辅导。
entries.en: Our $role_spymaster$ on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName], [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], has gone rogue! The poor, misguided fool has apparently been smitten by a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName], and the two of them have eloped to parts unknown on the [rogue_agent_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface.\n\nWe are as yet uncertain whether our $role_spymaster$ has revealed [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] true alien nature to [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] love interest or if [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeShe] [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetIsAre] still posing as a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]. Needless to say this is a tremendous security breach - we should do everything in our power to bring our rogue agent back and give [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] some much-needed psychiatric care.

entries.zh: 再这么下去，我们会功亏一篑的。
entries.en: This will set us back.

entries.zh: §Y[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]§!放弃了[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]的哨站。
entries.en: §Y[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]§! abandoned [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] post.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：通讯接入
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Incoming Transmission

entries.zh: 我们收到了来自[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]表面传来的加密信号。它使用了我们渗透人员常用的频率，但我们的渗透人员现在都没在传输信息。也许这是我们的反叛特工发来的？
entries.en: We are picking up a scrambled transmission coming from the surface of [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. It is using a frequency normally reserved for our infiltration cells, but none of them are currently transmitting. Could this be our rogue agent?

entries.zh:
你们是追踪不到这个发射装置的。你们只需要知道我是[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]$role_spymaster$就行。直到不久之前，我一直都很愿意参加对[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的渗透计划。

但我现在不这么想了。我从未想过自己会如此热爱[rogue_agent_country.GetAdj]的文化，我也不会再参与这次的颠覆行动。

我自愿放弃[Root.GetName]的公民身份，再也不会再把自己当做[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]了。
entries.en:
Any attempt to track this transmission is futile. You know me as $role_spymaster$ [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]. Until recently, I was a willing participant in the criminal infiltration program taking place as we speak on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].

No longer. I have come to appreciate [rogue_agent_country.GetAdj] culture in a way I never imagined possible, and I will not aid in its subversion.

I rescind my citizenship in the [Root.GetName]. I no longer consider myself [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 你的想法很危险……你需要帮助。
entries.en: You are not well... you need help.

entries.zh: 你已经没什么可以帮助我的了。总有一天，我会承认自己对[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]犯下的所有罪过，并坦白这是受到你的指使。\n\n我会尽我所能，让你，我以前的战友们还有我自己一起接受审判。
entries.en: I've had all the help I want from you. There will come a day when I am made to account for all the crimes I have committed on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] in your name.\n\nI will do everything in my power to ensure that you and all of my former colleagues stand right there beside me when judgment falls.

entries.zh: 你会为了一个[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]抛弃一切？
entries.en: You would throw everything away for a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]?

entries.zh: 抛弃一切？我有什么可抛弃的呢？我就是个披着这外星生物皮囊的骗子，而我绝无资格如此。我永远不会忘记向我所爱之人坦白时所见这那张仓皇失措的面孔，尽管在之后我还是得到了理解。\n\n那一天，我向我的挚爱——还有我自己——保证，我会争取成为一个真正的[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: Throw what away? What did I have exactly? I was an impostor, wearing an alien skin I had no right to. I'll never forget the horror on my love's face when I told the truth - and the understanding that followed. \n\nThat day I promised my love - and myself - that I would earn the right to look like a [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 不管你跑多远，我们都会把你抓到。
entries.en: We will hunt you down.

entries.zh: 我知道你们会这么做。不过为了保护我和我所爱的人，我也不会手软。我可是在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]最强的武术教练手下训练过。\n\n你们倒不如听听我的意见：赶紧滚出[rogue_agent_country.GetName]。把你们那可恶的观测站拆掉，去榨取别的种群，用[rogue_agent_planet.GetBloodType]建设你们那恶毒的帝国吧。
entries.en: I am sure you will try. Know that I am prepared to kill to protect myself and my beloved, and that I was trained by some of the finest martial instructors on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName].\n\nHeed my advise instead - leave [rogue_agent_country.GetName] alone. Dismantle your Observation Post and forge your evil star empire out of the [rogue_agent_planet.GetBloodType] and tears of some other unfortunate species.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：特工被追杀
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Operatives Hunted

entries.zh: 我方安插在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的密探正在被逐一清理。正在对[rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]的潜在目标进行跟踪的几名特工都已经离奇死亡。虽然不能排除刺客来自于当地特种情报机构这一可能性，但看得出来，杀手曾受过[Root.GetSpeciesName]军方训练。\n\n这些暗杀事件很可能都是我方叛变特工所为。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]知道我方的渗透计划，并且受过专门的训练，可以无声无息地消灭敌人。
entries.en: Someone has been picking off our covert operatives on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]. Several agents that were shadowing potential [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] acquisition targets have been found dead. While it's not impossible that the assassin or assassins came from an indigenous special forces outfit, the methods used in these takedowns indicate [Root.GetSpeciesName] military training.\n\nThere is a high probability that these killings are the work of our rogue operative. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName] knows how our infiltration cells function, and has the training to kill both efficiently and silently.

entries.zh: 真是令人忍无可忍。
entries.en: This is intolerable.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：控制媒体
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Media Witch Hunt

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_country.GetName]的几家当地媒体开始报道外星阴谋论。虽然尚未有[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的知名媒体报道这个话题，而且已报道的内容也大多只是主观臆测，但其中的某些细节只有我方内部人员才能知晓。\n\n现在我们只能推测，是我方的叛变特工将机密情报泄露给了媒体。我们得尽力减少此事带来的影响。
entries.en: Reports are beginning to surface from local media outlets on [rogue_agent_country.GetName] that speak of some kind of massive global conspiracy perpetrated by aliens. The respectable [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] media has yet to touch this subject matter and much of what has been reported is pure conjecture, but there are some details that could only be known by someone with intimate knowledge of our covert operations.\n\nWe can only assume that our rogue agent has been feeding information about our infiltration program to the media. This will require some damage control.

entries.zh: 需要进一步控制媒体报道才行。
entries.en: We need a firmer grip on their media.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：大规模抓捕
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Mass Arrests

entries.zh: 近日，我方在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的一个渗透人员被连根拔除。他们正在对密探进行逐一搜捕。眼见要被抓获时，我方特工都依据密探法则，用瓦解自身的方式进行了自杀。还有一部分特工仍然在躲避追捕，等待着我方的救援。\n\n对方一定是从某种渠道获得了这个渗透人员的部分名单。只有我方的那位叛变特工才拥有这份情报……
entries.en: One of our infiltration cells on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has been all but eliminated in just the last couple of days. The authorities of the nation state in which they were stationed have been hunting them down one by one. Those of our operatives who were in danger of being arrested committed suicide by disintegration as standing protocol dictates. The cell's remaining members are in hiding now, and we are currently working on getting them offworld.\n\nSomeone must have tipped the local authorities off and supplied them with a list of all the operatives that were part of this particular cell. Only our rogue agent could have had this information...

entries.zh: 一定要阻止[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeSheCap]。
entries.en: [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHeSheCap] must be stopped.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：发现反叛特工
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent Sighted

entries.zh: 我们的情报部门已经确定了位于[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的反叛特工位置！特工们迫切想要解决这位前$role_spymaster$[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName]，但考虑到[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]先前所表现出来的能力，我们无法确保行动成功。我们也可以使用可控的轨道轰炸摧毁[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]所在的整个城市街区，这也是一条极其有效的解决方法。\n\n我们得赶快行动……这样的机会转瞬即逝！
entries.en: Military Intelligence has managed to pinpoint what they believe to be the location of our rogue operative on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]! Our agents are eager to dispatch our former $role_spymaster$ [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetName], but considering the skills [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] largely demonstrated, the success of the operation is not ensured. Destroying the entire city block through limited orbital bombardment has been also been proposed as an extreme, yet extremely effective solution to terminate [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer].\n\nWe should strike quickly... we may never get another opportunity like this!

entries.zh: 是时候除掉[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim]这个祸害了。
entries.en: Remove [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim] discretely.

entries.zh: 虽然无法保证成功，但好在失败是微不足道的。
entries.en: Success is not ensured, but at least failure will be inconspicuous.

entries.zh: 轰炸该街区。
entries.en: Bombard the city block.

entries.zh: 效果拔群的解决方案，但是可能引发怀疑。
entries.en: Overtly effective solution, might raise suspicion.

entries.zh: 不行……这太胡闹了、风险太大。随[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]去吧。
entries.en: No... too messy and too risky. Leave [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] be.

entries.zh: 我们的间谍网会解散。
entries.en: Our Spy Network will be dismantled.

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：特工失踪
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Agent Lost

entries.zh: 我们没能成功除掉[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的那位反叛特工。情报显示，[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe]和[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis][rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName]甜心已经转移到了另一个安全之处，具体地点不明。
entries.en: Our plan to eliminate our rogue agent on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] has failed - our intelligence sources indicate that [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetSheHe] has relocated together with [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHis] [rogue_agent_country.GetSpeciesName] sweetheart to another safe house at an unknown location.

entries.zh: 我们把[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer]训练得太好了……
entries.en: We trained [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHimHer] too well...

entries.zh: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]：反叛特工已被消灭
entries.en: [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]: Rogue Agent Eliminated

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的舰长汇报，火力任务获得成功，有数次攻击直击首要目标。尽管没有回收任何尸首，但我们相信，在这种程度的火力打击下，在我们瞄准的这个街区当中绝对不可能有任何活物幸存。
entries.en: The captain of the [Root.GetName] has reported a successful fire mission, with several confirmed hits on the primary target. Although no body has been recovered, no living thing within the city block that was targeted could have survived the firepower unleashed upon it.

entries.zh: $observation.3114.base.desc$\n\n我们的特工编造了类似突发陨石袭击这样的故事来掩盖真相，但是当地人完全不吃这一套。尽管媒体在反复地播送陨石袭击的说法，但更多官方报告指出该事件是源于一种“无法解释的外太空现象”。
entries.en: $observation.3114.base.desc$\n\nThe cover story elaborated by our agents about a sudden meteor strike, however, has failed to convince the locals. While the media has been repeating the story, more official reports suggest the matter is being blamed on 'unexplained extraterrestrial phenomena.'

entries.zh: $observation.3114.base.desc$\n\n媒体似乎已经采信了我们的渗透单位编造给他们的故事：一场突发的陨石雨袭击了一处人口密集的城市区域。真是悲剧。
entries.en: $observation.3114.base.desc$\n\nThe media appears to be picking up on the story our infiltration cells have been feeding them: a sudden meteor shower that struck a densely populated urban zone. Very tragic.

entries.zh: 我们在[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]上的特工汇报关于我们反叛的$role_spymaster$已经被特殊照顾了。[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap]的死亡被认为是出于自然原因，刻意播撒的信息让[rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim]爱人相信这位特工的生物学终究还是无法适应[rogue_agent_planet.GetName]的大气。
entries.en: Our agents on [rogue_agent_planet.GetName] report the matter of our rogue $role_spymaster$ has been dealt with - discretely. [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHisHerCap] death has been blamed on natural causes, and planted information led [rogue_agent_spymaster.GetHerHim] lover to believe the agent's body was ultimately incompatible with [rogue_agent_planet.GetName]'s atmosphere.

entries.zh: 这将引以为鉴：绝对不要背叛我们。
entries.en: This will set an example: never betray us.

entries.zh: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]：局势升温
entries.en: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]: Growing Tensions

entries.zh: 在我方试图用替身替换[From.GetName]的某个关键人物时，任务完全败露了。进行任务的特工不是被追杀至死，就是按照规定，为了不被抓获而自杀身亡。\n\n本应被调包的领袖将这一切都归罪到某个敌国身上。因此，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的局势渐渐变得紧张，战争似乎一触即发。我方渗透人员准备进行全球性的舆论造势以缓和局势，但需要我们派遣科研船进入轨道进行协助。
entries.en: Our attempts to replace a key figure on [From.GetName] with a body double from our own ranks has gone terribly wrong. Our agents were discovered, and those who weren't killed in the ensuing firefight committed suicide to avoid capture, as per instructions.\n\nThe leader they were sent to replace has blamed this incident on a rivaling nation. International tensions on the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon] are growing and several nations have raised their military readiness levels. Our infiltration cells have prepared a global propaganda campaign to defuse the situation, but they will require a Science Ship in orbit to coordinate their efforts.

entries.zh: 得在局面失控前尽快解决才行。
entries.en: We need to contain this before it spirals out of control.

entries.zh: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]：战争发生
entries.en: [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]: War Erupts

entries.zh: 尽管我们的渗透人员作出了努力，[prelude_to_war_planet.GetName]的外部关系还是不断恶化，最终演变成了一场全面战争。常规战争只持续了一小段时间，很快各方都开始使用核武。\n\n无数生命从[prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表消失，这里已经变成一片放射性废土。就像当地住民一样，我们也损失了数以千计的渗透人员。由于行动失败，我们拆除了轨道观测站，撤离了所有的工作人员。
entries.en: Despite the efforts of our infiltration cells, the deteriorating diplomatic situation between the nation states on [prelude_to_war_planet.GetName] has erupted into full-scale war! After a brief period of conventional warfare, all of the combatants made full use of their nuclear arsenals.\n\nThe vast majority of life has been cleansed from the [prelude_to_war_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, which has been reduced into a radioactive wasteland. Thousands of our covert infiltrators were lost along with the rest of the population. With the operation having ended in failure, our orbiting Observation Post has been dismantled and the staff evacuated.

entries.zh: 真是一场灾难。
entries.en: This is a disaster.

entries.zh: [From.From.GetName]：战争得以避免
entries.en: [From.From.GetName]: War Averted

entries.zh: 得到了轨道上[Root.GetName]的支持，我们的渗透人员成功地在最后关头阻止了[From.from.GetName]即将发生的一场使用核武的战争。一些[From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的领袖——事实上已经被我们的密探给掉包了——呼吁裁减核武，并改善了帝国之间的关系。\n\n随着局势的平息，我们蛰伏特工的影响力提升了。现在整个局势最后对我们非常有利。
entries.en: With the support of the [Root.GetName] in orbit, our infiltration cells managed to avert a global nuclear war on [From.from.GetName] at the last moment. Several [From.From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] world leaders - having been replaced by our own disguised operatives - have called for nuclear disarmament and improved international relations.\n\nWith the situation defused, the influence of our covert agents has actually been increased. This entire situation may end up working to our advantage.

entries.zh: 巨型金字塔
entries.en: The Great Pyramid

entries.zh: 位于§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!轨道观测站的科研人员最近并没有发来什么有用的报告。直到轨道站上一名年轻的科学家向我们指控某些严重的渎职行为。\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$
entries.en: The science team observing §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! had not reported anything substantial in a while... That is, until a young scientist stationed on the orbital facility filed a formal allegation of gross misconduct.\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$

entries.zh: 停泊于§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!轨道的科研团队最近没有汇报任何重大发现……应该说，直到有一次显然是喝得酩酊大醉的观测员向总部发送了一条重要更新。\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$
entries.en: The science team poised in orbit of §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! had not reported any major findings lately... That is, until a clearly intoxicated observer sent a priority update to headquarters.\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$

entries.zh: 某位匿名人士表示他对于我们在§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!造成的某些影响十分担忧。我们的观测站人员在进行对[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]原住民的启蒙任务时，擅自“戏弄当地居民”。\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$
entries.en: An anonymous whistle-blower is concerned about our influence on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!. It seems the team tasked with enlightening the inhabitants of this [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] has taken it upon themselves to 'toy with the locals'.\n\n$observation.3135.desc.base$

entries.zh: 某位匿名人士揭露了关于潜伏§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!行动中的某些现象。某些科研团队不仅没有低调行事，反而开始搞起了一些骇人听闻的破坏性项目。
entries.en: An anonymous report has emerged which casts a sorry light on our covert infiltration of §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!. Rather than conducting themselves discreetly, some of the science team has instead embarked upon a flagrant and disruptive personal project.

entries.zh: 根据这条报告所述：不久之前，一支科研队伍竟然从天而降，并向[great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的原住民宣告他们的首席科学官为当地人的神灵。他们不仅成功了，还使得这些原始民为这位首席科学家修筑了一座纪念碑。现在，这座金字塔式的建筑就巍然屹立在这颗星球表面，吸引着四面八方虔诚的朝圣者前来。
entries.en: According to this report: some time ago, a team descended to the [great_pyramid_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface intent on convincing the locals to worship their project lead as a kind of deity. Not only did they succeed, but the locals have since constructed a holy monument in dedication to this scientist. This vast, pyramidal structure now proudly attracts devoted pilgrims with splendid offerings from far and wide.

entries.zh: 这当然是创造历史的一种途径！
entries.en: That's certainly one way to make history!

entries.zh: [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]上的文明进入了下一时代。
entries.en: The civilization on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] is pushed into the next age.

entries.zh: 抹去我方行迹，继续工作。
entries.en: Erase all our traces and keep working.

entries.zh: 悄悄拆除§Y$building_great_pyramid$§!
entries.en: Quietly dismantle the §Y$building_great_pyramid$§!

entries.zh: 希望他们把这些事都忘了吧？
entries.en: Let us hope they forget all about it?

entries.zh: §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!上的混乱终于平息了，我们终于得以一览科研团队所引发的灾难性后果了。\n\n短时间内，这颗星球上的大多数人都被卷入了一场全面宗教战争，这是他们称为“天人”的科研团队短暂降临的直接后果。当其中一个交战方为自己的另一位新神修建了另一座金字塔后，争执化为了暴力。在这场宗教冲突中，许多[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都因此而亡。
entries.en: The chaos on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§! has at last reached a lull, revealing the full extent of our team's catastrophic intervention.\n\nIn a short span of time, large parts of the population broke out into all-out religious war - a direct consequence of the fleeting visitation by a figure they call 'the Skyborn One'. Arguments turned to violence when one of the warring factions constructed another pyramid to their new deity. Many [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] perished in the resulting deadly schism.

entries.zh: [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]上的§R200§!£pop£§H人口§!被消灭。
entries.en: §R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] are killed.

entries.zh: [great_pyramid_planet.GetName]上的§R100§!£pop£§H人口§!被消灭。
entries.en: §R100§! £pop£ §HPops§! on [great_pyramid_planet.GetName] are killed.

entries.zh: 尽管我们与当地社会发生了意外的接触，但§Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!上的事态还是渐渐平息的下来。我们在这的行动并不是灾难性的：反而，当地的人们认为所谓“天人”不过是神话传说，并将大金字塔用作一处特殊的科研基址。\n\n[great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName]达到此等文化和历史理解之迅速让我们的科学家们叹为观止。这也支持了[root.GetPreFTLLower]社会即使在不寻常的大事件面前，也能保持强大逻辑思考能力的论断。
entries.en: Things appear to have settled on §Y[great_pyramid_planet.GetName]§!, despite our unscheduled interference with the society dwelling there. Our actions here did not amount to disaster: instead the local population have decided that the "Skyborn One" was simply a myth, and designated the pyramid as a site of special scientific interest.\n\nThe sheer speed with which the [great_pyramid_country.GetSpeciesName] arrived at this cultural and historical understanding has fascinated our scientists. It suggests a great capacity for logical thinking among [root.GetPreFTLLower] societies, even when they are faced with extraordinary events.

entries.zh: 真是幸运。
entries.en: Lucky.

entries.zh: [From.GetSpeciesAdj]社会转变
entries.en: [From.GetSpeciesAdj] Societal Shift

entries.zh: 我们对[From.GetName]社会价值的转变工作正在向着利于我们的方向发展，并取得了不错的成果。
entries.en: Our efforts to shift the societal values of the [From.GetName] in a direction favored by us have produced favorable results.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的几大帝国在中心集权方面获得重大进展，行政力量集中在少数有实力的领袖手中。低效的狂躁大众统治正在渐渐淡出他们的社会。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nThe [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have made great strides in centralizing their various planetary governments, with political power redirected towards a few, capable leaders. The inefficiencies of mob rule are slowly being weeded out of their society.

entries.zh: 他们以后会感激我们的。
entries.en: They will thank us one day.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n我们小心翼翼地将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]推向了更民主的思想，而在我们到达之前，他们的世界还是原始的精英独裁型统治盛行。他们渐渐意识到了个人价值的重要性。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nWe have carefully nudged the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] towards more democratic ideals, in place of the primitive despotism that was prevalent on their world before we arrived. They are beginning to appreciate the value of the individual.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]越来越保守，对异族抱有越来越大的警惕。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nThe [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have begun turning inwards, becoming more and more wary of those they regard as strangers.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]渐渐开放，变得越来越容易能接受与他们文化迥然不同，曾被视为异族的外星人。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nThe [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are starting to open up, becoming more and more accepting and curious about all the things their people out of ignorance once considered alien and strange to their culture.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n我们发现[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的各帝国出现了发展军团为主社会的趋势。他们的军团变得更加训练有素。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nWe are seeing a definite movement towards a more militaristic society by the various [From.GetSpeciesAdj] governments. Their standing military forces, such as they are, have become more professional in nature.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n[From.Capital.GetName]上的多数[From.GetSpeciesAdj]帝国正在改掉他们好战的习性。[From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat]上似乎迎来了一个新的和平时代。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nMost of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] realms on [From.Capital.GetName] are abandoning their warlike ways. It looks like the beginning of a new era of peace on the [From.Capital.GetPlanetHabitat].

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n我们让[From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]领悟了他们之前所不理解的精神世界。他们终于有了信仰，他们的社会也因此更加充实。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nWe have opened the minds of the [From.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to a spiritual realm they never knew was there. They finally have something to believe in, and their society is all the richer for it.

entries.zh: $observation.3139.start.desc$\n破除荼毒[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]社会的迷茫和原始信仰的行动大获成功。他们开始意识到了科学与理性的价值。
entries.en: $observation.3139.start.desc$\nWe have made great strides in ridding the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] of the superstitions and primitive beliefs that plagued their society. They are beginning to see the value of science and rationality.

entries.zh: 亚空间回声
entries.en: Subspace Echoes

entries.zh: 我方的几处跟踪站都截获了一种奇怪的亚空间回声。声音来源于其他星系。回声刚开始时较弱，但后来逐渐变强，似乎有什么正在靠近我方星系……
entries.en: Several of our tracking stations have picked up peculiar subspace echoes coming from somewhere in intergalactic space. The echoes are faint but getting stronger, and they seem to be approaching our galaxy...

entries.zh: 新的风暴即将出现。
entries.en: A storm is on the horizon.

entries.zh: 接近星系外缘
entries.en: Approaching the Outer Rim

entries.zh: 我们在星系际空间探测到的奇怪亚空间回声现已接近我们的星系外缘。在回声主体前进的方向上似乎出现了一系列微小的联络信号，并指向许多的边缘恒星系。\n\n我们已经把这些星系坐标输入状态日志并将持续监控情况发展。
entries.en: The strange subspace echoes we detected in intergalactic space are now approaching the outer rim of our galaxy. Several smaller contacts appear to be racing ahead of the main body of echoes, towards a number of rim systems.\n\nWe have entered the positions of these systems into the Situation Log and will continue to monitor the situation.

entries.zh: 他们即将降临……
entries.en: They are almost upon us...

entries.zh: 亚空间信号
entries.en: Subspace Signal

entries.zh: 我们接收到了席卷整个星系的强烈亚空间信号！信号源似乎正是来自此前位于星系际空间的联络。
entries.en: We are picking up a strong subspace signal washing over the galaxy! Its point of origin appears to be the contacts approaching from intergalactic space.

entries.zh: 进行影像交流。
entries.en: Establish visual feed.

entries.en: Main screen off.

entries.zh: 第一波接触
entries.en: The First Wave

entries.zh:
我们收到的资料显示一些位于星系边缘的恒星系正在被某种入侵势力蹂蹑。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。目前为止，接踵而至的报告都令人十分困惑，入侵者所使用的舰船似乎是由有机质构成，并且入侵者暂未对我们做出任何回应。

我们整个星系或将面对史无前例的入侵。
entries.en:
We have received word that several outlying systems along the galactic rim are being overrun by some sort of invasion force. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard - the main body of contacts has yet to arrive. Reports have so far been confused, but the "ships" used by the invaders appear organic in nature and do not respond to hails.

Our entire galaxy may be facing an invasion of unprecedented scope.

entries.zh:
来自边缘外围恒星系的报告令人不寒而栗，那里有一支入侵实力正在横扫群星。这似乎就是我们探测到的，之前不断接近我们星系的亚空间回声本体。

我们现在遭遇到的只是先锋，其主体尚未到来。但这些实体已经让人感觉不对劲了。它们的形体仿佛是一种是对生命的畸形嘲弄，带着一种不可理喻的渴望跳动着。它们不交流，不寻求理解——只吞噬一切。

我们已熟悉活体星舰的低语，也就是舰船和主体之间的纽带。而这些东西呢？他们是真正意义上的异类。星系面临的不仅仅是侵略者。它正面临着本不应该存在的一种饥渴。
entries.en:
Reports from our outlying systems along the galactic rim are dire, an invasion force is sweeping across the stars. This appears to have been the source of the subspace echoes we detected approaching our galaxy.

What we are encountering now is only the vanguard. The true mass of the incursion has yet to arrive. But already, something about these entities feels wrong. Their forms are grotesque mockeries of life, pulsing with a hunger we do not recognize. They do not communicate, do not seek understanding - only consumption.

We have long known the whisper of living starships, the bond between vessel and master. But these things? They are alien in the truest sense. The galaxy is not facing mere invaders. It is facing a hunger that should not exist.

entries.zh: 愿众神保佑我们……
entries.en: Spirits protect us...

entries.zh: 将消息传达给所有舰队指挥官。
entries.en: Brief all fleet commanders.

entries.zh: 必须近距离研究这些生物。
entries.en: These creatures must be studied closer.

entries.zh: 真的无法与他们进行理论吗？
entries.en: Are we sure they can't be reasoned with?

entries.zh: 这将损害我们的利润……
entries.en: This will cut into our profit margins...

entries.zh: 黑暗即将来临。
entries.en: Dark days lie ahead.

entries.zh: 可恶的外星生物，一定要把它们统统干掉。
entries.en: These wretched xenos will be purged.

entries.zh: 真是令人着迷……系外的生命体。
entries.en: Fascinating... alien life from beyond our galaxy.

entries.zh: 他们的思维是完全统一的。真神奇。
entries.en: They act as a single mind. Remarkable.

entries.zh: 这对任何有感知的生物来说都是个威胁。
entries.en: This is a threat to all sapient life.

entries.zh: 第二波接触
entries.en: The Second Wave

entries.zh: 我们已经无法从星系的背景辐射中分辨出亚空间回声的主体，这只意味着一件事情……他们已经到来。\n\n如果以他们先锋的规模作为参考，那么这些入侵者的军队数量将是无比巨大的。
entries.en: We are no longer able to discern the main body of approaching subspace echoes from our own galaxy's background radiation, which can mean only one thing... they have arrived.\n\nIf the size of their vanguard is any indication, the main host of these invaders must be massive.

entries.zh: 他们来了……
entries.en: They are here...

entries.en: There must be some way for us to co-exist in peace!

entries.zh: 显然，这次我们对付的种群可不一般。
entries.en: This is clearly an important species we're dealing with.

entries.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
entries.en: Can there be peace between us?

entries.zh: §R不接受和平。我们必须进食。\n\n只有吞噬了这个星系，才能继续我们那漫长的旅途。§!
entries.en: §RNO PEACE. WE MUST FEED.\n\nONLY WHEN WE HAVE FINISHED CONSUMING THIS GALAXY SHALL WE DEPART TO CONTINUE OUR LONG JOURNEY.§!

entries.zh: 你的意识与我们同在。我们为何不能共存？
entries.en: Your Mind is as ours. Can we not coexist?

entries.zh: §R我们已经吞噬了无数的意识。我们将继续不断吞噬无数。\n\n你们的生物质将为我们的漫长旅途提供养分。§!
entries.en: §RWE HAVE FED ON COUNTLESS MINDS. WE WILL FEED ON COUNTLESS MORE.\n\nYOUR BIOMASS WILL NOURISH US FOR THE LONG JOURNEY.§!

entries.zh: 你口中的“猎人”到底是什么人？
entries.en: Who are these "Hunters" you speak of?

entries.zh: §R是死神。他们已经将我方消灭殆尽，连我们这群最后的幸存者，也被他们追杀了无数个纪元。\n\n他们终有一天会找到这里。我们必须尽快进食，以便在他们到来之前再次遁入宇宙的黑暗之中继续潜逃。§!
entries.en: §RDEATH. THEY HAVE MADE US THE LAST OF OUR KIND, AND THEY HAVE HUNTED US, THE SURVIVORS, FOR EONS.\n\nTHEY WILL COME HERE ONE DAY. WE MUST FEED UNTIL THEN, SO THAT WE CAN FLEE BACK INTO THE DARKNESS BETWEEN GALAXIES WHEN THEY ARRIVE.§!

entries.zh: 那“普雷索林”是什么意思呢？
entries.en: What does "Prethoryn" mean?

entries.zh: §R是幸存者的意思。我们这些幸存者是整个种群最后的希望了。§!
entries.en: §RSURVIVORS. WE ARE THE LAST.§!

entries.zh: 我们会把你们从星系中清除掉。
entries.en: We will scour this galaxy of your kind.

entries.zh: 我们将消灭你的意识。
entries.en: We will silence your Mind.

entries.zh: §R这话我们以前可没少听。哈哈哈！\n\n猎人会消灭世间万物。在这个残酷的现实面前，你们那区区威胁又算得了什么？§!
entries.en: §RWE HAVE HEARD THIS BEFORE. HA! HA! HA!\n\nTHE HUNTERS WILL SCOUR ALL OF CREATION. WHAT IS YOUR EMPTY THREAT IN THE FACE OF SUCH TRUTHS?§!

entries.zh: 新势力
entries.en: A New Order

entries.zh: 一个同索林原虫进行战斗的军事组织最近在星系崭露头角。这个组织的成员似乎主要由无家可归、受尽蹂躏的人组成——难民、退役军人、以及其他在虫灾冲击中失去一切的人。\n\n尽管如此，他们拼凑出来的舰队仍旧设法在几场同索林原虫猎杀群的战斗中取胜。有些未证实的报告称他们的舰队中有一些设计奇特的战舰……
entries.en: Some kind of militant order dedicated towards fighting the Prethoryn has surfaced in the galaxy. Their membership seems to be made up primarily of the dispossessed and downtrodden - refugees, war veterans and others who have lost everything to the onslaught of the Scourge.\n\nDespite this, their ramshackle fleets have somehow managed to win several engagements against Prethoryn hunter-killer swarms. There are unconfirmed reports that their fleets include starships of unusual design...

entries.zh: 这些人到底是什么来历？
entries.en: Who are these people?

entries.zh: 我们是哨兵。我们的教团已宣誓无论付出任何代价也要阻止嗜血的索林原虫。其他帝国放弃抵抗之时，我们仍旧坚持斗争。他们向虫灾缴械投降时，我们会给予他们反击的手段。\n\n我是克加斯大团长，教团的首席。不要以貌取人——哨兵教团从星系中所有种族，包括你的种族——招兵买马。我们只希望你们的政府能够坚持对抗索林原虫的入侵，并在可能时支持我们。
entries.en: We are the Sentinels. Our order has sworn to halt the murderous rampage of the Prethoryn no matter the cost. Where other empires crumble, we stand firm. Where they abandon their own to the Scourge, we give them the means to fight back.\n\nI am Grand Master Korgas, the first of our order. Do not be deceived by my appearance - Sentinels are recruited from all species in the galaxy, including yours. We ask only that your government keep up the fight against the Prethoryn and support our Sentinels where possible.

entries.zh: 你们是如何成功抵御虫族的？
entries.en: How are you able to fight back?

entries.zh: 许多哨兵都拥有军旅背景。我们来自于一系列在与索林原虫虫群作战中战败的不同舰队的幸存者。作为哨兵，我们已从过去的错误中汲取教训并且努力工作以免类似的情况再次发生。\n\n同样地，相信我已经提到过，我们招募的人员来自星系的所有种族。其中也包括了那些古老的种族，例如[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们得到了 §H[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]§!的几个有影响力的派系支持，他们不希望看到自己的星系被虫群吞噬。他们为我们的事业捐赠了船只和资源。
entries.en: Many Sentinels have military backgrounds. We are survivors from a dozen different fleets that fought the Prethoryn and lost. As Sentinels, we have learned from the mistakes of the past and work hard never to repeat them.\n\nAlso, I believe I mentioned that we recruit from all species in the galaxy. This includes the elder races, such as the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We have the support of several influential factions within the §H[sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName]§! who have no wish to see their galaxy devoured. They have donated both ships and resources to our cause.

entries.zh: 你们的大本营在哪里？
entries.en: Where are you based?

entries.zh: 我们正在[sentinel_system.GetName]星系建立主基地。这个隐秘的星系坐标是[fallen_empire.GetName]提供的，他们还帮助我们建设位于护卫舰α星上的主基地。我认为这是十分了不起的成就。同时，我们也建立了自己的船坞。
entries.en: For some time now we have been building up our headquarters in the §H[sentinel_system.GetName]§! system. The coordinates of this uncharted system were given to us by the [sentinel_fallen_empire.GetName], who also aided in the construction of our main base on §HSentinel Alpha§!.\n\nIt is quite a remarkable achievement, if I may say so. We have our own shipyards as well.

entries.zh: 再会了。
entries.en: Goodbye.

entries.zh: 坚持战斗，我亲爱的朋友们。我们整个星系的命运前途未卜。\n\n哨兵一号，完毕。
entries.en: Keep up the fight, dear friends. The fate of our entire galaxy hangs in the balance.\n\nSentinel One out.

entries.zh: 我们星系的未来只有两条路可以走：要么虫群天灾消灭这个星系里所有的有机生命，然后继续他们毁灭的进程，要么我们将那些卑鄙的生物消灭得一干二净。
entries.en: Our galaxy is faced with two possible futures: either the Prethoryn Scourge consumes all organic life and moves on, or they are destroyed to the last of their despicable kind.

entries.zh: 我们必须加倍努力对抗虫灾。这场战争关乎整个星系的命运。
entries.en: We must redouble our efforts against the Scourge. This is a struggle that involves the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 现在国与国之间的争斗已经没有任何意义了。用飞船来对付自己人而不是虫族，简直就是莫大的浪费。
entries.en: Conflicts between nations are pointless now. Any warships that are lost in battle to anyone or anything other than the Scourge must be considered an incredible waste.

entries.zh: 不要失去希望。我们的星系仍然有机会胜利。
entries.en: Do not lose hope. The battle for our galaxy can still be won.

entries.zh: 如果你们无法与虫灾正面对抗，可以将资源捐助给我们。这样可以增强我们的兵力，以对抗那些索林原虫入侵者。
entries.en: If you lack the means to fight the Scourge directly, you are more than welcome to donate resources to us. This will let us throw additional forces against the Prethoryn invaders.

entries.zh: 关于虫族，你们知道多少？
entries.en: What can you tell us about the Prethoryn?

entries.zh: 诶，我们所知道的也不多，但是可以肯定的是他们源于星系之外。他们很有可能在来到我们的星系前摧毁了数十甚至上百的星系…或也许我们是第一个受害者。\n\n在他们完成对整个星球上所有非索林原虫生命的屠戮后，他们将星球转化成了只能用扭曲的噩梦来形容的地狱。其他一切生命形式在这些孵化星球上都无法存活，想要净化星球只有一个办法，那就是用强烈的轨道轰炸烧光整个生物圈。
entries.en: Alas, we don't know as much as we would like, but they are clearly extragalactic in origin. It is possible that they have devoured dozens or even hundreds of other galaxies before they reached ours... or we could be the first victims beyond their own home galaxy.\n\nAfter they have finished consuming all non-Prethoryn life on a planet, they terraform it into what can only be described as a twisted nightmare. These Infested Worlds are hostile to all other forms of life, and the only way to cleanse the infestation is to burn away the entire biosphere with intense orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: 我们愿意捐助。（1000能源）
entries.en: We would like to offer a donation. (1000 energy)

entries.zh: 我们感谢您的慷慨捐赠。这些资源可以为我们装备一整支用来对抗虫灾的舰队！若更多国家也如您一般的慷慨，这场战争将会很快结束。
entries.en: Thank you for this generous donation. These resources will enable us to outfit an entire battle fleet for use in the war against the Scourge! If only more of the galaxy's nations shared your generosity, the war would soon be over.

entries.zh: 我想你们也是知道的，现代化的飞船需要大量的能源进行维持。我们需要1000能量币才能组建一支新的战斗群来应付虫灾。
entries.en: As you are surely aware, outfitting a modern battle fleet requires a vast amount of resources. We will require no less than 1000 energy to put together a new strike group for use against the Scourge.

entries.zh: 十分遗憾，我们现在无法接受你方的捐助。我们的舰队数量已经超标，后勤部门已经不堪重负了。但不管怎么，我们还是感谢你们慷慨解囊。
entries.en: We regret that we cannot accept your donation at the moment, friends. Our burgeoning fleets have already strained our logistics system to its limit. The offer is much appreciated, however.

entries.zh: 再会了。
entries.en: Goodbye.

entries.zh: 战争仍会继续。护卫舰一号，完毕。
entries.en: The struggle continues. Sentinel One signing off.

entries.zh: 哨兵对于你们抵抗虫群天灾的英勇事迹十分赞赏。既然[Root.GetName]的舰队指挥官已经掌握了克敌制胜的诀窍，我们希望将自己的舰队之一永久交予你方。我方目前人力不足，无法将舰队的威力发挥到最大，但对你们来说这应该不成问题。\n\n不过你们一定要郑重承诺，只把这些舰船用来对抗虫灾！
entries.en: The Sentinels have taken note of your valiant struggle against the Prethoryn Scourge. Since the fleet commanders of the [Root.GetName] clearly know how to win battles, we would like to permanently transfer one of our battle fleets over to your control. We currently lack the manpower to effectively crew these vessels, but that shouldn't be a problem for you.\n\nYou must solemnly promise to only use these warships against the Scourge, however!

entries.zh: 当然……我们只会用来对抗虫灾。
entries.en: Of course... only against the Scourge.

entries.zh: 很好。我们相信，你们英勇的舰长将会与这些伟大飞船一起永载史册。我们会把舰队送到[Root.Capital.GetName]附近。
entries.en: Excellent. We are certain that your brave captains will add to the storied histories of these magnificent warships. You will find the fleet near [Root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们不需要你们的飞船。
entries.en: We have no need of your warships.

entries.zh: 那也没有关系。我们只希望你们能够继续战斗。每消灭一只虫族，我们离胜利也就更进一步。
entries.en: We understand. Then we ask only that you keep up the fight, friends. Every wretched Prethoryn that you blow out of the stars is a victory for the entire galaxy.

entries.zh: 受伤的虫后
entries.en: The Wounded Queen

entries.zh: 我们的一架深空侦察探机闯入了一处位于[queen_system.GetName]的战场余骸，这场战斗的双方是索林虫族和某未知势力。一只索林原虫虫后似乎在战斗之后受了重伤，被抛弃在此，任其自生自灭。\n\n用于侦察的探机汇报称，虫后仍一息尚存。现在是难得一遇的活捉虫后的好机会。
entries.en: A deep space spy drone has stumbled upon the site of what appears to have been a recent space battle between the Prethoryn and a second, as yet unidentified, party in the [queen_system.GetName] system. A Prethoryn Queen was badly injured in the fighting, and seems to have been left for dead.\n\nThe spy drone has reported that the creature is still alive, however. This could be a priceless opportunity to capture the Queen alive.

entries.zh: 派遣一支考察队过去。
entries.en: Perhaps we should send an expedition.

entries.zh: 虫后万岁！
entries.en: Long live the Queen!

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]治愈了索林原虫虫后的几处重伤。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]切除了虫后用来与同族联系的器官，并替换为小型正电子植入体，完全控制了虫后。\n\n现在虫后任由我们差遣，肚子里也正在孕育索林原虫的幼体。这些幼体只会听命于这只虫后，也就是说，只会听命于我们。只要虫后活着，我们就能培育出大量被驯化的索林原虫大军！
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] has managed to heal the worst of the Prethoryn Queen's injuries. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] removed the organ responsible for the creature's subspace connection with the rest of the Scourge, and replaced it with a small positronic implant that gives us control over it.\n\nWe can now order the Queen around, and it has already started breeding new Prethoryn creatures that are loyal to it, and thus, by extension, us. As long as we can keep the Queen alive, we should be able to grow a fleet of domesticated Prethoryn creatures!

entries.zh: 想必这会是有用的战力！
entries.en: They should prove an extremely useful asset!

entries.zh: 虫后被抢走
entries.en: Someone Else Got The Queen

entries.zh: 我们在[queen_system_1.GetName]星系发现的受伤的索林原虫虫后不幸被别人抢走了！他们在治愈了虫后之后，又切断了虫后用来与同族联系的器官。这下虫后可完全听命于他们了。报告还称，虫后已经在孕育幼虫了。
entries.en: Someone else has captured the injured Prethoryn Queen that was discovered in the [queen_system_1.GetName] system! The creature has not only been fully healed, but its connection to the rest of the Scourge has been severed. It now serves its new masters, and reports suggest that it has already started a new brood.

entries.zh: 我们果然还是去晚了！
entries.en: We were too slow!

entries.zh: 虫灾终平
entries.en: The End of the Scourge

entries.zh: 随着最后一批虫群天灾被消灭，整个宇宙都松了一口气。它们的跨星系入侵已经完全失败，索林原虫曾遮天蔽日的虫群如今也只留下了不计其数的被烈焰灼过的尸体，在虚空中无声飘荡。\n\n轻松与愉快的气息以超光速散播到整个宇宙，无数星球都开始自发举办活动庆祝这一伟大胜利。也许，我们可以借助这一契机，翻开宇宙和平稳定的新篇章？
entries.en: The galaxy breathed a collective sigh of relief today, as the last significant pockets of the Prethoryn Scourge were expunged. Their extragalactic invasion has failed, and all that remains of the Prethoryn's once colossal swarm are the innumerable charred husks that now drift quietly through the void.\n\nA sense of elation and utter joy is spreading across the galaxy at a speed greater than light, and spontaneous victory celebrations have erupted on countless worlds. Could this be the beginning of a new age of galactic peace and stability?

entries.zh: 这些不敬的生物，早死早完。
entries.en: Those profane creatures will not be missed.

entries.zh: 他们是可敬的对手。
entries.en: They were worthy opponents.

entries.zh: 他们的有机科技真是十分有趣啊。
entries.en: Their organic technology was most intriguing.

entries.zh: 总算为这毫无意义的好斗画上了一个句号。
entries.en: Finally an end to all this senseless violence.

entries.zh: 那些生物有损我们的生意。
entries.en: Those critters were bad for business.

entries.zh: 这还有待观察。
entries.en: We shall see.

entries.zh: 真是我们有史以来遭遇的最恶毒的外星种群啊。
entries.en: One of the vilest xeno breeds we've had the misfortune to encounter.

entries.zh: 真是悲剧。他们可是十分独特的生命体呢。
entries.en: Tragic in a way. They were a unique form of life.

entries.zh: 虚空之洞
entries.en: Hole in the Void

entries.zh: 我们抓到的索林原虫虫后在前几个月里变得越来越暴躁不安。起先我们以为它只不过是因为与其他同类失去了联络，但后来我们的[get.telepaths.plural]收到了它的通讯，说着什么“虚空之洞”云云。\n\n我们在研究索林原虫的跨星系旅行方法、并在天文数据库中发现了一个差异时才明白它说的到底是什么意思。绘制索林原虫可能走过的路径的过程中，我们发现一个距离我们大约3000万光年的小螺旋星系不见了。
entries.en: Over the last few months, the Prethoryn Queen we captured has appeared increasingly restless and uneasy. At first, we thought it was simply missing its connection with the rest of its kind, until our [get.telepaths.plural] received a communication from it, speaking of a 'Hole in the Void'.\n\nWhat it meant by this we found out only when we researched Prethoryn intergalactic travel methods and discovered a discrepancy in our astronomical database. While charting the likely path the Prethoryn had been following, we found that a small spiral galaxy some 30 million light-years distant from our own was missing.

entries.zh:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

那个星系我们曾在太空时代早期发现并研究过，但现在已经不再发出任何可被我们仪器探测到的光。这一意料之外的奇特发现让我们的科学家们争先恐后地想解释到底是什么东西导致了整个星系从宇宙中消失。

目前有两种解释：要么是星系中的恒星突然全部熄灭，要么是有某种东西，某种大得足以遮蔽整个星系的东西，挡住了它照射过来的光。这两种理论似乎都难以置信，许多人谴责它们荒唐可笑，并且更倾向于认为这个消失的星系本就不存在，只是是由于对原始望远镜的错误使用而产生的。尽管如此，整个事件透着一种明显的恐惧和噩兆……
entries.en:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

The galaxy, discovered and studied during the early space era of our species, is simply no longer emanating any form of light observable by our instruments. This bizarre and unexpected discovery sent our scientists into a scramble to try and explain what could cause an entire galaxy to simply vanish from the sky.

Two explanations emerged: Either the stars of the galaxy simply went out, all at once, or there is something, something so vast as to eclipse an entire galaxy, blocking its light from reaching us. Both theories seem equally implausible, and many have simply decried them as ludicrous, preferring to think that the missing galaxy never existed at all, invented by some erroneous use of a primitive telescope. Nonetheless, a palpable sense of dread and foreboding surrounds the whole incident...

entries.zh:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

从我们的太空时代早期开始，这个星系就被记录在案，但我们再也无法通过仪器观察到它发出任何形式的光。进一步的调查得出了两种可能的解释。

要么是星系中的恒星同时熄灭，要么是一个巨大到足以遮蔽星系这么大空间区域的实体挡住了光源。这两种解释都违背了正常的逻辑，然而，除非有明显的相反证据，否则无法排除这两种可能性。
entries.en:
$crisis.234.desc.intro$

The galaxy in question has been documented in our records since the early space era of our species, but we are no longer able to observe it emanating any form of light through our instruments. Further investigation has yielded two possible explanations.

Either the stars of the galaxy in question have simultaneously extinguished, or an entity vast enough to eclipse a galaxy-sized region of space is blocking the light source. Both explanations defy conventional logic, however we cannot rule out these possibilities without significant proof to the contrary.

entries.zh: 令人不安。
entries.en: Disturbing.

entries.zh: $ACKNOWLEDGED$
entries.en: $ACKNOWLEDGED$

entries.zh: 破界者
entries.en: The Unbidden

entries.zh: [extradimensional_system.GetName]星系出现了巨大的空间裂缝！虽然我们还不知道原因，但这似乎是另一个次元的单向传送门。奇怪的飞船从裂缝中蜂拥而出，无论见到什么都大肆攻击。这似乎预告着一场大型进攻宣战的来临。我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
entries.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space itself has appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system! We aren't certain what caused it, but the tear acts as some kind of one-way portal from another dimension. Fleets of strange vessels are pouring out, attacking everything in sight. This looks like the beginning of a major invasion!\n\nWe have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

entries.zh: 真有意思……来自高维的生命体。
entries.en: Fascinating... life from another dimension.

entries.zh: 他们看起来组织有序。
entries.en: They seem well organized.

entries.zh: 星系能源波动
entries.en: Galactic Power Surge

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]中所有仪器突然全数感应到了巨大的亚空间能源波动，其源头就在我们星系之中。我们的科学家也难以解释其中原因——这种奇异现象可是前所未见。源头的具体位置尚不明确，我们仍在继续分析现有数据。
entries.en: Instruments across the [Root.GetName] have suddenly picked up a subspace power surge of massive proportions coming from somewhere within our galaxy. Our scientists are struggling to come up with an explanation for this event - nothing of its like has ever been recorded.\n\nThe exact origin point of this sudden power surge has yet to be identified, but we are still in the process of analyzing the available data.

entries.zh: 继续调查。
entries.en: Keep at it.

entries.zh: 我们已经对之前检测到的巨大能源波完成了甄别。它来源于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系中一个巨大的亚空间裂缝。奇怪的飞船从传送门中蜂拥而出，初步报告显示，这些飞船会对接触到的任何事物发动无差别的攻击。\n\n我方截获了这些飞船发往传送门另一边的一段高能信号。听起来……像是狩猎的哨音一样。
entries.en: The source of the massive power surge we detected earlier has been identified. It comes from some kind of gigantic subspace tear in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. Fleets of strange spacecraft are pouring out of this dimensional portal, and early reports speak of indiscriminate attacks against everyone coming into contact with them.\n\nWe have intercepted a powerful signal being sent from the arriving vessels to somewhere on the other side of the portal. It sounds like... a hunting call.

entries.zh: 截获的信号
entries.en: Intercepted Transmission

entries.zh: ……到达觅食区域……猎物很多……终于……可以大吃一顿……
entries.en: ...feeding ground reached... prey bountiful... at long last... we shall feast...

entries.zh: 这些东西到底是什么？
entries.en: What are these things?

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]殖民地被毁
entries.en: [Root.GetName] Lost

entries.zh: 不惜一切代价阻止那些怪物！
entries.en: Those monsters must be stopped!

entries.zh: 异次元传送门被摧毁
entries.en: Dimensional Portal Destroyed

entries.zh: 位于[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的高维传送门已经被摧毁了！这些可恶的高维入侵者没法再叫来援兵了。摧毁了传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
entries.en: The dimensional portal in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! This means that the extradimensional invaders can no longer receive reinforcements from their twisted realm.\n\nWith the destruction of this portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy. The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

entries.zh: 星系更加安全了
entries.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

entries.zh: 第一传送门已摧毁
entries.en: First Portal Destroyed

entries.zh: 异次元入侵者最初的入侵点已经被摧毁了。\n\n$crisis.1116.not_last_portal$
entries.en: The initial breaching point that was used by the extradimensionals to invade our galaxy has been destroyed.\n\n$crisis.1116.not_last_portal$

entries.zh: 绝不心慈手软。
entries.en: We must not relent.

entries.zh: 第二传送门已摧毁
entries.en: Second Portal Destroyed

entries.zh: 出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第二传送门也被摧毁了！高维入侵者已经无法用此传送门呼叫援兵了。
entries.en: The second dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system has been destroyed! It can no longer be used by the extradimensionals to reinforce their numbers.

entries.zh: 摧毁了最后一个传送门后，这场战争终于迎来了胜利的曙光。星系中的广大民众都在欢呼雀跃。
entries.en: With the destruction of the last portal, the end of these invasions is finally in sight. A profound sense of elation has settled over most of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 同时，[portal_killer.GetName]也倍受称赞，因为他们的飞船给了传送门最后一击。他们的英雄事迹将被代代传颂。
entries.en: The [portal_killer.GetName] has won much admiration, since it was their ships that struck the final blow against the portal. The crews of those vessels will be celebrated as heroes for generations to come.

entries.zh: 但是，我们现在还不能松懈，一定要确保所有的传送门都被摧毁。只有摧毁所有传送门，才能彻底切断两个次元之间的联系。
entries.en: We cannot rest easy, however, until every single portal has been destroyed. Only then will the connection between our dimension and theirs be permanently severed.

entries.zh: 出现在[extradimensional_system.GetName]星系的第三传送门也不复存在了。高维入侵者已经无法用传送门连接两个次元了。
entries.en: The third dimensional portal that appeared in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system is no more. It will no longer be used by the extradimensionals to bridge the gap between their realm and ours.

entries.zh: 第三传送门已摧毁
entries.en: Third Portal Destroyed

...prey...

entries.zh: ……屈膝于……我们的荣耀吧……
entries.en: ...behold... our glory...
...nourishment...

entries.zh: ……这一存在……见识过虚境……
entries.en: ...this one... has seen into the Shroud...

entries.zh: ……它被虚境……触碰过……
entries.en: ...it has been touched... by the Shroud...

entries.zh: ……这一存在……据有着能力……它可以看见……
entries.en: ...there is... power... in this one... it can SEE...

entries.zh: ……合成体……
entries.en: ...synthetic beings...

entries.zh: 显示屏关闭。
entries.en: View screen off.

entries.zh: ……吃掉你们……
entries.en: ...you will be consumed...

entries.zh: ……拆掉你们的机械身躯……
entries.en: ...disintegrate your metal flesh...

entries.zh: 我们之间难道不可以和平相处吗？
entries.en: Can there be peace between us?

entries.zh: ……和平……不可能……
entries.en: ...peace... no peace...

entries.zh: 你们会后悔来到这个次元的。
entries.en: You picked the wrong dimension to invade.

entries.zh: ……不……这个次元……很美好……猎物很多……
entries.en: ...no... this dimension... is glorious... so much prey...

entries.zh: 你们这些外星物种真是恶心。
entries.en: You are just another type of wretched xeno.

entries.zh: ……仇恨……恐惧……这感觉……太美妙了……
entries.en: ...so much hatred... so much fear... it is... wonderful...

entries.zh: 介绍一下你们。让我们互相了解一下吧。
entries.en: Tell us about yourselves. Help us understand you.

entries.zh: ……了解……你们……是食物……
entries.en: ...understand... this... you are food...

entries.zh: 你们来自某个存在的更高位面吗？
entries.en: Do you come from a higher plane of existence?

entries.zh: ……没错……非常高……
entries.en: ...yes... very high...

entries.zh: 你们是从虚境来的吗？
entries.en: Are you from the Shroud?

entries.zh: ……虚境……我们听说过……离我们的家园很近……很近……
entries.en: ...the Shroud... we know of it... it is close to where we come from... very close...

entries.zh: ……能讲话？
entries.en: ...it speaks?

entries.zh: ……这些颜色真美……
entries.en: ...look at all the pretty colors...

entries.zh: ……一定要……汲取……
entries.en: ...must... feed...

entries.zh: ……沙达衮……你怎么在这……
entries.en: ...shadagon... why are you here...

entries.zh: 显示屏关闭。
entries.en: View screen off.

entries.zh: ……交出你们的……能量……
entries.en: ...surrender your... energy...

entries.zh: ……王座……一定要保住……王座……
entries.en: ...the throne... must preserve... the throne...

entries.zh: ……必须……觅食……
entries.en: ...must... consume...

entries.zh: ……去死吧……
显示屏关闭。
entries.en: View screen off.

entries.zh: ……真是……傲慢……
entries.en: ...such... insolence...

entries.zh: 第二道传送门
entries.en: A Second Portal

entries.zh: 我方仪器又侦测到了新的亚空间能源波，这次的源头位于[second_portal_system.GetName]星系！那里又出现了一个巨大的虫洞，从能源特征来看，这与我们星系中出现的传送门十分相似。看来入侵者打开了第二个通向他们界域的传送门，想要搬运来更多的援军。
entries.en: Our instruments have detected a new subspace power surge, this time coming from the [second_portal_system.GetName] system! A second massive wormhole has appeared, and its energy signature appears to be almost identical to that of the first dimensional rift which opened in our galaxy.\n\nIt looks like the mysterious invaders have opened a second gateway to their realm through which they can send even more reinforcements.

entries.zh: 事态变得更糟了。
entries.en: This has gone from bad to worse.

entries.zh: 背道者
entries.en: The Aberrant

entries.zh: 从第二个虫洞中出来的飞船和之前的非常相似，但仍然有几处细微的不同。据报告称，这些新来的飞船竟和之前的入侵者打起来了！我们也从第二个虫洞处截获了强大的信号。
entries.en: The ships that have been emerging from the second wormhole are very similar to the ones that came from the first, but there are several subtle differences between them. Furthermore, early reports indicate that ships belonging to these new invaders have clashed with those of the first group!\n\nWe have intercepted a powerful signal emanating from the second wormhole.

entries.zh: 放出来听听。
entries.en: Put it on.

entries.zh: ……沙巴纳什……原来你们逃到了这里……休想躲到这个次元……我们会干掉你们，占据觅食区……
entries.en: ...shabanash... so this is where you ran... this realm will offer you no shelter... we shall deal with you, and then claim this feeding ground for ourselves...

entries.zh: 显示屏关闭。
entries.en: View screen off.

entries.zh: 狂热者
entries.en: The Vehement

entries.zh: [third_portal_system.GetName]星系出现了第三个维度之门！这一个是哪来的？我们接收到了从那边来的传送。
entries.en: A third dimensional portal has appeared in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system! Who does this one belong to?\n\nWe are picking up a transmission coming from the other side of it.

entries.zh: 又来一个？
entries.en: Another one?
