entries.en: $FLEET_MANEUVERS_1_PROJECT_DESC$

entries.zh: 舰队演习取消
entries.en: Fleet Maneuvers Canceled

entries.zh: 主力舰队的演习计划已被取消。舰队长时间未能进入预定地点，这严重影响到整个舰队的战备水平。
entries.en: The plans to hold a major fleet exercise have been canceled. Continuous delays in moving the allocated forces into position means that to proceed now would seriously impair the readiness level of the entire fleet.

entries.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]被卷入一场战争，原本的舰队演习计划取消，我们的舰队得到战场上历练去了。
entries.en: As the [Root.GetName] is now involved in a shooting war, the major fleet exercise we had planned has been canceled. Our naval crews will have to gain experience on the field of battle instead.

entries.zh: 战火试炼。
entries.en: Trial by fire.

entries.zh: [exercise_system.GetName]的舰队活动
entries.en: Naval Activity in [exercise_system.GetName]

entries.zh: 我们已经收到了[From.Owner.GetName]大量的舰队活动情报报告。他们集中在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系，似乎接近我们的边界。[From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]想要做什么？
entries.en: We have received intelligence reports of significant fleet movements within the [From.Owner.GetName]. They seem to be centered on the [exercise_system.GetName] system - suspiciously close to our border. What are the [From.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] up to?

entries.zh: 继续监测情况。
entries.en: Continue monitoring the situation.

entries.zh: 舰队演习：碰撞
entries.en: Fleet Maneuvers: Collisions

entries.zh: 根据指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]所制定的演习计划，目前我们的舰队正在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行演习。在演习期间，发生了几次军舰之间的碰撞事故。所幸船员伤亡极少，相关军舰也没有遭受严重损伤，不过受损舰船仍需要进行修复。
entries.en: The complex maneuvers devised by Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] have resulted in several minor collisions during the naval drills currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Crew casualties were minimal and none of the involved ships suffered critical damage, but they will require some yard work upon the conclusion of the exercise.

entries.zh: 至少没有损失军舰。
entries.en: At least no ships were lost.

entries.zh: 我们的几艘军舰因碰撞而受到损伤。
entries.en: Several of our ships have sustained damage from collisions.

entries.zh: 舰队演习：军舰损失
entries.en: Fleet Maneuvers: Ships Lost

entries.zh: 当舰队在[exercise_system.GetName]进行演习时，[destroyed_ship_1.GetName]和[destroyed_ship_2.GetName]军舰意外高速相撞。两艘军舰的船员全部遇难，我们心情沉重，已将这个消息通知了他们的家属。
entries.en: The [destroyed_ship_1.GetName] and the [destroyed_ship_2.GetName] were both tragically lost with all hands when the two starships collided during a high-speed maneuver that was part of the ongoing [exercise_system.GetName] naval drills. Next of kin have been notified.

entries.zh: 令人悲伤的一天。
entries.en: A sad day.

entries.zh: 我们的两艘军舰因意外相撞而损失。
entries.en: Two of our ships have been lost due to an accidental collision.

entries.zh: 舰队演习：优秀军官
entries.en: Fleet Maneuvers: Promising Officer

entries.zh: [officer_ship.GetName]的舰长[exercise_officer.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习中表现了其出色的能力。这位军官表现出极强的领导才能，军方高层认为应立即提拔[exercise_officer.GetHerHim]为舰队司令。
entries.en: Captain [exercise_officer.GetName] of the [officer_ship.GetName] has shown a great deal of promise during the ongoing fleet exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The young officer has displayed initiative along with considerable leadership abilities, and the Admiralty has seen fit to immediately promote [exercise_officer.GetHerHim] to flag rank.

entries.zh: 舰队总会需要有能力的指挥官。
entries.en: The fleet is always in need of capable commanders.

entries.zh: 指挥官[exercise_officer.GetName]现已待命。
entries.en: Commander [exercise_officer.GetName] is available for assignment.

entries.zh: 舰队演习：公众利益
entries.en: Fleet Maneuvers: Public Interest

entries.zh: 在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习吸引了[Root.Capital.GetName]和各个殖民地上相当多的媒体关注。非秘密的全息影像全面的展示了[Root.GetName]舰队勇士的英姿，无数的志愿者因此涌向了我们的征兵站点！
entries.en: The ongoing naval drills in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have attracted considerable media attention on [Root.Capital.GetName] and the colonies. Unclassified holo recordings showing some of the more dramatic maneuvers have made the public enamored with the valiant defenders of the [Root.GetName] serving in the fleet. Volunteers are flocking to our naval recruitment stations!

entries.zh: 这将减少我们的花费。
entries.en: This should reduce costs.

entries.zh: 来自[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的演习情报
entries.en: Intelligence on [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] Maneuvers

entries.zh: 我们的情报人员收集了更多在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系不断增加的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]舰队活动的情报。[From.Owner.GetName]似乎聚集了一支庞大的舰队，以前所未有的规模进行着舰队演习.\n\n到目前为止，还没有迹象表明此次演习将转化为对[Root.GetName]的直接军事行动，但靠近我方边界的军事行动必然被看作是蓄意挑衅！我们应该如何回应？
entries.en: Our intelligence assets have gathered more information on the increased [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] naval activity in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. The [From.Owner.GetName] seems to have gathered a large fleet there to conduct some kind of massive naval exercise on an unprecedented scale.\n\nAs of yet there are no signs that this exercise will translate into direct military operations against the [Root.GetName], its proximity to our border can only be seen as a deliberate provocation! How should we respond?

entries.zh: 我们将严重抗议！
entries.en: Lodge a diplomatic protest!

entries.zh: 我们无视他们的挑衅。
entries.en: We will ignore their provocations.

entries.zh: 我们严重抗议[From.Owner.GetName]的行为，对他们表示强烈谴责与不满。
entries.en: We make our displeasure at these exercises known to the [From.Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: [From.GetName]以最强硬的措辞对目前正在[exercise_system.GetName]星系举行演习的[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰队表示抗议和不满。\n\n如此规模空前的舰队演习，如此接近我们的边界，这只能被理解为一种几乎不加遮掩的威胁与挑衅。我们的部队已经处于最高警戒状态，我们的舰队司令被命令以最强有力的军事回应应对任何边境的侵犯。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] objects in the strongest possible terms to the provocative military exercise currently being held in the [exercise_system.GetName] system by [Root.GetSpeciesName] naval units.\n\nTo stage fleet maneuvers on such an unprecedented scale so close to our borders can only be construed as a thinly veiled threat. Our own forces have been placed on maximum alert, and our fleet commanders have been instructed to respond to any border violations with overwhelming force.

entries.zh: 告诉[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不要干涉我们的内政！
entries.en: Tell the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to stay out of our affairs!

entries.zh: 我们无法承担后果……取消演习。
entries.en: We can't afford an incident... cancel the exercise.

entries.zh: 我们的外交官会缓和局面。
entries.en: Our diplomats will smooth things over.

entries.zh: 对于他们卑微的抗议，我们将回应以最强硬的态度。
entries.en: We make a hard-line diplomatic response to their obnoxious little protest.

entries.zh: 我们取消了正在举行的舰队演习，以便改善与[From.GetName]的关系。军方一定会对此表示不满。\n\n
entries.en: We cancel our ongoing fleet maneuvers to improve relations with the [From.GetName]. The military will not be pleased.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们将采取温和的回应以减轻外交伤害，但舰队演习仍将继续。
entries.en: We make a conciliatory response to lessen the diplomatic damage, but the exercise continues.

entries.zh:
我们收到了你们对在[exercise_system.GetName]举行演习的英勇无敌舰队发出的措辞不当的抗议。正如你们所知，那个恒星系位于[From.GetName]的主权范围内，所以我们不认为那里发生的事与你们有任何关系。

顺便提醒一下，[Root.GetName]最好能老老实实的管好自己并保证以后也不会给我们发送如此鲁莽、充满挑衅的外交文书。

通讯结束。
entries.en:
We have received your poorly phrased objection to the military exercises our glorious naval forces are currently conducting in the [exercise_system.GetName] system. Since that system, as you are no doubt aware, lies well within the sovereign territory of the [From.GetName], we do not see how what transpires there could possibly be any of your business.

The [Root.GetName] would do well not to send us any more such provocative and reckless diplomatic correspondence in the future.

This transmission ends now.

entries.zh: 无法容忍！
entries.en: This is intolerable!

entries.zh: 由于[Root.GetName]对在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的舰队演习表示抗议，[From.GetName]已决定终止所有正在进行的舰队演习，以增进两个星际国家之间的良好关系。\n\n我们真诚地希望，这次行动将有助于缓和星际间的紧张局势，同时这将毫无疑问地证明，[From.GetSpeciesName]致力于星系的持久和平。
entries.en: In light of the objections voiced by the [Root.GetName] to our naval maneuvers in the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the [From.GetName] has decided to terminate all ongoing exercises in the interest of fostering better relations between our two star nations.\n\nIt is our sincere hope that this action will help to defuse interstellar tensions while proving beyond doubt the [From.GetSpeciesName] commitment towards a lasting galactic peace.

entries.zh: 也许他们真的在追寻和平……
entries.en: Perhaps they are earnest in their quest for peace...

entries.zh: 我们在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系进行的军事演习受到了[From.GetName]的误解，对此我们深表遗憾。\n\n此次演习系按预定计划进行，进行的地点亦由指挥官随机挑选，不针对任何人或任何势力。该演习绝不应被过度解读为对[Root.GetName]的威胁或挑衅。
entries.en: The [From.GetName] deeply regrets any misunderstandings our ongoing military exercises in the [exercise_system.GetName] system might have caused.\n\nThese naval drills were planned well in advance, and the location was chosen at random by our commanders. In no way should this be construed as some kind of threat or provocation directed at the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 也许这是[From.GetSpeciesName]的另一个诡计？
entries.en: Is this yet another [From.GetSpeciesName] ruse?

entries.zh: 演习结束
entries.en: Maneuvers Concluded

entries.zh: [exercise_fleet.GetName]在[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系举行的演习已经结束。指挥官[exercise_admiral.GetName]报告说，我们从演习中获益颇丰，这很大程度上归功于此次演习规模之巨大。尽管可能会有一些的外交上面的负面影响，但至少此次军演所积累的军事经验是非常宝贵的。
entries.en: The fleet maneuvers conducted by the [exercise_fleet.GetName] in the [exercise_system.GetName] system have been concluded. Commander [exercise_admiral.GetName] reports that we have learned much from this exercise, in large part due to its immense scale. Despite any potential diplomatic repercussions, the military benefits, at least, have been substantial.

entries.zh: 干得不错。
entries.en: A job well done.

entries.zh: [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]演习结束
entries.en: [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] Maneuvers Concluded

entries.zh: 鉴于从[exercise_system.GetName]恒星系收到的[From.Owner.GetSpeciesName]军用加密信号突然减少，[From.Owner.GetName]在那里举行的舰队演习终于结束了。
entries.en: Judging by the sudden drop in coded [From.Owner.GetSpeciesName] military transmissions coming from the [exercise_system.GetName] system, the naval exercise that was being held there by the [From.Owner.GetName] has finally come to an end.

entries.zh: 正该如此。
entries.en: About time.

entries.zh: 他们的知识渊博、理论繁复。但他们对终极真理的探索究竟会带向启蒙还是湮灭。
entries.en: Their knowledge was vast, their theories complex. But did their search for ultimate truth lead to enlightenment, or oblivion?

entries.zh: 他们遨游繁星之间，探索不止，扩张不息。如今却只留下残砖断瓦，低语着未曾预见的后果。
entries.en: They roamed the stars, always searching, ever expanding. Now, only their ruins remain, whispering of unforeseen consequences.

entries.zh: 团结非常脆弱。如此影响力横跨整个星区的生机勃勃的联邦究竟是被什么力量击碎的呢？
entries.en: Unity is fragile. What force shattered a once flourishing federation whose influence spanned entire sectors?

entries.zh: 即使是最强大的文明也有可能落败于意料之外的敌人。究竟是傲慢使其盲目，还是天真使其丧命？
entries.en: Even the mightiest civilizations fall to unseen foes. Did arrogance blind them, or did ignorance seal their fate?

entries.zh: 曾经他们无可匹敌，不知何时他们的斗志却被击碎了。究竟是谁结束了他们的圣战？
entries.en: For a time, nothing could stand against them, until something shattered their resolve. What brought their crusade to an end?

entries.zh: 他们栽培整颗星球，精心雕琢生态系统。但无论扎得多深都可能被连根拔起。
entries.en: They cultivated entire worlds, shaping ecosystems with care. But even the deepest roots can be torn from the ground.

entries.zh: 意识没有极限。他们的思想带领他们穿越繁星，重塑现实。但即使目光再深远，也不意味着会看到同一个未来。
entries.en: The mind is limitless. Their thoughts carried them across the stars, reshaping existence. But even those who see beyond do not always see alike.

entries.zh: 繁荣孕育野心，野心招致毁灭。解开他们网的力量是谁仍不得而知，但单靠利润是不足以拯救他们的。
entries.en: Prosperity breeds ambition, and ambition invites ruin. What force unraveled their web remains unknown, but profit alone was not enough to save them.

entries.zh: 他们驾驭着宇宙的狂潮，不受束缚，永不停息。但即便流浪者也不能永远流浪。
entries.en: They rode the tides of the cosmos, never bound, never still. But even wanderers cannot roam forever.
